Description.シリウスシュガーの少女たちはメイズにて、\n全裸で追いかけられる謎の男性を発見す: In the Maze, the girls of Sirius Sugar discover a mysterious man being chased around completely naked. That was the beginning of a fate-altering encounter.
Description.突如として退学の危機に陥る指揮官たち。\nそんな彼女たちは最強クラスのチームと\: The commanders suddenly face the threat of expulsion. To save their future, they must challenge a top-tier team in a high-stakes battle with everything on the line.
Description.危機を乗り越えたシリウスシュガーへと、\n待ち受けていた次なる試練は資金難？\n: Having overcome the crisis, the next trial awaiting Sirius Sugar is... financial trouble? As they take on new challenges, an unexpected turn of events unfolds...
Description.２つの試練を乗り越え成長した彼女たちの\n次なる試練は問題児達の訓練指導！？\n: <size=90%>Having grown after overcoming two trials, their next ordeal is instructing a group of problem children!? Meanwhile, a conspiracy targeting them begins to unfold in the shadows...</size>
Description.次に指揮官が導くのは、チーム『トレブル\nクインテット』。ＭＧの新型ジェネレータ: Next, the commander leads team 'Treble Quintet'. They take on a project to evaluate MG's new generator model, and so—
Description.ＬＯＣでの事件を解決した指揮官は、突如として誘拐される。その犯人は……スランプに: After resolving the incident at LOC, the commander is suddenly kidnapped. The culprit is none other than... 'Chaos Maiden', who have fallen into a slump!?
Description.ミリアム達に招かれた指揮官。そこで彼は\n『ピクシス・マスール』の解散と新チーム: Invited by Miriam and her group, the commander learns of the disbandment of 'Pyxis Ma Soeur' and the birth of a new team, 'Arcturus'—
Description.人工スタンピードの犯人『双頭の斧』を一斉検挙するため、学園は大規模作戦を企図。そ: <size=80%>To round up the 'Double-Headed Axe', the culprits behind the artificial stampede, the Academy plans a large-scale operation. To that end, Sirius Sugar is provided with new machines—</size>
Description.危機的な状況から、生還した指揮官たち。\nイザナミによって支配されたパイロットを: Having survived a critical situation, the commanders launch a counteroffensive on the surface to save the pilots controlled by Izanami—
Description.ゾリャー校区に現れたのは、イザナミが操る\n戦略機動要塞『八咫烏』。指揮官達は校: Appearing in the Zorya School District is the strategic mobile fortress 'Yatagarasu', controlled by Izanami. The commanders head into battle to protect the district. Just then, five Tenkyu units appear—

Appearing in the Zorya School District is the strategic mobile fortress 'Yatagarasu,' controlled by Izanami. The commanders head into battle to protect the district. Just then, five Tenkyuu units appear--
Description.ピコの告げる真実に衝撃を受ける一同。\nそしてそれをきっかけに記憶を取り戻す指揮: Everyone is shocked by the truth Piko reveals. Prompted by this, the Commander regains their memories. The final battle against Izanami begins—
Description.イザナミとの戦いが終わり、ようやく静かな\n時間が戻ってきた。だからこそ、俺は―: With the battle against Izanami over, a quiet time has finally returned. That is precisely why I—I must properly determine where I belong.

SubTitle.煌めくは白百合の剣: The Gleaming Sword of White Lilies

Overview.「次の公式試合で負ければ退学」\nそんな条件を言い渡されたシリウスシュガー。\n: "Expulsion if you lose the next official match." That was the condition handed down to Sirius Sugar. Living alongside these girls who lacked any sense of urgency, you, as their commander, must discover what missing element Sirius Sugar needs...
Overview.同じ校舎のチーム『カラフルブーケ』との\n演習で惨敗し、後がないことを自覚した\: After suffering a crushing defeat in a practice match against Colorful Bouquet, a team from the same school building, the members of Sirius Sugar realize they have their backs to the wall. To train them, the protagonist subjects them to drills that seem downright unreasonable. Pushed to their limits, frustration builds up within the girls, but as a test of their progress, they dive into the maze...
Overview.ついに訓練を終えたシリウスシュガー。\n成果を披露するものの、不安を隠す事の\n: Sirius Sugar has finally finished their training. Though showcasing the fruits of their labor, Meru remains unable to hide her anxiety, and together you head out to scope out the competition. What you witness there is Chaos Maiden, a team boasting overwhelming skill. What will be the outcome of a match with the team's destiny on the line...?
Overview.辛い特訓乗り越えたシリウスシュガー。\nだが、楽観視できない現状に危機感を抱く\: Sirius Sugar managed to overcome their grueling special training. However, feeling a sense of crisis regarding their far-from-promising situation, Nanairo head out together to the Scalar School Building. There, they witness the prowess of Julia Barnes, who possesses talent beyond common sense. What will be the outcome of a match with the team's destiny on the line...?
Overview.退学の危機を乗り越えたシリウスシュガー。\nしかし、次なる危機が待ち受ける。\n: Sirius Sugar survived the threat of expulsion, but the next crisis was already waiting for them. And that was... the team's lack of funds! As they prepare to embark on a full-scale maze exploration to earn money, two familiar girls arrive to act as their advisors.
Overview.順調に進んでいくメイズの探索だったが、\n『メイズシンドローム』という現象による: The maze exploration was progressing smoothly, but a condition known as "Maze Syndrome" leaves them feeling ill and brings their progress to a halt. However, that very phenomenon increases their maze aptitude, pushing them to venture even deeper. But when they discover a new route...
Overview.メイズの未知なる領域へと落ち、危機に陥る\nシリウスシュガーのメンバー。\n極限: Falling into an unknown region of the maze, the members of Sirius Sugar find themselves in danger. Pushed to the brink, what are the feelings that the cheeky and competitive Rami opens up to the commander about? In a desperate, cornered situation, will they be able to escape the maze safely...?
Overview.新ルート開拓に失敗して、メイズの奥底へと\n落ちていったシリウスシュガー。\nそ: Having failed to forge a new route, Sirius Sugar plummets into the depths of the maze. Even in such an unsettling situation, Shirona remains a pillar for the team, her skills earning everyone's trust. Yet, only the commander notices a certain side to her...? Will they truly be able to escape the maze...?
Overview.メイズの深層から脱出という危機を乗り越えた\nシリウスシュガー。そんな彼女たちに: Having overcome the crisis of escaping the maze's deep layers, Sirius Sugar receives an unexpected request. It entails training the pilot trainees of Pre-Class A. Flipping the script from students to teachers, will they be able to successfully shape them up?
Overview.大きな陰謀に巻き込まれたシリウスシュガー。\nそのターゲットは『月ヶ瀬ちゆる』と: Sirius Sugar becomes embroiled in a massive conspiracy. The target was none other than Tsukigase Chiyuru, a genius. Sirius Sugar finds themselves competing against a team from another school in a match to decide who gets her. In the midst of the battle over Chiyuru, an unidentified, mysterious entity crashes the fight...
Overview.ちゆるを巡るバトルロイヤルに\n突如乱入してきた違法パイロット集団――\n『双頭: Suddenly barging into the battle royale over Chiyuru is a group of illegal pilots—Double-Headed Axe. Their goal, too, was Chiyuru. With various motives intertwining, Chapter 3 finally reaches its climax...!
Overview.ＬＯＣ所属『トレブルクインテット』からの\n依頼で、新型ジェネレーターの\n評価: Taking a request from Treble Quintet of LOC, the commander agrees to support an evaluation project for a new generator. Standing in their way, however, are the three members of their rival team, Trinity Jewel!
Overview.１勝１敗で迎えた次なる試験は、\nメイズでの実地試験。\nトリニティ・ジュエルと: Tied at one win and one loss, the next trial is a practical test inside the maze. In a match against Trinity Jewel that they cannot afford to lose, Evi can be seen quietly wrestling with her own troubles. Entering the challenge with various anxieties and emotions, where will this maze exploration contest lead...?
Overview.情報窃取の疑いで捕まったトリニティ・\nジュエル。リリーの呼びかけもあり、\n指: Trinity Jewel is arrested on suspicion of stealing information. Prompted by Lily, the commander and Flute begin questioning people around LOC to see if anyone suspicious has been spotted, hoping to prove their innocence. In doing so, an unexpected name comes up.

Trinity Jewel is arrested on suspicion of stealing information. Prompted by Lily, the commander, Evi, and the others track the traces of unauthorized access. In the process, Evi realizes the possibility that her former hacking mentor, Farfalla, might be involved in this matter...
Overview.ＬＯＣでの依頼を終えた指揮官は、突如として\nＭＧ集団に誘拐されてしまう。その正: Upon finishing the request at LOC, the commander is suddenly kidnapped by a group of MGs. Their true identity turns out to be Chaos Maiden, who have fallen into a slump. Meanwhile, a request from "a certain someone" comes in for Meru and the others while they wait for the commander.
Overview.生徒会長が企画した競技、メイズラッシュ。\n参加を要請されるカオスメイデンだが、: Maze Rush— a competition organized by the student council president. Chaos Maiden is requested to participate, but they are still stuck in a severe slump. Will the commander be able to guide them out of it...?
Overview.突如として現れた巨大穿光属種によって、\n分断されたふたつのチーム。\n未だに受: The two teams are separated by a giant Spearlight species that appears out of nowhere. Julia remains bewildered, unable to accept her feelings. Just then, a swarm of Spearlight species launches an attack against them.
Overview.突如として現れた巨大穿光属種によって、\n分断されたふたつのチーム。\n未だに己: The two teams are separated by a giant Spearlight species that appears out of nowhere. Saya still hasn't found her answer. Just then, a new Maze Shifter attacks them.
Overview.ユーロ・タワーに新チーム『アークトゥルス』\nが発足。このチームにドロテアがリー: A new team, Arcturus, is formed in Euro Tower. Dorothea is scouted to be its leader, leaving Pyxis Ma Soeur destined for dissolution. Wanting to stay with Dorothea, Miriam and the others invite the commander to assist in special training so they can win the member selection trials.
Overview.ユニティエッジに勝利したミリアム達。\nだが、その後リュシーから告げられたのは、: Miriam and the others defeated Unity Edge. However, Lucy delivers a shocking truth to them afterwards: Miriam, Harriette, and Kate weren't even eligible to participate in the selection trials in the first place. Upon learning this, Miriam and the others...
Overview.コード９９１――大規模敵性存在の出現。\n学園中の生徒達はＭＧを駆り、\n次々と: Code 991—the appearance of a large-scale hostile entity. Students across the academy pilot their MGs and head to the battlefield one after another. The commander, too, sorties at the head of Dorothea and the others to eradicate the threat approaching the academy.
Overview.コード９９１――大規模敵性存在の出現。\nそれは人工的に引き起こされた可能性が\: Code 991—the appearance of a large-scale hostile entity. Word has it that this might have been artificially triggered... To pursue Double-Headed Axe, the suspected culprit, the commander leads Dorothea and the others deep into the Sparkling Belt...
Overview.人工的にスタンピードを発生させている\n『双頭の斧』。\n学園は彼女達を一斉検挙: Double-Headed Axe has been artificially causing stampedes. In order to round them all up at once, the academy plans a large-scale operation. To that end, Sirius Sugar is provided with new units...
Overview.神楽とコトハが、実は仲間だった……\nその事実に動揺する一同。\nそこにさらに神: Kagura and Kotoha were actually allies all along... Everyone is shaken by this fact. To make matters worse, Kagura and her companion reveal a shocking truth. It pertains to the very foundation of this world, as well as the crisis currently unfolding within it...
Overview.イザナミによって大事な仲間を奪われた\n指揮官とコトハ。そんなふたりを救ったのは: Having had precious comrades stolen from them by Izanami, the commander and Kotoha are saved by Team Krasna—a team from the Zorya School Building led by Olga Volkova. Entrusted with Kagura's "hope" by the team, Kotoha...
Overview.暗示にかかった仲間たちを救うため、\n一行は４つのサブノードの破壊に動き始める。: To save their brainwashed allies, the group sets out to destroy four sub-nodes. The first target is Node-A in the nearest LOC district. Waiting for them there are their former academy schoolmates...
Overview.トレブルクインテットやトリニティ・ジュエル\nを打ち破り、さらにイザナミの防御網: Having defeated Treble Quintet and Trinity Jewel, as well as breaking through Izanami's defense network, the commander and the group successfully destroy Node-A. The second target is Node-S in the Scalar district. The commander prepares for the upcoming battle while deepening bonds with Kotoha and everyone in Krasna.
Overview.カオスメイデン戦での予想以上の消耗から、\n指揮官たちは残り２つのサブノードを\: Due to greater depletion than expected during the battle with Chaos Maiden, the commander and the group decide to split into two teams to capture the remaining two sub-nodes. The commander and Kotoha set off for Node-N alongside Olga and Elena. Waiting for them there is...

Due to greater depletion than expected during the battle with Chaos Maiden, the commander and the group decide to split into two teams to capture the remaining two sub-nodes. The commander and Kotoha set off for Node-K alongside Nadja and Elena. Waiting for them there is...
Overview.指揮官を排除するため、行動を開始した\n戦略機動要塞『八咫烏』。\n強大すぎる敵: The strategic mobile fortress Yatagarasu springs into action to eliminate the commander. Facing an overwhelmingly powerful foe, the group avoids direct combat, opting instead for an operation to strike Izanami's main server. Just as they attempt to break through a drone encirclement, five Tenkyu appear...
Overview.指揮官の演説を引き金として、\nザルトゥームの生徒達は洗脳から解放された。\nし: Triggered by the commander's speech, the students of Zartum are freed from their brainwashing. Driven to madness, however, Izanami deems the area of the speech a target for purge and launches an attack. Freed from mind control, the various teams gather around the commander to fight alongside one another and protect the people.
Overview.生還した神楽を加え、決戦の準備は整った。\nザルトゥームの人々の自由を勝ち取るた: Joined by the surviving Kagura, preparations for the final battle are complete. To win back freedom for the people of Zartum, the group embarks on their final operation, targeting Selenosia Island where Izanami's main body resides. As preparations proceed at a breakneck pace, the commander catches sight of Tatiana, who looks exhausted...

Joined by the surviving Kagura, preparations for the final battle are complete. To win back freedom for the people of Zartum, the group embarks on their final operation, targeting Selenosia Island where Izanami's main body resides. As preparations proceed at a breakneck pace, the commander catches sight of Elena, who wears a gloomy expression...
Overview.イザナミとの最後の戦いが始まる。\n立ちはだかるのは、全力の『八咫烏』。\nザル: The final battle against Izanami begins. Standing in their way is the full might of 'Yatagarasu.' Risking the future of Zartum Island and the humanity living upon it, the commanders face the decisive battle.
Overview.ザルトゥーム島の真実を知った学園の少女達。\nそしてそのピコの話をきっかけに、\: The academy girls learn the truth about Zartum Island. Prompted by Piko's story, the Commander regains their memories. Though the revelations are shocking, their goal remains unchanged. For the freedom and future of Zartum Island, the party heads toward Izanami's main server—
Overview.１万年以上前。アマツカゼに乗って宇宙へ\n旅立ったあなたとイザナミ、そして――\: Over ten thousand years ago. You, Izanami, and—alongside Captain Asahi Mikage and the crew—set off into space aboard the Amatsukaze. Reaching a new frontier at the end of a long voyage, they are forced to make a momentous choice—
Overview.イザナミとの戦いが終わり、\nザルトゥーム島に日常が戻った。\n指揮官は自身がこ: With the battle against Izanami over, daily life returned to Zartum Island. The Commander is troubled by the reality that they are one of the 'root causes' who changed this world. Amidst this, he ends up going out on a date with Meru, just the two of them—
Overview.生徒会長・四王天神楽は双頭の斧の少女達に\n学園への所属を提案する。\nしかしコ: Student Council President Kagura Shioumon proposes that the girls of the Twin-Headed Axe join the academy. However, Kotoha refuses. Afterward, they suddenly abandon their hideout and disappear. It seems their destination is the Maze—

Hobby.研究・読書・友達と出かける: Research, reading, and hanging out with friends

Description.平凡な家庭に生まれた少女。過集中の傾向があり、集中すれば高いパフォーマンスを発揮: A girl born into an ordinary family. She has a tendency to hyperfocus, which allows her to perform exceptionally well when concentrated, though this has caused troubles with those around her in the past. She has a strong desire to be helpful to others.
Description.シリウスシュガーのリーダー。ＭＧ事業で１代にして財を築いた鳴滝家の長女。世の中か: The leader of Sirius Sugar. Eldest daughter of the Narutaki family, who built their fortune in a single generation through the MG business. Known to the world as nouveau riche, she carries a complex about it and wants the world to recognize the Narutaki family as respectable, legitimate wealth.
Description.社交的で明るいメイズオタク。会員が自分だけの『メイズ研究同好会』を立ち上げ、１人: A social, cheerful Maze nerd. An eccentric who founded the 'Maze Research Club' where she is the sole member and conducts research alone. She is supposedly extremely smart, but because her suspicious experiments constantly trigger explosions in the clubroom, those around her view her as a brilliant idiot.
Description.お金を稼ぐためにザルトゥーム学園へと入学した少女。生意気で負けず嫌いな性格をして: A girl who enrolled in Zartum Academy to earn money. She has a cheeky, competitive personality and never backs down, even against older opponents. Coming from a complicated family environment, she is reluctant to talk about her background.
Description.ミステリアスなオーラを漂わせる寡黙な少女。様々な分野で好成績を残している事から、: A quiet girl with a mysterious aura. Respected across the academy for her high achievements in various fields, she seems to hold a secret she can tell no one...
Description.カラフルブーケのリーダー。政治家の父を持つ名家出身の少女。柊校舎内でも優秀なパイ: The leader of Colorful Bouquet. A girl from a distinguished family with a politician father, and an elite pilot in the Hiiragi Dorm. Strict with both herself and others, she values discipline above all. Though feared by some students, she is deeply caring at heart.
Description.引っ込み思案で自信のない少女。学園にも両親に言われたから入学しただけで、危険で怖: A shy, insecure girl who only enrolled in the academy because her parents told her to, and wants to quit because it's dangerous and scary. Despite her fears, her abilities are exceptional and highly valued by her team, though her lack of self-awareness leaves her perpetually frightened.
Description.生まれつき知能が高く、周囲にも献身的で慕われている優等生。効率的に立ち回る事を好: A naturally brilliant honor student, devoted to others and widely admired. She prefers acting with maximum efficiency. As Colorful Bouquet's strategist, she stays behind the scenes to support the team, though she appears to harbor a secret.
Description.ノヴァセレスの元貴族。元貴族ではあるが、誇りを重んじる負けん気の強い性格。いつか: A former noble from Novaceres. Despite her fallen status, she possesses a fierce pride and competitive spirit, dreaming of reviving her family's business to prove everyone wrong. She can be surprisingly easy to manipulate at times. 'Kira' is her mother's surname.
Description.面倒くさがりな省エネ主義であり、目立ったことを嫌って必要以上に前に出ないようにし: An energy-saving slacker who hates standing out and avoids the spotlight whenever possible. A longtime best friend of Aoi, she constantly backs up Aoi, who frequently creates friction with others.
Description.カオスメイデンのリーダー。パイロットとして天才的なセンスを持っているが、性格は問: The leader of Chaos Maiden. A genius pilot whose personality is a complete disaster. Though bright and charismatic, she is childish and tactless, with a mysterious origin that hints at hidden secrets...
Description.スカラ地区の華連というコミュニティの出身。商家の娘でビジネスの世界を知るせいか他: Hailing from the Karen community in the Scalar District. As a merchant's daughter familiar with business, she can be strict with others, but is fundamentally caring and kind. Reluctant to be bound to her family's trade, she hopes to work for a stable company with good benefits in the future.
Description.アマツをルーツに持つスカラ地区出身の茶道宗家の息女。茶の道を究める精神修行を兼ね: A grandmaster's daughter from a tea ceremony family in the Scalar District with roots in Amatsu. She became a pilot as part of her mental training to master the way of tea. Perceived by outsiders as a gentle young lady, her teammates seem to view her quite differently.
Description.掴みどころのない性格をしており、普段はぼんやりとしていることが多い。しかしＭＧに: An elusive girl who often seems spaced out. However, once inside an MG, she displays top-tier piloting skills capable of handling any situation. In her own words, she enrolled in the academy to learn human emotions.
Description.ノヴァセレスをルーツに持つ少女。仲の良い相手をからかい、その反応で親愛を試すよう: A girl with roots in Novaceres. She has a bad habit of teasing close friends to test their affection through their reactions. Raised by a single mother currently hospitalized for mental illness, she became a pilot to pay medical bills and secure a stable future.
Description.アマツ系の少女。凄腕のパイロットだが他人と行動するのが苦手。実力で学園に特例を認: A girl of Amatsu descent. A highly skilled pilot who struggles to work with others, her sheer talent forced the academy to grant a special exception allowing her to operate as a solo team. Raised in the mountains by her father in self-sufficiency, her favorite nail gun is a keepsake from him.
Description.トレブルクインテットのリーダー。元々は真面目で大人しい地味な子だったが、ネットを: The leader of Treble Quintet. Originally a serious, quiet, and plain girl, her discovery of Amatsu's 'gal culture' online inspired her to become a gal herself. She is now a popular gal streamer with a growing fanbase.
Description.幼い頃からＰＣに慣れ親しみ、ネットで出会った師匠から教わったハッキング技術で、一: Familiar with computers from an early age, she operates as a top-tier white hat hacker using skills learned from a mentor online. Lacking grand dreams or ambitions, she holds a pragmatist mindset focused heavily on time efficiency and cost-performance.
Description.かつてはザルトゥーム島でも有名な歌手として活動していた。現在は活動を休止し、パイ: Once a famous singer on Zartum Island, she currently put her music career on hold to work as a pilot. Fluffy, cheerful, and soothing to be around, her hobby is cultivating cacti.
Description.起業家の父親と画家の母親の間に生まれた、商売人気質な少女。親から教わった手腕で、: Born to an entrepreneur father and painter mother, she inherited a natural business instinct, running several ventures despite being a student. Broadly social and outgoing, she struggles with an unfortunate tendency to view relationships in terms of profit and loss.
Description.金属工芸アーティストとして有名であり、一部界隈からは『空想造形師ロージー』という: Famous as a metalcraft artist, known in certain circles by the alias 'Rosie the Imaginary Sculptor.' Raised in a family auto repair shop, she is skilled with machinery. Exceptionally bright and free-spirited, she frequently drags along anyone she takes a liking to.
Description.ピクシス・マスールのリーダー。名門カークランド公爵家の一人娘。上に立つべき人間と: The leader of Pyxis Ma Soeur and the only daughter of the prestigious Ducal Kirkland family. A true noble who honors the duty of leadership, acting in a way that commands respect. Her maid Lucy has been her best friend since childhood, whom she regards as an older sister.
Description.下級貴族ヘイワード家の生まれ。実家は貴族としての体面を維持するのがギリギリで、暮: Born to the low-ranking noble Hayward family, whose lifestyle barely maintains aristocratic appearances and resembles commoners. Admiring Dorothea after a certain incident, she became a maid-in-training. Poor at academics, her confidence is second to none.
Description.下級貴族ミルズ家の生まれ。多忙な両親の元で一人で過ごしてきた事から、内向的で人見: Born to the low-ranking noble Mills family, spending her childhood alone due to busy parents left her introverted and shy. She idolizes Dorothea following a certain incident and became a maid-in-training. Sharp-tongued and guarded toward outsiders, she is earnest and affectionate at core.
Description.中級貴族フルニエ家の生まれ。やや特殊な家庭環境で育ったせいか、運動神経抜群。ある: Born to the mid-ranking noble Fournier family, her unusual home upbringing granted her outstanding athletic ability. Inspired by Dorothea after a certain incident, she became a maid-in-training. Usually timid, she is secretly the scariest member of the team when angered.
Description.プレ・クラス－Ａのリーダー。４人兄妹の末っ子として、家族に愛されて育ってきた明る: The leader of Pre-Class A. Raised as the beloved youngest of four siblings, she is a bright girl who respects her father, a small business owner, and plans to start her own company. A bit clumsy and clumsy-brained, but relentlessly positive.
Description.母親がアマツ出身なハーフの女の子。弟や妹が多く、家族の生活のためにパイロットを目: A half-Amatsu girl with many younger siblings who entered the academy as a pilot to support her family's livelihood. Gentle and big-sisterly, she finds joy in helping others. She is terrified of ghosts and bugs.
Description.かつて将来を期待された陸上競技の選手だったが、事故によってその道を諦めることに。: A promising track-and-field athlete whose career was cut short by an accident. Finding out her Maze aptitude opened a second path in life at the academy. Stoic and hardworking, her lack of cooperativeness sometimes leads to trouble.
Description.人懐っこく誰とでも仲良くなれるが、メイズに潜ると我を忘れて暴れまわる危険な一面を: Friendly and quick to make friends, she harbors a dangerous side that loses control and goes wild when diving into the Maze. Secretly a romantic, she loves reading romance novels away from prying eyes.
Description.カークランド家のメイド。孤児。幼い頃施設を飛び出し、路上生活を送っていたが、ある: A maid of the Kirkland family and an orphan. After running away from an orphanage to live on the streets, she saved a drowning Dorothea from a river, becoming her maid. She considers Dorothea both her master and a younger sister.
Description.元々は内気で臆病な少女だったが、『超機神ジャスティオン』という作品を読んでからヒ: Originally a timid, shy girl, reading 'Super Machine God Justion' inspired her love for heroes, transforming her into a cheerful, justice-driven person. Passionate about heroes, she can talk endlessly whenever she meets a fellow enthusiast.
Description.スカラ地区の華連というコミュニティの名家出身。様々なコネクションを持っており、そ: From a prominent family in the Karen community of the Scalar District, her extensive connections remain shrouded in mystery. She respects Shiouten Kagura deeply and will push through any obstacle for her sake. Though she hides her weakness for spicy food, it is open knowledge.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Resilient and positive, she is uniquely assertive and overbearing only toward her childhood friend Takeru Shirogane.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Exceptional in swordsmanship, noble, and composed, rumors in her homeland say she bears a striking resemblance to a certain noble figure.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Always cheerful, innocent, and friendly, Takeru Shirogane calls her by the nickname 'Tama.' Her marksmanship as a sniper is exceptional.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Possessing a strict military personality that respects orders, she frequently clashes with the free-spirited Ayamine.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Bright and often the moodmaker of her squad, her overly easygoing pace sometimes causes her to tune out others.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Feline in demeanor, she possesses great close-quarters combat instincts and adapts fluidly, though over-improvising occasionally leads to acting alone.
Description.有名なモデルとしても活躍している精鋭クラスのパイロット。クールで知的なリーダーと: An elite pilot who also doubles as a famous model. She leads Trinity Jewel as a cool, intellectual leader. Born into an ethnic minority, she cherishes her homeland. It seems she harbors a secret hobby she has told to no one.
Description.運動が苦手で自尊心が低い陰気な女の子。だが、非常に高いメイズ適性と知識、観察力で: A gloomy girl poor at sports and low in self-esteem. However, her exceptionally high Maze aptitude, knowledge, and observation skills make her a powerful support pilot. Hoping to change herself, her first goal is losing weight, though her sweet tooth leaves little sign of success.
Description.不思議な雰囲気を持つフワフワとした博愛主義の女の子。みんなを笑顔にするために、色: A airy, philanthropic girl with an enigmatic aura. To make everyone smile, she helps solve people's troubles and fulfill their wishes. Though appearing laid-back, her piloting skills are praised as genius level.
Description.風紀委員会・副委員長。一見気怠げなギャルだが、実はノヴァセレスの下級貴族出身であ: Vice Chairperson of the Disciplinary Committee. At first glance a lazy gal, she is actually a low-ranking noble from Novaceres. Unserious and a chronic slacker, she is nevertheless clever and quietly supports the blunder-prone Mao behind the scenes. Though never showing it, she admires Mao deeply.
Description.風紀委員会・委員長。身体能力が高く、ＭＧ操作技術も風紀委員会トップ。正義感も強く: Chairperson of the Disciplinary Committee. Athletic with top-tier MG piloting skills in the committee. Earnest with a strong sense of justice, she is useless at administrative work outside piloting. Yet in crises, she steps up as a leader, acting as a resilient emotional pillar for everyone.
Description.クラスナのリーダー。パイロット歴１０年以上のベテランであり、一人の娘を持つ母親で: The leader of Krasna. A veteran with over 10 years of piloting experience and mother to a daughter. A strict woman who values discipline and rationality above all. Rarely displaying emotion, her awkward yet profound love for her daughter is genuine.
Description.オルガの一人娘。引っ込み思案で甘えん坊気質。母親に褒めてもらうため、日々努力を重: Olga's only daughter. Shy and affectionate by nature, she works hard every day seeking her mother's praise. Raised in a single-parent home, she longs for a father figure. Despite her appearance, she inherited her mother's talent and high MG piloting abilities.
Description.クラスナのムードメーカー。明るく元気な性格で、周囲の空気を読むことが得意。パイロ: The moodmaker of Krasna. Bright and energetic, she excels at reading the room. While her piloting skills fall slightly behind other members, her ability to mediate and coordinate among teammates is second to none.
Description.クラスナの作戦参謀。作戦立案力の高さを評価されており、その実力を買われてチームに: Krasna's tactical strategist. Recruited to the team for her renowned operational planning skills. Though appearing purely analytical and rational, she is compassionate and deeply values her friends. Her archaic manner of speech comes from her former female mentor.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Usually strict with herself, she occasionally glimpses the innocent side of a normal girl her age.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Hot-headed and quick to fight, she excels in close-quarters battle using unique maneuvers she developed herself.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' A cool beauty with mature charm, she also shows a domestic side by occasionally cooking dishes from her homeland.
Description.違法パイロット組織『双頭の斧』のボス。その正体は『ＡＩＤＡプロトコル統括ＡＩ・イ: The boss of the illegal pilot syndicate 'Double-Headed Axe.' Her true identity is an isomorphic construct of the original Shiouten Kagura, operating behind the scenes to liberate the world from the control of 'AIDA Protocol Managing AI Izanami.' Feisty at first glance, she is deeply considerate and kind at heart.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' A cool beauty with mature charm, she also shows a domestic side by occasionally cooking dishes from her homeland.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Hot-headed and quick to fight, she excels in close-quarters battle using unique maneuvers she developed herself.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Usually strict with herself, she occasionally glimpses the innocent side of a normal girl her age.
Description.主人格ニーナ・ミーシナ。クラスナのメンバーで、二重人格の少女。物腰柔らかく、穏や: The primary personality, Nina Mishina. A member of Krasna and a girl with a dual personality. She has a soft-spoken and gentle demeanor. In daily life, the primary personality Nina is active, and she can switch personalities by sneezing. However, Gina occasionally pops out on her own as well.
Description.別人格ジーナ・ミーシナ。クラスナのメンバーで、二重人格の少女。やや芝居がかった口: The alternate personality, Gina Mishina. A member of Krasna and a girl with a dual personality. She has a unique personality, speaking in a somewhat theatrical tone. Gina primarily handles combat while piloting the MG. According to them, they share memories with each other even while switching personalities.

Favorite.静かな場所・自分の部屋: Quiet places and my own room
Favorite.カフェスイーツ・ファッション雑貨・ポップミュージック: Cafe sweets, fashion accessories, and pop music
Favorite.正しいこと・小動物・子ども: Doing the right thing, small animals, and children

Favorite.他人の笑顔・可愛い文房具やメモ帳: Smiles of others, cute stationery, and notepads

Description.鳴滝七彩をリーダーとした落ちこぼれチーム。仲の良さならトップにも負けない。: A underachieving team led by Narutaki Nanairo. When it comes to how well they get along, they lose to no one, even the top teams.
Description.生駒葵をリーダーにした校舎内トップクラスチーム。規律の取れた連携が強み。: A top-tier team in the school building led by Ikoma Aoi. Their strength lies in disciplined coordination.
Description.リーダーのユリアの性格を反映したような自由さが売りの校舎内トップクラスチーム。: A top-tier team in the school building whose selling point is a sense of freedom reflecting the personality of their leader, Julia.
Description.実力によって学園から特例で単独結成を認められた榊野ヒイロだけのチーム。: A team composed solely of Hiiro Sakakino, granted a special exception by the academy to form alone due to her skill.
Description.ドロテアをリーダーとした学園でも指折りのチーム。統率の取れたチームワークが強み。: One of the academy's leading teams, led by Dorothea. Their strength lies in well-organized teamwork.
Description.フルートをリーダーとしたチーム。全員がパイロット以外に別の肩書きを持つ。: A team led by Flute. Every member holds a title or profession outside of being a pilot.
Description.レイヴェルをリーダーとしたチーム。たった３人でもトップクラスの実力を持つ。: A team led by Ravel. Despite having only three members, they possess top-class strength.
Description.再訓練用校舎『特別養成校舎』に所属するプレ・クラスのうちの１チーム。: One of the Pre-Class teams belonging to the 'Special Training School Building,' a facility used for retraining.
Description.オルガをリーダーとするチーム。チームの連携力は、他チームを凌ぐと言われている。: A team led by Olga. Their team coordination is said to surpass all other teams.
Description.生徒会直下の治安維持チーム。各校舎から集められた生徒達で構成されている。: A public safety team directly under the student council, composed of students gathered from each school building.

This gacha can be used by consuming paid/free Gems or Standard Gacha Tickets. 
 
[About Gacha Points] 
In the Standard Gacha, you earn 1 Standard Gacha Point for each pull.
*Standard Gacha Points do not have an expiration date.
 
[About the Wishlist]
You can set 4 students for each of the 4 basic attributes (Aggressive, Smart, Shy, Cute) and 1 student for each of the 2 special attributes (Comical, Clever) on your Wishlist. When the Wishlist is set, SSR students that appear will be limited to those set on your Wishlist. 

[About Style Cards] 
If you obtain a student you already own, they will be converted into Style Cards.
Style Cards are used to limit break students.

[Available Students]
Students who newly debut in Pick-Up Gachas will be sequentially added to the pool for this gacha.
*Students from Limited Pick-Up Gachas are excluded from being added.

Speech.集中しすぎて周りが見えなくなるくせ……今なら前向きに受け止められます。これもあな: My habit of hyperfocusing to the point where I tune out my surroundings... Now, I can take it in a positive light. That's thanks to you as well.
Speech.この学園に入ってよかったと心からそう思ってます。シリウスシュガーのみんなやあなた: I truly feel from the bottom of my heart that coming to this academy was the right choice. If I hadn't met everyone in Sirius Sugar and you, I surely never would have been able to change.
Speech.今度どこかにシリウスシュガーのみんなと遊びに行きませんか？例えばピクニックとか…: Would you like to go out somewhere with everyone from Sirius Sugar next time? Like a picnic, for instance... I'd be more than happy to pack lunches for everyone!
Speech.あれ……？ 反応がありませんね……もしかしてお休み中でしょうか？ふふ、目が覚める: Oh...? No response... Could you be sleeping? Fufu, I'll wait until you wake up.
Speech.今日はあなたが生まれた記念すべき日……そんな日に立ち会えて、なんだか嬉しいです。: Today is the memorable day you were born... I feel somewhat happy to share in a day like this. Shall we celebrate together in my room, just the two of us? Naturally, until this day comes to an end.
Speech.ふふっ、あけましておめでとうございますっ！ こうして一緒に年を越せて、感慨深いで: Fufu, Happy New Year! Ringing in the new year together like this brings back so many feelings. I may still be clumsy, but please keep looking after me.
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーですね……ふふっ、もちろんチョコレートはありますよ。えっ？: Today is Valentine's Day, isn't it... Fufu, of course I have chocolates for you. Eh? Is it the safe kind with no alcohol...? Well, now... Who knows?
Speech.ドキドキ……ドキドキ……きょ、今日ってホワイトデーですよね！その…………えっ？: *Thump-thump*... *thump-thump*... T-Today is White Day, right! Um......... Eh? You properly have one for me too? E-Ehehe... I'm so happy!
Speech.あ、あのっ……私！ あなたに嘘をついてみたいです！！……なんて、今の言葉が嘘だっ: U-Um...! I want to try telling you a lie!! ...Just kidding, maybe what I just said was a lie itself... Ehehe.
Speech.ウエディングドレスって結婚式のとき以外にも着たいほど、綺麗なドレスですよね。実は: Wedding dresses are so beautiful that you almost want to wear them outside of weddings too. Actually, there's a shop nearby where you can try them on... Would you like to go check it out with me for a bit?
Speech.ふふ、私のお願いはもう叶っちゃったか、あるいはみんながいれば叶うものばかりです。: Fufu, my wishes have either already come true, or they're all things that will come true as long as everyone is here. So I'll share my portion of wishes with you.
Speech.秋といえば食欲の秋。もしよろしければ、かぼちゃ料理なんてどうですか？くり抜いたも: Autumn is the season for eating. If you'd like, how about some pumpkin dishes? Everyone at the school building gave me plenty of hollowed-out pumpkins saying 'use these for cooking'...
Speech.メリークリスマスです！ あの……チームのみんなとのクリスマスパーティーのあと、よ: Merry Christmas! Um... After the Christmas party with the rest of the team, if it's alright with you, would you like to have a Christmas party 'just for the two of us' as well?
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……？ ありがとうございます！ プレゼント何がいいか……ですか？: Happy birthday...? Thank you so much! What would I like as a present...? Ah, th-then... I want to spend the entire day today... j-just the two of us with you...
Speech.ここって……なるほど……|あなたのおかげで、だいぶわかるようになってきたかもです: This part... I see...|Thanks to you, I feel like I'm starting to understand a lot better. You're really good at teaching, too.
Speech.ちょっと眠く……|あっ……ね、寝てない……ですよ？ え？ 見てた？ き、気のせい: Getting a bit sleepy...|Ah... I-I wasn't... sleeping, okay? Eh? You saw me? Y-You must be imagining things.
Speech.（あっ！ 目があった……）|（うぅ……そういえば今ふたりきりなんだよね……意識し: (Ah! Our eyes met...)|(Ugh... Come to think of it, we're all alone right now... Becoming aware of it is making my heart race!)
Speech.自分だけが犠牲になればいいなんて思いません。あなたと、みんなと……一緒に生きて帰: I don't think it's fine as long as I'm the only one sacrificed. Because I promised to return alive together with you, and with everyone else. I definitely won't give up!
Speech.最近、前よりも少しだけ自分に自信が持てるようになった気がします。あなたがいつも、: Lately, I feel like I've gained just a bit more confidence in myself than before. That's thanks to you always watching over me. Ehehe...
Speech.メイズ深層での戦いは不安ですけど……あなたとなら、どこまででも行ける気がするんで: I'm anxious about fighting in the deep layers of the Maze, but... with you, I feel like I can go anywhere. So please keep guiding me from now on, okay?
Speech.すぅ……すぅ……あっ、いけない！ 私のほうが寝ちゃってました。あなたが無防備な顔: *Snoore*... *snoore*... Ah, oh no! I was the one who fell asleep. You were sleeping with such a defenseless face that I somehow felt completely at ease... Ehehe.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございますっ！ あなたが生まれてきてくれた奇跡に、心から感謝し: Happy Birthday! From the bottom of my heart, I thank the miracle that brought you into this world. Today, I'll grant... whatever wish you have, okay!
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます！ 今年もあなたのお世話はいーっぱい私にさせてくだ: Happy New Year! Please let me take care of you a whole lot this year too, okay? First off, Hatsumode... Let's go buy a charm for success in love!
Speech.ハッピーバレンタイン、ですっ！ ……あ、あの、このチョコ……私のありったけの『想: Happy Valentine's! ...U-Um, this chocolate... I made it by hand pouring all my 'feelings' into it, so... please eat every last bit, okay?
Speech.……えっ、これ……私にですか！？ バレンタインのお返し……っ！ あ、あわわ……嬉: ...Eh, this... is for me!? A return gift for Valentine's...! A-Ahawa... I'm so happy! It feels like a waste to eat it, I almost want to display it for the rest of my life...!
Speech.実は私……ちょっと家の事情で故郷に帰ることにしたんです。……なーんて、嘘ですよっ: Actually... I've decided to return to my hometown due to some family circumstances. ...Just kidding, it's a lie! Sirius Sugar is my precious home, after all.
Speech.６月の花嫁は幸せになれるって言いますよね。……あの、もし私がウエディングドレスを: They say June brides will be happy, right? ...Um, if I ever wear a wedding dress... will you stand beside me...?
Speech.短冊にお願い事、書きましたか？ 私は……『ずっとみんなのそばにいられますように』: Did you write your wish on a paper strip? I wrote... 'May I always be by everyone's side.' ...Fufu, I wonder if this wish will come true.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート、ですっ！ お菓子をくれないとイタズラしちゃいますよ？…: Trick or Treat! If you don't give me treats, I'll play a trick on you, okay? ...Eh, you'd rather play a trick on me than take treats...? Auuu...!
Speech.この時期は街がキラキラしてて、とっても綺麗ですね……でも私にとっては、こうしてあ: The town is sparkling and so beautiful at this time of year... But to me, spending time with you like this is the brightest sparkle of all.
Speech.私のお誕生日、覚えててくれたんですね……っ！ ありがとうございます！……誕生日プ: You remembered my birthday...! Thank you so much! ...May I ask for one thing as a birthday present? Please—N-Never mind, it's nothing!
Speech.えへへ……転んじゃいました……|まだまだこのスーツ、全然着こなせてないですね……: Ehehe... I fell down...|I'm still nowhere near mastering this suit...
Speech.あっ……胸元が……！|うぅ……この格好、やっぱり恥ずかしいです……あ、あまり見な: Ah... my chest...!|Ugh... this outfit is embarrassing after all... P-Please don't look too much...
Speech.ピチッとした感じ……苦手かも……|普段あまりこういうのを着ないので、張り付く感じ: This tight feeling... I might not be good with it...|I don't usually wear things like this, so I can't quite get used to the clinging sensation...
Speech.実はドライフラワー作りが得意ですの。自分が育てた花を、ずっとわたくしの手元に残し: Actually, I am quite good at making dried flowers. I learned how because I wanted to keep the flowers I grew by my side forever.
Speech.今までの自分を振り返ると……冷静に立ち向かう重要性が分かりますわね。焦っては、ノ: Looking back on my past self... I understand the importance of facing things calmly. After all, one cannot fulfill noblesse oblige if panicking.
Speech.秘密にしておりましたが……実はジャンクフードも好きですの。濃いめの味が好きで……: I kept it a secret, but... I actually like junk food as well. I enjoy rich, strong flavors... Um, would you like to go eat together sometime?
Speech.ふぅ……こうして静かな時間を過ごすのも悪くありませんが……。どうしても、チームの: Phew... Spending quiet time like this isn't bad either, but... I inevitably end up missing those noisy times with everyone on the team.
Speech.あなたの誕生日には、どんなことをしてあげればいいのでしょうか？……お金じゃない、: What kind of thing should I do for you on your birthday? ...I want to give you a heartfelt gift, not something bought with money.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。もし、あなたが良ければ……一緒に新年のあいさつで: Happy New Year. If it pleases you... would you like to come to my home with me to give New Year's greetings?
Speech.その、どうぞ。バレンタインデーのチョコレートですわ。生まれて初めて手作りをしてみ: Um, here. These are Valentine's Day chocolates. It's the first time in my life I've tried making them by hand, but... um, will you accept them?
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しですか？ ありがとうございます。……ふふ、あなたから貰ったも: A return gift for White Day? Thank you very much. ...Fufu, since it is a present from you, I shall treasure it.
Speech.実はお父様の会社が倒産しまして……今はただの一般人なんですの。 ……えっと、嘘で: To tell you the truth, my father's company went bankrupt... I am merely an ordinary citizen now. ...Um, that was a lie. You see, I am quite bad at this sort of thing!
Speech.わたくし、いつか結婚をするのなら政略結婚などではなくて……大好きな誰かと大恋愛の: If I am to marry someday, rather than a political marriage... I wish to marry someone I love dearly after a passionate romance.
Speech.……こうして空に祈って願い事をかなえてもらうよりも、自分の力で叶えたい……そんな: ...Rather than praying to the sky to have my wishes granted like this, I want to fulfill them through my own strength... I've come to think that way, you know?
Speech.トリックオアトリート……いえ、仮装はしませんわよ？子供の頃は、それこそとっても派: Trick or Treat... No, I shall not wear a costume. When I was a child, I used to wear extremely flashy costumes and stand out in a bad way, though...
Speech.メリークリスマス。お金を使って豪華なパーティもいいですけども……自分たちの手で準: Merry Christmas. Splurging on a lavish party is fine, but... preparing everything with our own hands and celebrating together with everyone is truly wonderful♪
Speech.わたくしの誕生日を祝ってくださってありがとうございます……ふふ、あなたに祝ってい: Thank you for celebrating my birthday... Fufu, having you celebrate it for me... strangely makes me feel restless with excitement.
Speech.はぁ、とっても可愛い……|ふふ、ふかふかで、とても愛らしくて……このままずっと抱: Haa, so very cute...|Fufu, so fluffy and adorable... It makes me want to hold it tight forever.
Speech.これが、あちらに……あっ！|取るのに失敗してしまいましたね……こういうゲームは難: This goes over there... Ah!|I failed to grab it... Games like this are quite difficult.
Speech.ふふ、ありがとうございます。|知らない場所でも、安心できるのはあなたが居てくれた: Fufu, thank you very much.|Even in an unfamiliar place, being able to feel at ease is all thanks to you being here with me.
Speech.メイズっていうのは謎が多くて奥が深いんだよねぇ。いつかは全ての謎を解き明かしたい: The Maze is full of mysteries and super deep. I'd love to unravel all its secrets someday... Well, usually I just enjoy researching at my own pace, though♪
Speech.シリウスシュガーの皆は割と気に入ってるよ。だって面白い子達ばっかりだもんね。もち: I quite like everyone in Sirius Sugar. They're all such interesting girls, after all. Of course, I'm super curious about you too♪
Speech.ねえねえ、ちょっと実験に付き合ってくれないかな？ どんな内容かって？簡単だよ！: Hey hey, mind helping me out with an experiment? What's it about? Simple! Just gulp down that rainbow-colored liquid... Absolutely not? Aww, no way~!
Speech.んー、暇だなぁ。あたしに構ってくれないと退屈で死んじゃうよ～？: Mmm, I'm so bored. If you don't pay attention to me, I'm gonna die of boredom~
Speech.今日はキミの誕生日なんだよね？今なら、特別にあたしの部屋へご招待♪ 一緒に朝まで: Today's your birthday, right? Right now, you get a special invitation to my room♪ Want to party and hang out together till morning?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！折角の新年だからね、どうせなら部室でちょっと爆発でも起こし: Happy New Year! Since it's the New Year and all, maybe I should cause a little explosion in the clubroom to blow everyone's minds♪
Speech.ハッピーバレンタイン！ さて、チョコを作ってきたからパクっと食べてみて！……え？: Happy Valentine's! Now then, I made some chocolate so open wide and take a bite! ...Eh? Did I put something in it? Ahaha... Maybe you'll find out once you try it!
Speech.おや、ホワイトデーのお返しをくれるの？うーん、君も律儀だねぇ。ありがと、大切に食: Oh, giving me a White Day return gift? My, aren't you dutiful. Thanks, I'll be sure to savor it♪
Speech.さて、おバカな振りはやめて科学者として活動を再開しようかしらね……なーんて、冗談: Now then, perhaps I should stop playing dumb and resume my activities as a scientist... Just kidding♪ Eh? Did I sound serious? Ahaha, I wonder which one is real?
Speech.ジューンブライドかぁ。気になるよねぇ。なんで６月にやるんだろう？結婚するなら、も: June bride, huh. It makes you wonder. Why hold it in June? You'd think there are better suited months to get married, right? ...I lack romance?
Speech.願い事？ うーん、それなら面白いことが起きますようにって願いをするかな。自分で叶: A wish? Hmm, then I'd wish for something interesting to happen. If it's something I can fulfill myself, there's no need to wish for it, right?♪
Speech.お化けかぁ。なんとなくお化けの正体を考察してみてるんだけどさ。メイズの重力異常か: Ghosts, huh. I've been pondering what ghosts actually are. Entities born from gravity anomalies in the Maze... Meaning ghosts might originate from the Maze too... Just a thought, though?
Speech.メリークリスマス♪ いやー、クリスマスっていいよねぇ！だって、ホールケーキを誰に: Merry Christmas♪ Man, Christmas is great! After all, it's a day where you can eat a whole cake without anyone scolding you♪ That's not a thing?
Speech.え？ 誕生日？ ……ああ、そういえばそうだったね。意外と覚えてなかったから不意打: Eh? My birthday? ...Ah, now that you mention it, it was. Surprisingly I forgot, so you caught me off guard... Thanks♪
Speech.え？ 誕生日？ ……ああ、そういえばそうだったね。意外と覚えてなかったら不意打ち: Eh? My birthday? ...Ah, now that you mention it, it was. Surprisingly I forgot, so you caught me off guard... Thanks♪
Speech.んー、君と一緒だからかなぁ？|こうしてのんびりしてても、一人でいる時よりもずっと: Hmm, is it because I'm with you?|Even when relaxing like this, it feels way more enjoyable than being alone♪
Speech.んん～！ 美味しい！|もしかして、一口欲しい？間接キスになっちゃうけど、それでい: Mmm~! Delicious!|Do you want a bite? It'll be an indirect kiss, but if you're fine with that, I'll share♪
Speech.わわっ！？ ……なんだ、花びらかぁ。|いきなり何事かと思っちゃった……もっとおし: Wawa!? ...Oh, just flower petals.|I wondered what happened all of a sudden... Maybe I should've reacted more gracefully?
Speech.アマツから戻ったら、さっそく研究研究研究の研究ざんまいだね♪ こんなに時間あるの: Once we're back from Amatsu, it's straight back to research, research, research, a total research frenzy♪ Having so much time and just idling it away is such a waste! My blood is pumping~!
Speech.ねえ、お正月だからこそ、メイズ探索いかない？ 他のチームとか休んでて人少なそうだ: Hey, precisely because it's New Year's, why not go Maze exploring? Other teams are resting so there'll be fewer people, seems like a comfortable run, right? Ah, but that means the number of Maze Shifters we have to fight might increase...
Speech.ねえ、甘酒買ってきたんだけど、一緒に飲まない？ あ、でも、酔っ払って襲わないでよ: Hey, I bought some amazake, want to drink together? Ah, but don't get drunk and attack me, okay? A girl like me can't resist your strength. Eh? You won't get drunk from this much? R~eally?
Speech.お正月のせいで、ちょっと体重が……%usernameusernameuserna: Because of New Year's, my weight went up a bit... I wonder if %usernameusernameuserna% prefers slimmer girls after all—Wait, when did you get behind me!? You didn't... hear that, right!?
Speech.誕生日おめでと。今日はあたしがキミの神様になって、何か１つ願い事を叶えてあげよう: Happy birthday. Today I'll be your god and grant you one wish... Of course, as long as it's not dangerous, 'anything' goes. It's a secret from Meru-chan and the others, okay?
Speech.あけましておめでとう、%usernameusernameuserna%。これから: Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%. I want us to keep exchanging these words forever. So with that said, hand over some New Year's money for my research fund♪
Speech.はい、チョコ羊羹。振袖着てるし、せっかくなら渡すものも和菓子っぽいのがいいかなっ: Here, chocolate yokan. Since I'm wearing a furisode, I thought a Japanese sweet would fit best. Besides, you're getting gifts from other girls too, so I wanted to leave a bit of an impression♪
Speech.ん？ ホワイトデーのお返しに苺大福？ わぁ、美味しそう♪ こんな美味しそうなの、: Hmm? Strawberry daifuku as a White Day return gift? Wow, looks delicious♪ Is it really okay for me to have something this tasty? I won't give it back even if you ask, you know? But if we eat it together, that works too!
Speech.今日エイプリルフールだったよね？ ふふ、そうだ。あたしの質問に答えてみてよ。『あ: Today was April Fools' Day, right? Fufu, I know. Try answering my question: 'Do you like me or dislike me, which is it?' I wonder how you'll answer, %usernameusernameuserna%~?
Speech.多分あたしって研究第一人間だから、行き遅れる気がするんだよね。もしそうなったらさ: Since I'm a research-first person, I'll probably end up missing my chance to marry. If that happens, why don't you take me off the market? ...Just kidding. But if so, I could keep focusing on research with peace of mind.
Speech.七夕の願い事かぁ……神社でも散々したし、これ以上は欲張りすぎて罰が当たるかもね。: Tanabata wishes, huh... I wished plenty at the shrine, so being any greedier might bring bad luck. But since it's free, the cost-performance feels way better here...
Speech.ハロウィンなのに振袖はおかしいって？ まあでも、アマツなら着物姿の女の霊が出てく: Wearing a furisode for Halloween is weird? Well, Amatsu has ghost stories about women in kimonos, so calling it an 'Amatsu arrangement' works, right? Sweets like yokan fit too♪
Speech.メリクリ～！ 振袖だと違和感ある？ どうせこのあとすぐお正月だし、別にいいでしょ: Merry Christmas~! Does a furisode feel out of place? It's going to be New Year's right after this anyway, so who cares. Even supermarkets start taking New Year's food reservations early, right? It's the same thing.
Speech.へえ～誕生日祝ってくれるんだ？ じゃあ、今日はキミがあたしの願いを叶える神様にな: Heh~ you're celebrating my birthday? Then today, you be the god who grants my wishes. What kind of wish should I have granted~? First, let's start by wishing to increase my wishes to 100♪
Speech.ぷくー……|ふふ、どう？ あたしのほっぺもお餅っぽいでしょ。: *Puff*...|Fufu, how's that? My cheeks look like mochi too, don't they.
Speech.醤油、使う？|砂糖醤油を絡めたお餅は格別だよね～。それともキミと一緒だから格別な: Want some soy sauce?|Mochi coated in sweet soy sauce is exquisite~ Or is it exquisite because I'm with you?
Speech.まだかな、まだかな、お・も・ち♪|ちなみにこことこれとあれは、あたしが育ててる餅: Is it ready yet, is it ready yet, m-o-c-h-i♪ By the way, this one, that one, and that over there are mochi I'm raising, so no touching!
Speech.いやー、今思えばメイズで出会ったときの裸のおまえ、動画にでも撮っておけばよかった: Man, looking back, I should've recorded a video of you naked when we met in the Maze~! If I had that, I could tease you relentlessly forever!
Speech.部屋の中、物が少ない？ まあ、あんましいろいろ買うお金ないし。どこに消えてるのか: Not much stuff in my room? Well, I don't have money to buy lots of things. Where's it disappearing to? That's... something I'd never tell the likes of you.
Speech.お金って本当人間変えちゃうよね……特にうちの親とか財政状況がマイナスに振り切って: Money really changes people... Especially after my parents' finances plunged into the negative—Ah, sorry. That wasn't something I should be telling you.
Speech.……はぁ、退屈～。最近金欠だし、暇つぶしの材料も買えないの、マジだる……なんで世: *Sigh* So bored~ Broke lately, can't even buy stuff to kill time, seriously annoying... Why does everything in this world take money...
Speech.誕生日なんだ？ へえ、めでたいじゃん。……え？ 普通に祝ってくれて意外？ こうい: It's your birthday? Huh, congrats then. ...Eh? Surprised I'm celebrating normally? I can congratulate you honestly on a day like this. It'd be sad not getting celebrated on a day that only comes once a year, right?
Speech.よし、きた！ お正月！ お正月といえば……！ お年玉！ だから、ちょ～だい！え？: Alright, here it comes! New Year's! Speaking of New Year's...! New Year's money! So, hand it over! Eh? Not at that age anymore? Haaah~! Who cares!
Speech.え～？ もしかしてラミからチョコが欲しいの～？どうしよっかな～？ 用意はしてるけ: Ehh~? Don't tell me you want chocolate from Rami~? What should I do~? I have some ready, but do you want it~? Desperately~?
Speech.え？ バレンタインのお返し？ ふーん……まあ、良い心がけじゃない？おまえにしては: Eh? A Valentine's return gift? Hmh... Well, good initiative. Quite thoughtful for you... Th-Thanks.
Speech.ラミだけ課題の提出し忘れがある……？ マジで！？ ……なんて、驚くと思った？そん: Rami is the only one who forgot to submit the assignment...? Seriously!? ...Did you think I'd be shocked? I won't fall for a lie like that! ...Eh? Not a lie? Seriously!?
Speech.……何？ ラミだって女の子なんだから、ドレスに憧れはあるっての。人生で１回くらい: ...What? Rami's a girl too, so of course I long for a dress. I'd like to wear a wedding dress at least once in my life... *glance*.
Speech.願い事？ お金ほしい！ ……って言いたいところだけど、お金はあくまで手段というか: A wish? I want money! ...is what I'd like to say, but money is just a means, not the goal. My real wish is... the happiness of my younger brother and sister.
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ お菓子じゃなくて、お金よこせー！え？それじゃ、ただのアウ: Trick or Treat! Give me money instead of candy! Eh? Then I'm just an outlaw?
Speech.今日おまえも含めてクリスマスパーティーやるじゃん？ でもラミ、こういうの初めてな: We're throwing a Christmas party today including you, right? But it's Rami's first time doing this. Couldn't do it much at home. So what should I... Ah, no point asking an amnesiac like you.
Speech.待ちに待った、ラミの誕生日～！ おまえはどんなプレゼントしてくれるの？時計？ カ: The long-awaited Rami's Birthday~! What kind of gift are you giving me? A watch? A bag? Accessories? Anything works as long as it can be cashed in, even a stack of bills is fine!
Speech.はぁ～、まったく。|なっさけないなぁ、もう。そんなんでラミ達の教導指揮官できるの: *Sigh*, honestly.|So pathetic, geez. Can you really be Rami and the others' instructor like that~?
Speech.あはっ、どこで寝てんの？|いくら疲れてるからって、こんな道端で寝るとか野生動物じ: Aha, where are you sleeping? No matter how tired you are, sleeping on the roadside like this makes you a wild animal~!
Speech.ざ～こ、ざ～こ、よっわ～！|もっと普段から体力つけてないから、こうやってラミに笑: Weakling, weakling, so weak~! That's why Rami's laughing at you, because you don't build up your stamina regularly!
Speech.昔は、こういう浮かれた空気はあんまり好きじゃなかったけどさ……最近は、なんだろ…: In the past, I didn't really like this kind of merry mood, but... lately, I don't know... thanks to you and everyone, I might've come to understand the fun of it a little.
Speech.久々に弟と妹の顔見たなー。ちょっと大きくなってて、やっぱ子どもの成長って早いよね: It's been a while since I saw my brother and sister. They got bigger, children really grow fast~. Huh? Rami's growth is slow? Rami isn't a kid! Just a bit petite!
Speech.神社巡りのために、お賽銭用の小銭いっぱい両替しておいたけど、マジでおっっっも！: I exchanged a bunch of coins for shrine offerings, but it's super heavy! My wallet got insanely fat! ...Ah, but I can just make %usernameusernameuserna% carry it.
Speech.……ふんふんふーん♪ 結構着るのもダルそうだし、お金の無駄と思ったけど……着てみ: ...Hum-hum-hum♪ Thought wearing this would be a hassle and a waste of money, but... putting it on, this kind of furisode isn't half bad♪
Speech.あ、誕生日おめでと。それじゃ、どこ行く？ ……え？ どういうことかって？そんなの: Ah, happy birthday. So, where are we going? ...Eh? What do I mean? Obviously we're going out to celebrate together. For today at least, I'll tag along wherever.
Speech.ん？ このメモ？ 神社でお祈り予定の願い事リストに決まってんじゃん。多すぎて覚え: Hmm? This note? Obviously it's the wish list I plan to pray for at the shrine. There are too many to memorize, so I listed them. You look like you think I'm greedy, but I carefully selected these, you know.
Speech.……なんか、ただチョコを渡すだけだっていうのに、この格好だと……仰々しくて緊張す: ...Somehow, even though I'm just handing over chocolate, in this outfit... it feels so formal and nerve-wracking... Hey, don't look at my face so much!
Speech.ほら、バレンタインデー、チョコあげたんだからホワイトデー返しなさいよ。まさか準備: Look, I gave you Valentine's chocolate so give me a White Day return gift. Don't tell me you didn't prepare anything? I'm waiting for a triple return!
Speech.あれ？ なんで服着替えてないの？ この後、学園の行事があるから正装しないとダメな: Huh? Why haven't you changed clothes? We have an academy event after this so you need formal wear. Eh? Don't tell me you forgot? Really...? Just kidding, lie~! Ahaha, did you fall for it?
Speech.ラミは白無垢よりもドレス派なんだよね～……って、正月に見たあの夢思い出したじゃん: Rami is more of a dress person than a shiromuku~ ...Ah, that reminded me of that dream I had on New Year's... Eh? What dream...? I-It's nothing!!
Speech.ふふ、七夕でも願い事しまくってやるんだから。そうすればご利益２倍ね！まずは弟と妹: Fufu, I'm gonna make tons of wishes for Tanabata too. That way the blessings double! First is my brother and sister's happiness... top priority. Next is with you and... Wait, scratch that last one!!
Speech.トリックオアウィーッシュ！ イタズラされたくなけりゃ、ラミの願い事をなんでも叶え: Trick or Wish! If you don't want to be pranked, grant any wish Rami has! Huh? The demand is too big...? Got it, a prank for you without question then.
Speech.クリスマスかぁ……シリウスシュガーの皆とパーティーやろって話してて、楽しみにして: Christmas, huh... We talked about throwing a party with everyone in Sirius Sugar, so I'm looking forward to it♪ ...Setting that aside, if I go in this outfit, people will think I got the date wrong...
Speech.もう誕生日か～。早いもんだよね。え？ 神様の代わりに願い事ひとつ叶えてやるって？: Already my birthday, huh~. Time flies. Eh? You'll grant one wish in place of god? Heh... If you'll 'grant anything', what should I choose~? ...Hmm? You didn't go that far?
Speech.ちょ、取るな！？|あっぶなー……油断も隙もないなぁ。折角の大吉なんだから、大切に: Hey, don't take it!?|Whew, close one... Can't let my guard down around you. It's a great fortune after all, obviously I'm gonna treasure it.
Speech.……やりすぎたかも。|ムキになっちゃった……うぐぐ……この後の予定が……節約しな: ...I might have overdone it.|I got carried away... Ugh... My plans after this... I have to save money...
Speech.へへーん、大吉～♪|ほらほら♪ これこそ、本気ラミの運気パワーなんだから！: Heheh, great fortune~♪|Look look♪ This is the true luck power of Rami at full effort!
Speech.わたしは何もできないから……何かを出来る自分になりたいと思ってる。それがメイズに: Since I can't do anything... I want to become someone who can. Even if it involves something dangerous like diving into the Maze.
Speech.わたし、服を見たりするのが好きなの。もしよければ、あなたのコーディーネートをして: I like looking at clothes. If it's okay with you, I'd like to try styling your outfit... Is that fine?
Speech.こんな、何もできないわたしの事を必要だって言って、仲間にしてくれた……そんなシリ: They said they needed someone like me who can't do anything, and welcomed me as a comrade... I love Sirius Sugar for that. That's why I want to be of help to everyone.
Speech.……あれ？ もしかしてどこかに行っちゃった……？全然気づかなかった……えっと、ど: ...Huh? Did you perhaps go somewhere...? I didn't notice at all... Um, what should I do...
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……わたしからお祝いをしたいの。だから、あなたのためにピッタリな: Happy birthday... I want to celebrate with you. So, can I pick out an accessory that suits you perfectly?
Speech.わたしは初日の出を見たことがないの。毎年、気づいたらいつも寝ちゃうから……: I've never seen the first sunrise of the year. Every year, before I know it, I'm always asleep...
Speech.……これ、どうぞ。チョコレート。いつもお世話になってるから。頑張って作ったから、: ...Here, please take this. Chocolate. Because you're always taking care of me. I worked hard to make it, so I'd be happy if you gave me your thoughts...
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？ 私にいいの？嬉しい……絶対に落とさないように気を付けるね: A White Day return gift? Is it really okay for me? I'm so happy... I'll be really careful not to drop it.
Speech.嘘をついていい日って言われてるけど……何を言えばいいんだろう？……うう、全然思い: They say it's a day when you can tell lies, but... what should I say? ...Ugh, I can't think of anything at all... What kind of lie should I tell...?
Speech.ジューンブライド……６月に結婚式を挙げたら、幸せなお嫁さんになれるっていうの。…: June bride... They say if you hold a wedding in June, you'll become a happy bride. ...Someday, I'd like to become like that too.
Speech.願い事……他の子みたいに要領良く出来るようになりたいな。他にも色々お願いしたい事: A wish... I want to become capable and efficient like the other girls. I have many other things I'd like to wish for, but... right now, this is my biggest wish.
Speech.わたし、ハロウィンでお菓子をあげる準備をしてるんだけど……あげる前に子供たちから: I'm getting treats ready to hand out for Halloween, but... the kids run away before I can even give them out. I wonder why...
Speech.メリークリスマス。クリスマスパーティーだね。ちゃんとサンタさんのための靴下も用意: Merry Christmas. It's time for the Christmas party. I even set out a stocking for Santa. Everything is all set.
Speech.……もしかして誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ふふ、そんな風に祝って貰えるなんて……: ...Are you perhaps celebrating my birthday? Fufu, having you celebrate it like this... makes me really happy.
Speech.……不思議な気分。|一人でいつも来ているから……誰かと一緒に、アクセサリーを見る: ...It's a strange feeling.|I always come alone, so... looking at accessories with someone else turns out to be fun too...
Speech.……その、どうして見てるの？|髪をかき上げてるだけで……あんまり、じっと見られる: ...Um, why are you staring?|I was just brushing my hair up... If you stare so intently, it gets embarrassing.
Speech.……どう、似合ってる？|ふふ……こんなに素敵なアクセサリーをプレゼントして貰えて: ...Well, does it suit me?|Fufu... I'm so happy to receive such a wonderful piece of accessory as a gift.
Speech.何度見ても、このスーツ……すごい格好。え？ もっと見ていたい？ ……変態。そもそ: No matter how many times I look at it, this suit... is quite an outfit. Eh? You want to look at it more? ...Pervert. In the first place, are you really fine with someone like me? I think everyone else is much more attractive.
Speech.このスーツのデザインは合理性を重視した結果らしいけど……さすがにこの見た目、途中: Supposedly, this suit's design is the result of prioritizing rationality, but... surely someone should have stepped in to stop this design along the way.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%、鼻の下伸びてる。でもあなたの視: %usernameusernameuserna%, you're grinning like crazy. But if it means I get to monopolize your gaze, then that's... No, it's nothing. Forget it.
Speech.……まだ、戻ってこないのね。わたし、待つのは得意だからいいんだけど……おやつのく: ...You haven't come back yet. I'm good at waiting so it's fine, but... I feel like I'm going to finish all my snack walnuts and macadamia nuts... Please come home soon.
Speech.……お誕生日、おめでとう。プレゼント何を渡そうか悩んでしまって……だから、一緒に: ...Happy birthday. I couldn't decide what gift to give you... So, why don't we go buy one together?
Speech.あけましておめでとう。……お年玉、わたしももらえるのかな。……ふふ、冗談。今年も: Happy New Year. ...I wonder if I get New Year's money too. ...Fufu, just kidding. Please let me stay by your side this year as well. Always looking forward to being with you.
Speech.……これ、あげる。マカダミアナッツがたっぷり入ったチョコ。わたしが好きなものを、: ...Here, take this. Chocolate packed with macadamia nuts. I wanted you to try something I love. I'm sure it tastes great.
Speech.……お返しのマカロン、ありがとう。ふふ、わたしが欲しかったもの、どうしてわかった: ...Thank you for the return gift macarons. Fufu, how did you know what I wanted? ...Since it'd be a waste to rush, I'll savor them slowly.
Speech.わたし、実は天才。どんな計算も、一瞬でできちゃうよ。……なんて、嘘。わたしはただ: Actually, I'm a genius. I can solve any calculation in an instant. ...Just kidding, that was a lie. I'm just lucky... So don't take it too seriously.
Speech.……ウェディングドレス。いつか着てみたいとは思うけど……わたしには、あまり似合わ: ...A wedding dress. I think I'd like to wear one someday, but... I feel like it wouldn't suit me very well. ...Hey, what do you think?
Speech.短冊に願い事……それはこれからもずっとみんなで一緒にいること。当然、そこにはもち: My wish on the paper strip... is for all of us to stay together forever. Naturally, that includes %usernameusernameuserna% as well.
Speech.……トリック・オア・トリート。お菓子をくれても、あなたにイタズラしてみたい。どん: ...Trick or treat. Even if you give me a treat, I want to play a trick on you. What kind of trick would you like?
Speech.メリークリスマス。……特別なプレゼントなんていらない。だって、あなたがここにいる: Merry Christmas. ...I don't need any special presents. Because having you right here is already the best present of all.
Speech.……わたしの誕生日、ちゃんと覚えててくれたんだ。ありがとう……すごく嬉しい。今日: ...You properly remembered my birthday. Thank you... I'm so happy. May I monopolize you for today at least?
Speech.このデザイン、悪意感じない？|間違ってスイッチ押したら、股間のすごいとこが開いち: Don't you feel some malicious intent in this design?|If I hit the switch by mistake, a crazy spot around my crotch is gonna open up...
Speech.ふぅ……いっぱい汗かいた。|だから……%usernameusernameuser: Phew... I sweat a lot.|So... %usernameusernameuserna%, keep a bit of distance. Don't ask why.
Speech.ジロジロ見られるのは、その……|でもわたしをそういう目で見てくれるのは……ちょっ: Being stared at like that is, well...|But having you look at me with those eyes... might actually make me a little happy.
Speech.規律を守ることは大切だが、間違っている規律もある。だから、盲目的に従うのではなく: Observing discipline is important, but there are also wrong rules. That is why it's vital to understand the meaning behind the rules rather than blindly following them.
Speech.整理整頓は大切だ……というよりも、私が散らかっている部屋を見るのが我慢ならんのだ: Keeping things neat and organized is important... or rather, I simply cannot stand seeing a messy room. If it's messy, I will go clean it up myself, alright? Make sure you keep things tidy.
Speech.この竹刀か？ 幼い頃から剣道をしていて、持っていると気が引き締まるんだ。……基本: This shinai? I've been doing kendo since I was young, so holding it braces my spirit. ...I don't just swing it at people in general, alright? I carefully choose when and against whom to use it.
Speech.……そういえば、そろそろお世話の時間だな。ふふ、ペットアプリのコロちゃんも元気そ: ...Come to think of it, it's almost time to care for him. Fufu, Koro-chan in the pet app looks lively too... Fufu, good boy...
Speech.誕生日なのか？ おめでとう！しかしプレゼントがないな……ふむ、なら一緒に今から買: Is it your birthday? Happy Birthday! However, I don't have a present on hand... Hm, shall we go buy one together right now then?
Speech.新年あけましておめでとう。元旦は一年の始まりだ。しっかりと抱負を決めておくんだぞ: Happy New Year. New Year's Day is the start of the year. Make sure you set firm resolutions.
Speech.バレンタインデーか……こういう催しは嫌いじゃない。君にはお世話になってるからな…: Valentine's Day, is it... I don't mind these kinds of occasions. You've looked after me well... Will you accept this?
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しか。ふふ、律儀だな……嬉しいよ。ありがたく受け取らせてもらう: A White Day return gift. Fufu, how dutiful of you... I'm pleased. I gladly accept it.
Speech.私か？ エイプリルフールとはいえ、嘘を言うのは苦手だからな……だから、どんな嘘を: Me? Even if it's April Fools' Day, I am terrible at telling lies... So, I'll just look forward to seeing what kind of lie you'll tell.
Speech.……ジューンブライドか。私も、ああいったウエディングドレスを着る憧れはあるんだ。: ...A June bride, huh. I also long to wear a wedding dress like that. Well, it probably wouldn't suit me, though... That's not true? D-Don't say that out of nowhere! ...It makes me blush.
Speech.七夕か。君は何か願い事があるのか？私は……そうだな。もう少しだけ、女の子っぽくな: Tanabata, is it. Do you have any wish? As for me... let's see. I'd like to become just a little more feminine... N-No, forget I said that.
Speech.ハロウィンか。お菓子はしっかりと準備しているぞ。仮装をしてお菓子を貰いに来る子達: Halloween, huh. I've prepared plenty of treats. I want the children coming for treats in costumes to have a wonderful time.
Speech.メリークリスマス。こういうお祝い事は、皆で楽しまないとな。柊校舎でクリスマスパー: Merry Christmas. We ought to enjoy celebrations like this together with everyone. We're planning a Christmas party at Hiiragi School Building, so why don't you join us?
Speech.私の誕生日だったのだが……チームの皆がお祝いをしてくれてな。その時には、思わず感: It was my birthday, and... everyone on the team celebrated it for me. At that moment, I was so moved I couldn't say a word.
Speech.どうした？ ギュッとしてほしいのか？|ふふ、こうして誰かを甘やかせる機会なんてな: What's wrong? Do you want a hug?|Fufu, I've rarely had the chance to spoil someone like this... You can rely on me as much as you want.
Speech.はぁ……よしよし、良い子だな……|こうして褒めるのも楽しいものだな……ああ、もっ: Ah... there, there, good boy/girl...|Praising someone like this is quite fun... Ah, I want to spoil you even more...
Speech.すぅ、はぁ……！これはいい|……なんというか、癖になる匂いだ……もう少しだけ匂い: *Sniff*, *breath*...! This is nice.|...How should I put it, it's an addictive scent... Can I keep smelling it a bit more...? No?
Speech.アマツに居た時は父上について、こういったパーティーも参加したものだ。……年上や立: When I was in Amatsu, I accompanied my father to parties like this. ...The reason I have no trouble talking to elders or those in higher positions might be thanks to that experience.
Speech.兄上は、とても賢く尊敬できる人なのだが、どうも私をからかって遊ぶ悪癖があってな…: My elder brother is a very wise and respectable person, but he has a bad habit of teasing me for fun... Though as children I caused my share of trouble too, so in a way, we're even.
Speech.子供の頃はお転婆だったのか？ と聞かれても困るな……自分でもあまり記憶がないので: Were you a tomboy as a kid? Asking me that puts me in a spot... I don't recall much of it myself. ...I'm not dodging the question, alright? It's the truth.
Speech.ふむ……パーティーとはいえ、少し派手過ぎただろうか？しかし、%usernameu: Hm... Even for a party, is this a bit too flashy? But %usernameusernameuserna% said it suited me... I'm torn on what to do...
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%、誕生日おめでとう。せっかくだか: %usernameusernameuserna%, Happy Birthday. I thought that since it's a special occasion, giving you my birthday wishes properly dressed like this would be nice.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。こうしたドレス姿で、新年を迎えるのは新鮮な気分だな。伝統を: Happy New Year. Welcoming the New Year in a dress like this feels refreshing. Preserving tradition is good, but turning our eyes to new things might be important as well.
Speech.バレンタインデーといえば……チョコレートではなく、手紙を送る文化もあるらしいな。: Speaking of Valentine's Day... Apparently there's a culture of giving letters instead of chocolates. But writing letters for everyone you give them to would take quite a bit of time, wouldn't it...?
Speech.ホワイトデーという習慣は私は嫌いではない。贈り贈られる……一方的ではなく、相互に: I don't dislike the practice of White Day. Giving and receiving... Rather than being one-sided, thinking of each other mutually is quite wonderful, I think.
Speech.……はぁ。エイプリルフールか。父上も兄上もこういうイベントが好きなんだ。私を全力: ...*Sigh*. April Fools' Day, huh. Both my father and brother love this kind of event. They pull out all the stops to trick me, and I fall for it every time, so I get depressed thinking about what lie is coming...
Speech.このドレスであれば飛び込みでも結婚式に参加はできるだろう……と、自分が着る側にな: With this dress, I could probably crash a wedding on the spot... Ah, you mean about me being the one getting married? ...I thought a shiromuku was nice, but a wedding dress isn't bad either, I suppose.

Speech.……どこを見ているんだ。|そういった視線は気づかれるからな？ ……私だけにしてお: ...Where are you looking?|People notice those kinds of looks, you know? ...Keep them just for me, alright?
Speech.ここをこうして……あっ、すまない！|つい締めすぎてしまったな……久々だったので力: Do this like so... Ah, sorry!|I accidentally squeezed too tight... It's been a while, so I got the strength wrong.
Speech.んっ……私はそんな子どもではないぞ……？|……だが、悪い気はしない。ただ、髪のセ: Nn... I'm not that much of a child, you know...?|...Though I don't feel bad about it. Just keep it in moderation so my hair doesn't get messed up, okay?
Speech.うぅ……正直、パイロットもメイズも苦手ですぅ……出来る事なら、こんな危ないことも: Ugh... Honestly, I'm bad at being a pilot and dealing with the Maze... If possible, I want to live peacefully without dealing with scary or dangerous things like this...
Speech.うぅ……パイロットは嫌なんですけど……褒められることはあるので、続けてます……実: Ugh... I dislike being a pilot, but... I get praised sometimes, so I keep doing it... Back at home, I was never praised for anything...
Speech.趣味でアクセサリー作りをしていますけど……趣味程度なので人にお見せできるほどでは: I make accessories as a hobby, but... it's just a hobby so it's not something I can show people... Th-Though I do have a little confidence in my skills... You want to see...? I-I can't!
Speech.……はぁ……落ち着く……誰もいない時間はリラックスできます……ぴえっ！？ ま、ま: ...Phew... so calming... I can relax when no one is around... Eek!? D-Don't tell me you heard me talking to myself...!?
Speech.誕生日、お、おめでとうございます！ プレゼントのアクセサリーです！えへへ……毎日: H-Happy birthday! Here's an accessory as a present! Ehehe... I cut into my sleep schedule every day and worked really hard to make it...!
Speech.あ、あけましておめでとうござます……うぅ、新年はいろんな方から挨拶をされるのが気: H-Happy New Year... Ugh, having so many people greet me for the New Year feels so overwhelming...
Speech.あ、あの、チョコレート……いりませんか？ あっ、わたしのなんて要らないですよね…: U-Um, would you like some chocolate...? Ah, you wouldn't want something from me, right... Ahaha... Eh? Y-You want it...!? Th-Thank you so much!
Speech.これはいったい……？ ほ、ホワイトデーのお返し……！？チョコを貰っていただいたの: What on earth is this...? A-A White Day return gift...!? Even though you accepted my chocolate, is it really okay for me to get a return gift!?
Speech.エイプリルフールですか？ 私なんかが嘘をつくなんて、そんな恐れ多いです……！むし: April Fools' Day? Someone like me telling a lie would be way too audacious...! Honestly, I'm more at ease being lied to... so please, say whatever you like!
Speech.は、花嫁衣裳ですか！？ わ、わたしには勿体ないです！そ、それにあんなに注目される: B-Bridal wear!? Th-That's way too good for me! B-Besides, I can't handle being the center of attention like that, so... if I were to wear it, I'd want it to be with just the two of us...
Speech.願い事……ですか？ えっと、そうですね……いっぱい褒められたいですね……！あと、: A wish...? Um, let's see... I want to be praised a lot...! Also, to stop getting depressed, win at video games, and win a lottery sweepstakes while I'm at it...!
Speech.はぁ、憂鬱です……今日は、お菓子を強奪される日ですから……！うぅ……どうにかして: *Sigh*, I'm so depressed... Today is the day where my treats get extorted...! Ugh... Isn't there any way to eliminate both trick and treat...?

Speech.あ、そういえば今日は私の誕生日ですね……えっ、お、お祝いをしてくれるんですか……: Ah, come to think of it, today is my birthday... Eh, y-you're going to celebrate it for me...!? What should I do... I might die of happiness right here...!
Speech.ま、負け……！？ そんなぁ！？|うぅ……やっぱりわたしってダメダメです……ゲーム: L-Lost...!? No way!?|Ugh... I really am useless... I can't even win at a video game...
Speech.しあわせですぅ……|あっ、もう終わりなんですか……い、いえ！ ねだるわけじゃない: I'm so happy...|Ah, is it over already...? N-No! It's not like I'm begging for more or anything...!
Speech.こっちのコントローラーをどうぞ！|わたしの人生で初めてかも……一緒にゲームをプレ: Here's the controller for you!|This might be a first in my life... Having someone play games with me makes me so thrilled...!
Speech.あら、もしかして暇なら一緒にボードゲームでもする？ふふ、カラフルブーケ参謀の力…: My, if you're free, want to play a board game together? Fufu, I'll show you the power of Colorful Boquet's strategist. Prepare yourself!
Speech.はぁ……甘いものって本当にいいわよね……糖分は、脳の栄養補給に優秀だもの。私って: Haa... Sweet things are truly great, aren't they? Sugar is excellent for brain nourishment. You see, I'm a tactician, right? So my brain constantly needs energy.
Speech.びっくりした……さっき散歩中の犬に吠えられちゃって。昔噛まれたのが今でもトラウマ: That startled me... A dog being walked just barked at me. Being bitten in the past is still a trauma for me today. Because of that, I'm a bit bad with animals in general now...
Speech.……えっと、スケジュール帳には……今週は公園でゴミ拾いボランティアに参加ね。忘れ: ...Um, in my planner... this week is participating in the park trash pickup volunteer work. Must not forget. I should prepare some refreshment drinks too.
Speech.ふふん、誕生日なことは既に調べているわ！ プレゼントにパーティー、ちゃーんと準備: Fufun, I already looked up that it's your birthday! I've properly prepared a present and a party, so you can thank me all you want!
Speech.あけましておめでとう。ふふ、お正月はとっても好きなのよ。だって、新年は皆休みたが: Happy New Year. Fufu, I really love New Year's. After all, everyone wants to rest during the new year... so working makes it a day where you get even more gratitude than usual!
Speech.はい、チョコレート……なに！？ 私から贈るのは変かしら！？ 義理だから！そんな…: Here, chocolate... What!? Is it weird for me to give you some!? It's obligation chocolate! Don't go misinterpreting it as genuine feelings! Though words of thanks are welcome.
Speech.これは……ホワイトデーのお返し？ あ、ありがとうございます……こ、これも贈り物へ: Is this... a White Day return gift? Th-Thank you... S-Since this is your expression of gratitude for my gift, I'll accept it... Fufu♪
Speech.今日はエイプリルフール？ 私は別に興味がないわ。だって、嘘を吐いても感謝されない: Today is April Fools' Day? I don't particularly care for it. After all, telling a lie won't get you any gratitude, right? Though if it got me gratitude, I wouldn't mind lying.
Speech.結婚式かぁ……どっちかといえば、準備をする側になりたいわ。だって、結婚式が成功し: A wedding, huh... If anything, I'd rather be on the planning side. Just think about how grateful people would be if the wedding is a success...!
Speech.願い事は当然、もっと感謝されますようによ。まあ、願っているだけじゃダメだけどね。: My wish is naturally to be thanked even more. Well, just wishing won't accomplish anything though. I have to take action and earn that gratitude myself! A hundred good deeds and a hundred thanks a day!
Speech.ハロウィンの準備は万端よ。お菓子をあげれば子ども達が喜ぶでしょ？ 子どもからの『: My Halloween preparations are complete. Kids will be happy if I give them treats, right? Hearing 'thank you' from children is extraordinary. I'll go all over the place distributing treats! ...Eh? That's not the point of Halloween?
Speech.メリークリスマス。ふふ、この日は色んな人から感謝されるチャンスなのよ。とはいえ、: Merry Christmas. Fufu, this day is a chance to receive gratitude from all kinds of people. Still, we have a party with Colorful Boquet, so I have to enjoy that as well♪
Speech.えっ、もしかして私の誕生日を覚えててくれたの？あ、ありがとう……うぅ、こんな感謝: Eh, did you actually remember my birthday? Th-Thank you... Ugh, being made to feel so grateful like this... It's frustrating, but I'm happy...!
Speech.……ちょっと、黙ってないで何か言ってよ。|私だって、こういう場所で男の子と一緒に: ...Hey, don't just stay silent, say something.|Even for me, being with a boy in a place like this makes me nervous...
