Speech.え、えっと……ありがとね……|感謝って……言われるのもいいけど、言うのも悪くない: U-Um... thanks...|Expressing gratitude... Being told 'thank you' is nice, but saying it yourself isn't bad either.
Speech.ほんと、%usernameusernameuserna%さんといると知らない気持: Honestly, whenever I'm with %usernameusernameuserna%, so many unfamiliar feelings sprout... Nothing goes according to my calculations at all. Fufu, I'll have to make you take plenty of responsibility♪
Speech.触れないようにしてたけど、この格好いろいろ際どすぎない……？ でもあえて%use: I was trying not to touch on it, but isn't this outfit way too revealing...? But if I intentionally show off to %usernameusernameuserna% to get words of gratitude—Wait, wouldn't that just make me a exhibitionist!
Speech.クララさんがライバルかぁ……でもいっそのこと３人でってのも――いや、それは逃げね: Clara-san is my rival, huh... But maybe all three of us together would—No, that's running away. ...Hm, what am I talking about? I-I-It's nothing at all!!
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……？ ん？ 反応なし……？: %usernameusernameuserna%-san...? Hm? No response...? Could you be sleeping? When I went out of my way to wear such a cute outfit... That's unbelievable...!
Speech.ふふ、誕生日おめでとう。あなたから特大の感謝の言葉をもらうには、どんなプレゼント: Fufu, Happy Birthday. To get an extra-large word of thanks from you, what kind of present would be best? Look forward to Santa Senka's present.
Speech.あけましておめでとう、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。 …: Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. ...Eh? You feel left behind? It's fine, I ended up liking this outfit.
Speech.プレゼントって意味では、サンタ衣装も合ってるわね……あ、いま私のチョコ受け取った: In terms of giving presents, a Santa outfit fits well... Ah, you just took my chocolate, didn't you? Fufu, since you accepted it, I expect a triple return gift, alright? It's bite-sized, but high quality.
Speech.なっ……３倍返しを要求したけど、まさかあげたチョコの３倍の重さのマカロンを用意す: Wha... I demanded a triple return, but to think you'd prepare macarons three times the weight of the chocolate I gave... I was outsmarted... I should have specified the price... Well, presents aren't about the price, though.
Speech.ん……？ エイプリルフールだし、感謝するからあなたのこと格好いいって言ってほしい: Hm...? Since it's April Fools' Day and you'd be thankful, you want me to say you're handsome...? Why are you saying something so sad... Well, I could say the opposite for you, though.
Speech.結婚するならクリスマスのほうが良くないかしら？ なんだかロマンチックだし、お互い: If you get married, wouldn't Christmas be better? It feels romantic, like gifting yourselves to each other, right? What do you think, %usernameusernameuserna%-san?
Speech.サンタって願う側というよりある種願われる側だから、今回はあなたの願いを聞くべきか: Santa is more on the receiving end of wishes rather than making them, so should I listen to your wish this time? Ah, weird wishes are forbidden! W-Well... if it's only in front of me, maybe...
Speech.コスプレって意味では、この時期にぴったりな衣装なのよね。これでお菓子でも配り歩い: In terms of cosplay, this costume is perfect for this season. Maybe I'll walk around handing out treats and collect gratitude from everyone.
Speech.メリ～クリスマ～ス！ 思えばサンタってどうしてプレゼントを配るのかしら……もしか: Merry Christmas~! Thinking about it, why does Santa hand out presents... Could it be that, like me, he wants to be thanked? ...Eh? Don't lump him together with you...? How rude.
Speech.誕生日祝ってくれるの？ ……なに？ 『いつもありがとう』？ うぅ……あ、あなたか: You're celebrating my birthday? ...What? 'Thank you for everything'? Ugh... Hearing that from you... hits deeper than receiving some random item...
Speech.まだ降るのかしら……|不思議とぽかぽかしてて、全然寒くないのよね……なんでかしら: I wonder if it'll keep snowing...|Strangely, I feel warm and not cold at all... I wonder why, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.

Speech.くっ……演習の成績で他の子に負けちゃうなんて……このままじゃ絶対にいられないわ！: Kuh... Losing to other girls in drill results... I can't stay like this! I don't want to lose next time, so it's time for special training!
Speech.私のお父さんは貴族だったのよ。今でこそ、爵位は返上しちゃったんだけど……いつか、: My father was a noble. Though he surrendered his title now... Someday, I plan to start a company carrying his name and show everyone who doubted us!
Speech.……はぁ、なんで素直になれないんだろ……あいつ、もっと可愛げのある子が好きなのか: ...*Sigh*, why can't I just be honest... I wonder if he likes girls who are more cute and agreeable...?
Speech.えっ、あんた誕生日なの！？ ……え、えっと、お祝いの準備してないわね……きょ、今: Eh, it's your birthday!? ...U-Um, I didn't prepare any celebration... F-For today only, I'll do whatever you ask! I won't go back on my word!
Speech.新年ね……私のところではあんまりお祝いとかしないのよね。ま、まあ、あんたがお祝い: New Year's, huh... We don't celebrate much back home. W-Well, if you say we should celebrate, I guess I wouldn't mind?
Speech.……こ、これ！ バレンタインチョコ！カードでもよかったけど……な、何も言わずに受: ...H-Here! Valentine's chocolate! A card would've been fine too, but... J-Just accept it without saying anything!

Speech.大好き！ 本当はあなたの事、大好き！ 私と付き合って欲しいの！……ふぅ、嘘だから: I love you! Honestly, I love you so much! I want you to go out with me! ...Phew, that was a lie! April Fools'! ...I-It really was a lie, okay!?
Speech.私の実家ってちゃんとしたところだから、結婚するなら盛大にやらないとね。それこそ、: My family comes from a proper background, so if I get married, it'll have to be grand. Gorgeous decorations and tons of guests will be necessary...!
Speech.願い事ね……うーん、何がいいかしら？……もっと正々堂々勝てるように、強くなれます: A wish, huh... Hmm, what would be good? ...May I become stronger so I can win fair and square...!

Speech.えっ、あんたが私の、た、誕生日のお祝いをしてくれるの！？その、えっと……うぅ……: Eh, you're going to celebrate my b-birthday!? Um, er... ugh... th-thanks... um, I'm really happy...
Speech.んん……ちょっと、やめて……|そんな、イタズラ……むにゃ、したら……怒るわよ……: Nn... hey, stop it...|If you play... *mumble*... a trick like that... I'll get mad... *sleepy breathing*...

Speech.練習で作ったあまたのケーキ、さすがに捨てるわけにもいかないから、最近３食の食事が: I can't just throw away the countless cakes I made for practice, so lately all three of my meals have been cake... Maybe I should distribute them to everyone in Colorful Boquet too...
Speech.ちょ、ちょっと%usernameusernameuserna%！ 今胸元ちらっと: H-Hey, %usernameusernameuserna%! You just glanced at my chest, didn't you! If you look again, I'll sew your eyes shut! ...W-Well, if it's only me you're looking at, I might forgive you...
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%？ もしかして寝てる……？ ふふ: %usernameusernameuserna%? Could you be sleeping...? Fufu, maybe I should write 'Merry Christmas' in permanent marker on that silly sleeping face of yours.

Speech.あけましておめでとう。……え？ もう正月なのに、まだサンタの衣装を着ているのかっ: Happy New Year. ...Eh? Why am I still wearing a Santa costume when it's already New Year's? That's... because I thought you'd be happy... Wait! It's nothing!

Speech.ジューンブライドねぇ……私もまあ、そういうのに興味がないわけじゃないけど……肝心: June brides, huh... It's not like I'm completely uninterested in that sort of thing, but... the person who matters doesn't notice my feelings at all.
Speech.願い事ねぇ……思ったんだけど、そういうのって自分の力で叶えてこそ価値があると思う: Wishes, huh... I was thinking, those things only have value if you fulfill them with your own strength. So I won't rely on making wishes. What I want, I'll get with my own hands!
Speech.ハッピーハロウィーン！ なんか一周回ってこのサンタ服が違和感なくなるわね……しょ: Happy Halloween! Somehow, after a full circle, this Santa outfit doesn't feel weird anymore... Guess since I'm Santa, I'll walk around giving out treats. Ah, there's a portion for you too, of course...
Speech.メリークリスマス、%usernameusernameuserna%！ クリスマス: Merry Christmas, %usernameusernameuserna%! We're having a Christmas party, so make sure you attend! We're doing a present exchange too, so prepare something! Got it!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……？ あ、ありがと。プレゼントはそうね……ふたりの思い出に……: Happy birthday...? Th-Thanks. As for a present... for our memories together... Ugh, n-never mind!!
Speech.たくさん入ってそうね……|なんだか開けてしまうのがもったいないかも……: Looks like there's a lot inside...|It feels almost like a waste to open it...

Speech.クリスマスなのに、サンタでもトナカイでもなく、ウサギって……しかも露出度も高すぎ: Even though it's Christmas, not Santa, not a reindeer, but a rabbit... Plus, it's way too revealing. If I step outside wearing this, I'll catch a cold instantly.
Speech.誕生日のお祝い、ありがとうございます。どうして私は自分の生まれた記念すべき日に、: Thank you for the birthday wishes. Why on earth am I dressed like this on the memorable day of my birth...
Speech.あっ……！ もう！|どこ見てるんですか……！ というか、私のなんか見ても、楽しく: Ah...! Geez!|Where are you looking...! I mean, looking at someone like me isn't fun or anything, is it?
Speech.あちこち際どすぎます……|どんな思考回路をしていたら、こんないろいろ危ない衣装を: It's way too risky all over...|What kind of thought process leads someone to come up with such a dangerous outfit...
Speech.すごく視線を感じます……|この服着てシティを歩いたら、確実に風紀委員会に目をつけ: I feel so many eyes on me...|If I walked through the City in this outfit, the Disciplinary Committee would definitely lock their eyes on me...
Speech.私の実家は茶道の宗家ですから、少しだけお茶やアマツの文化には詳しいのです。もしよ: My family is the head house of tea ceremony, so I am a bit familiar with tea and Amatsu culture. If you'd like, shall we discuss various aspects of Amatsu culture together?
Speech.お茶菓子は好きですが、甘すぎるものは実は苦手で……以前にリバティのケーキを食べた: I like tea sweets, but I'm actually not good with things that are overly sweet... Previously, I ate a cake from Liberty, but it was so sweet that I got a headache...
Speech.私は紫雲家の跡継ぎとして、恥じない自分であるように律してきました。だからでしょう: As the successor to the Shiun family, I have disciplined myself to be someone without shame. Perhaps because of that... occasionally, I feel a desire to become a version of myself that isn't this way.
Speech.……そういえば、カオスメイデンの皆さんとお茶の約束をしていましたね。ふふ、ユリア: ...Come to think of it, I promised to have tea with everyone from Chaos Maiden. Fufu, I wonder what kind of tea sweets I should treat Julia and the others to.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。言葉だけではなく贈り物をしたいのですが……もしよけ: Happy Birthday. I want to give you a gift rather than just words... If you'd like, shall we go shopping together after this?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。一年の計は元旦にありといいます。ご一緒に一年の抱: Happy New Year. They say the plan for the year is made on New Year's Day. Why don't we decide our New Year's resolutions together?
Speech.こちら、お饅頭です。……その、チョコレートが売り切れていて……いつも食べている和: Here are some manju. ...Um, the chocolates were sold out... It's the usual Japanese sweets I eat, but will this convey my feelings?
Speech.私にバレンタインデーのお返しを？……ふふ、とても嬉しいです。お茶を点てるのでご一: A White Day return gift for me?... Fufu, I'm very happy. I'll brew some tea, so how about enjoying it together?
Speech.実は……今から実家に帰って家元として茶道の道に戻るつもりなのです。ふふ、嘘です。: Actually... I plan to return home now and go back to the path of the tea ceremony as the grand master. Fufu, that was a lie. Since coming to this academy, I've learned to have a playful side like this too♪
Speech.私はどちらかといえば洋風の結婚式よりも、白無垢が良いですね。……ですが、確かにド: If I had to choose, I would prefer a white traditional wedding kimono (shiromuku) over a Western-style wedding. ...However, I do feel like I'd want to wear a dress too... This is a deeper dilemma than I thought.
Speech.願い事をする日ですか……私の願い事は、スカラに茶道文化が広まる事です。ですが、叶: Is today a day for making wishes...? My wish is for tea ceremony culture to spread across Scalar. But taking the first step is necessary to make it happen. I must steadily pass it on as well.
Speech.今日はお化けの仮装をして、お菓子をねだる日だと聞いています。……無理やり強奪……: I heard today is a day to dress up as ghosts and beg for treats. ...Forcibly extorting them... I feel like acting like a child for just a bit... Eh? You don't extort them?
Speech.メリークリスマスです。ふふ、こういうお祝い事は楽しみませんとね。ユリアさん達が楽: Merry Christmas. Fufu, we must enjoy celebrations like this. Julia and the others are looking forward to it, and actually, I am looking forward to it too.
Speech.私の誕生日を覚えてくださっていたのですか？ふふ、ありがとうございます。思わず、飛: You remembered my birthday? Fufu, thank you very much. I'm so happy I feel like jumping for joy...
Speech.……退屈ではありませんか？|ふふ、静かに待つのもいいですが……こうして会話を楽し: ...Are you bored?|Fufu, waiting quietly is nice too, but... enjoying conversation like this is the true charm of tea time, you know?
Speech.……照れてしまいますね。|家族以外の男の方を前にするのは、初めてですから……緊張: ...I feel embarrassed.|Being in front of a man outside my family is a first for me, so... I feel nervous.
Speech.……どこを見ているのですか？|……あまりジロジロとみられると恥ずかしいので……そ: ...Where are you looking?|...It's embarrassing if you stare so intently... so, um, don't look too much, okay?
Speech.紫雲家の跡取りとして、このような破廉恥な格好をするのはいかがなものかと思うのです: As the heir to the Shiun family, I wonder if it's appropriate to wear such a scandalous outfit... Fufu, but the sense of immorality from doing something naughty makes my heart pound.
Speech.知っていますか？ ウサギってとても繁殖能力が高いんです。それと基本草食動物ですが: Did you know? Rabbits have very high reproductive capabilities. Also, while they are basically herbivores, they apparently consume meat sometimes too. Not that it means anything, though... Fufufu.
Speech.普段は自分を厳しく律していますが、この服を着ていると、違う自分になれたような気が: Normally, I strictly discipline myself, but when wearing this outfit, I feel as though I can become a different person... I feel driven by the impulse to act more intensely and freely.
Speech.この服のまま放置されると、色々な意味で昂りそうですね……ふふ、私をこんな姿にして: If I'm left alone in this outfit, I feel like I'll get excited in various ways... Fufu, leaving me like this after putting me in this state, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, you really are quite mean.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。え？ プレゼントに今日一日この格好でいてほしい？: Happy Birthday. Eh? As a present, you want me to stay in this outfit all day today? Fufu, understood. Then I shall serve by your side in this attire. It feels like doing something naughty.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。新年からバニー姿でご挨拶することになるとは……紫: Happy New Year. To think I would be giving greetings in a bunny suit right at the start of the new year... It's shameful as a member of the Shiun family, but this sense of liberation is becoming somewhat addictive...
Speech.バレンタインの贈り物です。バニーで渡すようにとアニスさんに言われまして……ふふ、: Here is a Valentine's gift. Anise told me to hand it over as a bunny... Fufu, are your eyes glued to me rather than the chocolate? I'm both happy and embarrassed.
Speech.お返し、ありがとうございます。バニーに合うお茶菓子はなんでしょうか？ バニー姿で: Thank you for the return gift. I wonder what tea sweet goes well with a bunny suit? Brewing tea in a bunny outfit is unprecedented, but... fufu, I feel like trying to challenge it a bit.
Speech.実は私、実家を飛び出してバニーガールとして生きていくことに決めたのです。……ふふ: Actually, I've decided to run away from home and live as a bunny girl. ...Fufu, that was a lie. But running across the battlefield in this outfit feels so liberating... and quite exciting.
Speech.結婚式ですか。純白のドレスも素敵ですが、いっそこの衣装の上にウェディングベールを: A wedding? A pure white dress is wonderful, but how about putting a wedding veil right over this outfit? ...Just kidding. But my heart gets a little excited thinking about it.
Speech.短冊にどんな願いを書いたのか……ですか？ ふふ……ではヒントを。%usernam: What wish did I write on the paper strip...? Fufu... Here is a hint then. Your name, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, is written on it. And perhaps the rest of the team made a similar wish too.
Speech.ハッピーハロウィン。仮装ということでこの服をカオスメイデンの皆で着てますが……や: Happy Halloween. We in Chaos Maiden are wearing this outfit as a costume, but... it really is very revealing. Still, this breezy feeling... somehow feels addicting.
Speech.メリークリスマス。サンタの衣装だと思ってユリアさんから受け取ったら、バニーでした: Merry Christmas. I received this from Julia thinking it was a Santa costume, but it was a bunny suit. ...However, to liven up Christmas, I will fulfill this role in this outfit with all my might.
Speech.私のお誕生日をお祝いしてくださるのですか？ ありがとうございます。……ふふ、こん: Are you celebrating my birthday? Thank you very much. ...Fufu, I never thought I would welcome my birthday in an outfit like this, but this makes a good memory in its own way.
Speech.誘惑が……|ダメだとわかっているのに、シたくなっちゃいます……！: Temptation...|Even though I know I shouldn't, I end up wanting to do it...!
Speech.ハァ……ハァ……！|１回だけ……１回だけ、ここでシてもいいですか？ %usern: *Haah*... *haah*...!|Just once... can I do it here just once? %usernameusernameuserna%-san...
Speech.あぁ……ヤりたい……|紫雲家の人間がギャンブルに魅了されるなんて……でも、昂るの: Ah... I want to play...|To think a member of the Shiun family would be captivated by gambling... But I can't suppress the excitement...
Speech.飴でも、舐める？演技をするときに、喉は大切だから喉飴は欠かさないようにしてるの。: Want to suck on a candy? Throat candy is essential when acting because the throat is important, so I never run out of them.
Speech.わたしは元々役者をしてた。自分にない、色んな感情や人を演じるのは楽しい。もしも演: I used to be an actor. Acting out various emotions and people that I don't possess myself is fun. If you want to see an acting performance, shall I do something for you?
Speech.……あんまり自分で決めるのは好きじゃない。演技をするなら、決める事は出来るけどわ: ...I don't really like deciding things myself. If it's acting, I can decide, but making decisions as myself might be something I'm bad at.
Speech.……ぼーっ…………今日は……何をしよう……: ...*Staring blankly*... Today... what should I do...
Speech.誕生日なんだね。おめでとう……演技じゃない、素のわたしからのお祝いだよ。: It's your birthday, right? Happy birthday... This isn't an act, it's a celebration from my genuine self.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。新年になると、皆の楽しい感情を見れて面白い。演技の参考にな: Happy New Year. When the new year comes, seeing everyone's happy emotions is interesting. It serves as a good reference for acting.
Speech.別にあんたのことが好きだから渡すわけじゃないんだからね！ 義理だから！……素直に: It's not like I'm giving this to you because I like you or anything! It's just out of obligation! ...How was my acting as a girl who can't be honest?
Speech.あ、ありがとうございます……こんな私に、お礼だなんて……！……気弱な女の子の演技: Th-Thank you very much... Expressing thanks to someone like me...! ...That was an act of a timid girl. Thank you for the return gift.
Speech.嘘……演技をするのはある意味嘘と言えるかも？……でも、そうしたら普段から嘘を吐い: Lies... Could acting be called lying in a sense? ...But if so, does that mean I'm lying normally all the time... Hmm, complicated.
Speech.ふふ……こんな素敵なドレスを着て、結婚できるなんて幸せ……結婚式で感動してる人の: Fufu... To wear such a lovely dress and get married is pure bliss... That was an act of a person moved by a wedding ceremony. Someday, I'd like to experience it myself.
Speech.願い事……わたしだけの感情が、いっぱい見つかりますように。それと、役者として復帰: My wish... May I find plenty of emotions that belong solely to me. Also, when I return as an actor, may I perform many different roles...
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ お返しくれないとイタズラしちゃうぞ！ お菓子をよこせー！: Trick or treat! If you don't give me a treat, I'll play a trick on you! Hand over the sweets~! ...That was an act of a kid on Halloween. So, will you give me treats?
Speech.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。さて、クリスマスはいい子にしておったかな？ ……サンタさんの演: Ho ho ho. Now then, have you been a good kid this Christmas? ...An act of Santa Claus. So, do you want a present?
Speech.誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ ……ありがとう。演技をせずにお礼を言いたかったけど: You're celebrating my birthday? ...Thank you. I wanted to thank you without acting, but... I didn't know what the right reaction was.
Speech.ぴょん！ ……ぷー！ ぷー！|……喜んでる時のウサギの演技。嬉しい時はこういう感: *Hop!* ...*Poo! Poo!*|...Acting like a happy rabbit. When they're happy, they make joyful squeaks like this to express delight.
Speech.んっ……？ くあぁ……|興味を惹かれてない時のウサギの演技。実際に触った時は、こ: Nn...? *Yawn*...|Acting like an uninterested rabbit. When I actually petted one, it gave a reaction like this.
Speech.ぴょん！？ ふーっ！|……怒ってる時のウサギの反応。地面を足で叩いて不機嫌な反応: *Hop!? Foo!*|...An angry rabbit's reaction. They stamp the ground with their feet when displeased, so pet them gently, okay?
Speech.この浴衣、胸元結構きつい……でもこれ以上サイズがないって言われて……でもわりと着: This yukata is pretty tight around the chest... but they said there aren't any bigger sizes... Still, it's pretty easy to wear so it's not bad... and Suiran dresses me in it. Huh... then that's no different from my everyday clothes...
Speech.一応この浴衣でもＭＧには乗れるって聞いた。そういう特別製……？ なんだって。あま: I heard I can still pilot an MG even in this yukata. It's specially made or something...? Though it'll slip off if I move too vigorously.
Speech.わたしはユリアみたいに何でもすぐ見つける子が羨ましい……%usernameuse: I envy girls like Julia who can find anything right away... %usernameusernameuserna%, do you like people like Julia? ...On second thought, don't answer.
Speech.……ぼーっ…… ……今日は…………%usernameusernameuserna: ...*Staring blankly*... Today... I might want to go to a hot spring with %usernameusernameuserna%...
Speech.誕生日……何かほしいものある？ %usernameusernameuserna%: Birthday... Is there anything you want? I want %usernameusernameuserna% to smile... but I don't know what gift would make you smile the most... Even though I want to make you smile.
Speech.正月って……みんなアマツの服着てるから、ずっと浴衣のままでもいいと思う……って言: During New Year's... since everyone wears Amatsu clothing, I thought it'd be fine to just stay in a yukata all the time... but when I said that, Suiran got mad at me.
Speech.はぁい、僕くん、ママからのチョコレートよ～？ 僕くんはかっこよくてモテモテだから: Hiii, my little boy, here's chocolate from Mama~ You're so handsome and popular, so maybe you don't need chocolate from your mother? ...How was my acting as a mother giving chocolate to her son?
Speech.あらまぁ、お婆ちゃんにホワイトデーのマカロンくれるのかのう？ 僕ちゃんはハンサム: My oh my, giving White Day macarons to grandma? You're such a handsome boy, so you must have a hard time returning gifts to all those girls. ...I tried acting like a grandma receiving macarons from her grandson.
Speech.わたし、今はいてないよ……じゃなかった。嘘を言うなら、『今はいてるよ』になる……: I'm not wearing underwear right now... Wait, no. If I were lying, it would be 'I AM wearing it right now'... Hemp...? %usernameusernameuserna%, why do you have a surprised face... Did something happen?
Speech.その結婚待ったぁああ！ 変な男と政略結婚するくらいなら、その花嫁はこの俺がもらい: Hold that wedding right there! Rather than letting her enter a political marriage with a weird guy, I'll take that bride for myself! ...That was an act of a shonen manga protagonist trying to stop the heroine's political marriage... Was it hard to tell?
Speech.願い事……やりたいことを見つける……でもたぶん、願わなくても、%username: A wish... finding something I want to do... But maybe even without wishing, I'll find it as long as I'm with %usernameusernameuserna% and everyone in Chaos Maiden...
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート？ お菓子ほしいの？ なら……ちょうどいい季節だから、ふ: Trick or treat? You want treats? Then... since it's the right season, shall the two of us go buy hot spring manju? Actually, I'm already prepared.
Speech.グゥォッ、ブォ、ブォッ、ヴオォ！ ……え？ なにしてるのかって？ トナカイの演技: *Gwoh, buh, buh, vuoh!* ...Eh? What am I doing? Acting like a reindeer... By the way, I said 'Want to go to the hot springs?'. ...It wasn't a fart.
Speech.誕生日……？ そうだった……時間が経つのは早い。今年は少しほしいと思うものがある: My birthday...? That's right... time flies fast. I might have something I want a little bit this year. That is... time spent with %usernameusernameuserna%.
Speech.ねむたい……|ずっと温泉に浸かっていると、ぽかぽかして……眠たくなってくる……一: Sleepy...|Soaking in the hot springs for a long time makes me feel warm and... sleepy... Want to sleep together?
Speech.ちょっと暑くなってきた。|%usernameusernameuserna%も暑い: It's gotten a bit hot.|Are you hot too, %usernameusernameuserna%? I'll fan you, so come over here.
Speech.何を見ているの……？|景色……？ わたしと見ることに意味がある……？ それは……: What are you looking at...?|The scenery...? There's meaning in looking at it with me...? That... I might understand a little bit.
Speech.あたしの好きなもの？ ロリータ寄りのゴスロリとか可愛くて良いわよね♪方向性が違う: Things I like? Lolita-style Gothic Lolita is cute and nice, right?♪ I dislike things with different aesthetics because they're a bit scary. Skulls and stuff aren't cute.
Speech.ふふ、%usernameusernameuserna%のことはとーっても好きよ♪: Fufu, I like %usernameusernameuserna% VERY much♪ Your expression changes constantly from my words and actions, showing me all sorts of faces♪
Speech.駆け引きをするタイプのゲームは得意なのよ♪トランプだったり、ボードゲームだったり: I'm good at tactical games♪ Card games, board games... Fufu, want to play a round?
Speech.……もう、こんな放置をするだなんて……ふふ、つまりはイタズラをしてほしいってこと: ...Geez, leaving me ignored like this... Fufu, which means you want me to play a trick on you, right? What should I do...♪
Speech.あなたのお誕生日なのよね？ おめでとう♪それで、何をしてほしい？ ふふ、望むこと: It's your birthday, right? Happy birthday♪ So, what do you want me to do? Fufu, feel free to pitch whatever you desire to me...♪
Speech.あけましておめでとう。ふふ、新年最初に挨拶をしてくれるなんて愛よね♪……あたしが: Happy New Year. Fufu, greeting me first in the new year is pure love, right?♪ ...You're not going to say I wasn't the first, right?
Speech.当然、あたしからの愛情たっぷりのチョコレートをあげるわ。え？ 何チョコレートなの: Naturally, I'll give you chocolate packed with my affection. Eh? What kind of chocolate is it? ...Fufu, what do you think? Try it and see♪
Speech.あら、お返しをくれるの？ありがとう……普通のクッキーなのね。ちょっとがっかり……: My, giving me a return gift? Thank you... Plain cookies, huh. A little disappointed... You know you can pour more love into it!
Speech.実はカオスメイデンから首になっちゃったの……ねえ、新しいチームを一緒に探してくれ: Actually, I got kicked out of Chaos Maiden... Hey, won't you help me find a new team? ...Fufu, just kidding, it's April Fools' Day♪ I'm going to tell plenty more lies, okay?
Speech.あたし、結婚式に興味があるの。色んな人から祝福されて結婚して……その後に、どんな: I'm interested in weddings. Getting married while being blessed by everyone... and after that, what kind of terrible thing could I do to feel the most love?
Speech.お願いごとね……ふふ、それならずっと愛を感じられますようにってお願いするわ。絶対: A wish... Fufu, then I'll wish that I can feel love forever. I wish there were an eternal love that would never ever change.
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ ふふ、お菓子はいらないわ……それよりも、イタズラしちゃっ: Trick or treat! Fufu, I don't need sweets... More importantly, it's fine if I play a trick on you, right? That's much more wonderful than candy♪
Speech.メリークリスマス♪ ふふ、クリスマスパーティーはカオスメイデンでもお祝いをするつ: Merry Christmas♪ Fufu, I plan to celebrate the Christmas party with Chaos Maiden too♪ ...I'll get genuinely yelled at today, so I won't play tricks. Really!
Speech.……えっ、あたしを祝ってくれるの？ プレゼントもある？あ、ありがとう……嬉しいわ: ...Eh, you're celebrating for me? There's a present too? Th-Thank you... I'm happy... Um, er... Ah, this is throwing off my rhythm...!
Speech.……あーん、ふふっ。|とっても美味しいわ、このパフェ♪ もしかして怒った？ なら: ...*Ahhn*, fufu. | This parfait is delicious♪ Did you get mad by any chance? Then you can get back at me, you know♪
Speech.これ……食べないの？|もしかしてあたしの顔についているの？ ……違うみたいね。も: This... you're not eating it?|Is there something on my face by any chance? ...Doesn't seem like it. Geez, tell me the reason.
Speech.……もしかして欲しいの？ はい。|そんなに物欲しそうな顔されたらからかえないわ。: ...Do you want it by any chance? Here.|If you make such a longing face, I can't tease you. So, was it delicious? That's good then♪
Speech.学園生活は平和すぎて退屈だけど、メイズは面白い。自分がどこまで出来るのか……そん: Academy life is too peaceful and boring, but the Maze is interesting. Because I can challenge my limits to see how far I can go.
Speech.今まで私はずっと山で育ってきた。だから、こういう場所で暮らすのはまだ違和感がある: I've grown up in the mountains until now. So living in a place like this still feels unnatural. If you're interested, want to try wilderness survival in the mountains with me?
Speech.ネイルガンは、私の父さんの形見。だから、いつだって使えるように改造して大切にして: This nail gun is a keepsake from my father. That's why I modified and cherished it so it can be used anytime. Not only can it be used as a weapon, but also as a tool for building bases... Or is it the other way around?
Speech.……ネイルガン、良し。コート、良し。体調、万全。よし。いつでも狩りにいける。: ...Nail gun, ready. Coat, ready. Physical condition, perfect. Alright. Ready to go hunting anytime.
Speech.誕生日なの？ おめでとう。お祝い……何か美味しい動物を狩ってくる。期待して待って: Is it your birthday? Happy birthday. Celebration... I'll hunt some delicious animal for you. Look forward to it.

Speech.すごい……ぜーんぶ雪よ！|これだったら、雪を使ってお城だって作れちゃうかも……！: Amazing... it's ALL snow!|With this, we could even build a castle using snow...!
Speech.……へ、へ……へくちっ！ ずず……|さすがに雪の上だとちょっと寒いのかも……でも: ...A-A... Achoo! *Sniffle*...|As expected, standing on snow might be a bit cold... But it's fun so I don't want to leave...

Speech.ひゃあああああああ！？ む、虫！？ご、ごめんなさい……虫だけはダメなの……こ、腰: Hyaaaaaaa!? B-Bugs!? S-Sorry... I really can't handle bugs... M-My legs gave out... H-Help me...
Speech.ふんふふーん♪ …あ、聞かれちゃった？実は私、歌うのが好きなのよね♪ 一緒に歌っ: Hum-hum-hum~♪ ...Ah, did you hear me? Actually I love singing♪ Want to try singing together?
Speech.私、誰かのために動くのが好きなの。……ただ、ドジをして逆にお世話をかけちゃうこと: I like acting for someone else's sake. ...Although I often mess up and end up causing trouble instead...
Speech.皆が戻ってくるまでに、お料理でもしちゃおうかしら？でも、ついつい楽しくなって作り: Should I do some cooking before everyone returns? But I end up having so much fun that I make way too much...
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ 実は誕生日って聞いたから、特製ケーキを作ったの！色んな人を: Happy Birthday! Since I heard it was your birthday, I made a special cake! Let's invite all kinds of people and celebrate together♪
Speech.あけましておめでとう！新年だから、張り切っておせち料理を作ってみたの！ 食べてみ: Happy New Year! Since it's the new year, I eagerly made osechi dishes! Won't you try some?
Speech.バレンタインだから、手作りチョコを作って色んな子に配ってるの。……君にあげるのは: Since it's Valentine's, I made handmade chocolates to distribute to various girls. ...The one I'm giving you is wrapped differently from the other girls', okay♪
Speech.えっ、私にお返しをくれるの？ あ、ありがとう！凄く嬉しいわ。大切に取っておくから: Eh, giving me a return gift? Th-Thank you! I'm so happy. I'll cherish it carefully... Eh, since it's sweets, eat it?
Speech.エイプリルフール？ ううん……私、人に嘘をつくのは苦手だから……折角だから、君の: April Fools' Day? No... I'm bad at lying to people, so... Since it's a special day, I'd like to hear your lie. Try telling me a lie!
Speech.結婚かぁ……私のお父さんとお母さんみたいな幸せな家庭を作るの。子供はそうだなぁ…: Marriage, huh... Building a happy family like my mother and father. As for children, let's see... I want enough to hold a sports tournament♪
Speech.どんなお願い事をしたの？ 私はドジをしないようにってお願いしたわ♪え？ でも短冊: What kind of wish did you make? I wished not to make clumsy mistakes♪ Eh? 'You didn't hang the paper strip...?' Ah, I-I forgot...
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ お菓子の準備は万全よ！ はい、君にもどうぞ。ふふ、ジュリ: Trick or treat! Candy preparations are complete! Here, one for you too. Fufu, I'm going around giving them out to Julie-chan and the juniors... Eh? I'm doing Halloween wrong?
Speech.メリークリスマス！ ふふ、いい子にしてたらサンタさんが来るからね！……関係ないけ: Merry Christmas! Fufu, Santa Claus comes to good children! ...Unrelated, but is there any present you want?
Speech.えっ、私の誕生日？ ……お祝いをしてくれて嬉しいわ♪じゃあ、一緒にご飯を食べまし: Eh, my birthday? ...I'm happy you're celebrating it♪ Then let's eat together. I'll cook! ...Eh? That's not how it works?
Speech.色々勉強中なの！ 今度はどこに出かけるにしても、私がテントを作ったり、みんなの事: I'm studying various things! Next time we go out anywhere, I need to make sure I can set up tents and support everyone...!
Speech.みんなで雪山に行くための服を悩むの、とっても楽しかったわ♪……ただ、ちょっとだけ: Pondering over clothes for everyone to go to the snow mountain was so much fun♪ ...Though my wallet got pretty cold since it was a bit pricey...
Speech.雪山のピンチも乗り越えて……もう、次はどこに行くにしても覚悟は出来てるわ！たとえ: Overcoming the snow mountain crisis... now I'm prepared wherever we go next! Whether it's snow mountains or underwater... Ah, but places with ghosts and bugs are impossible...
Speech.はぁ……この服、温かいわ……今度雪山に行くとき以外にも、この服を着てお出かけしち: Haa... these clothes are warm... Maybe I'll wear them out when going out other than snow mountains next time... But as expected, it might be too hot...?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう♪ ふふ、もしよかったら、今度はふたりで一緒に山登りデートでも: Happy Birthday♪ Fufu, if you'd like, shall the two of us go on a mountain-climbing date next time?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。ふふ、とっても温かいから、暗い時間からこの格好で: Happy New Year. Fufu, since it's very warm, I can even prepare to watch the first sunrise in this outfit from early morning♪
Speech.ええっと……その、チョコレートを持ってきたの！ ほ、ほら、山登りには良いっていう: Umm... well, I brought chocolate! S-See, they say it's good for mountain climbing... and today is Valentine's Day... It's handmade. Will you accept it...?
Speech.えっ、お菓子？ ふふ、ありがとう。これでみんなでお茶をしましょうか♪……え？ ホ: Eh, sweets? Fufu, thank you. Shall we all have tea with this♪ ...Eh? A White Day return gift... In that case... shall we eat it with just the two of us?
Speech.うう……エイプリルフールの嘘、いっつも騙されちゃうの……明日は山で授業をするって: Ugh... I always get tricked by April Fools' lies... I was told class tomorrow would be on the mountain, but my friends were in normal clothes...
Speech.結婚の時のドレスも素敵だけど……二人でこの格好で山に登って、サラッと結婚して欲し: A wedding dress is wonderful too, but... climbing the mountain together in these clothes and being casually asked to marry sounds wonderful too, I think.
Speech.ふふ、お願いはもちろん、プレ・クラスーAの皆が元気で幸せでいられますように……♪: Fufu, my wish is naturally 'May everyone in Pre-Class A stay healthy and happy...♪' I have to work hard for the formal team promotion!
Speech.ふふ、ちゃんとハロウィンのためのお菓子は準備してきたわ♪ちょっと登山向けのカロリ: Fufu, I properly prepared treats for Halloween♪ Though they're mostly high-calorie snacks meant for mountain climbing...
Speech.もこもこした、この可愛い服だとホワイトクリスマスも外で楽しめて素敵ね♪: With these fluffy, cute clothes, enjoying a white Christmas outdoors is lovely♪
Speech.えっ、私の誕生日のお祝い……？ 本当に良いのかしら？ふふ、ありがとうね。ふたりで: Eh, my birthday celebration...? Is it really okay? Fufu, thank you. Shall the two of us celebrate grandly♪
Speech.んん……気持ちいい……|サウナは、やっぱり熱い方が気持ちいいよね……そう思わない: Mmm... feels so good...|Saunas really feel better when they're hot... Don't you think so?
Speech.……え、きゃあっ！？|も、もしかして見えちゃってた……？ うう、恥ずかしい……: ...Eh, kyaa!?|C-Could it be that you saw...? Ugh, embarrassing...

Speech.……ふぅ……トレーニングはこのくらいかな……次はマニュアルの１２０ページ……: ...Phew... that's about enough for training... Next is page 120 of the manual...
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……この程度なら、覚えてるわ。: Happy Birthday... Something like this, I remember.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。……何？ 新年でもやることは変わらないから。: Happy New Year. ...What? What I do doesn't change even in the new year.
Speech.チョコ、あげる。お世話になってるから。ちゃんとカカオ99％。糖質が低いのを選んだ: Here's chocolate. Because you take care of me. It's properly 99% cacao. I picked one low in sugar.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？……あ、ありがと。: A White Day return gift?... Th-Thanks.
Speech.嘘なんてつく暇はないから。……騙したら怒るから。: I don't have time to lie. ...If you trick me, I'll be angry.

Speech.誕生日のお祝い……？ ……ありがと。……まあ、祝ってくれるのは嬉しいかも。: Birthday celebration...? ...Thanks. ...Well, having you celebrate it might feel nice.
Speech.この体操服を着てると、陸上で現役だった時を思い出すわ。……あんまり悲しい顔をしな: Wearing this gym uniform reminds me of my active track days. ...Don't make such a sad face. The past is past... right now is fun too.
Speech.……こうして団体競技をすることは少なかったから……少しだけ、楽しいわ。自分が今ま: ...Since I rarely did team sports like this... it's a little bit fun. I can also utilize the knowledge I've accumulated so far.

Speech.……誕生日を祝ってくれるの？ ふふ、ありがとう。折角の誕生日だし、ウォーキングく: ...You're celebrating my birthday? Fufu, thank you. Since it's a special birthday and walking is manageable... want to take a walk together?
Speech.……うん、腫れは引いてきたわね。|無理はしちゃダメよ。あとは痛みがなくなるまで安: ...Yup, the swelling has gone down.|Don't overdo it. Rest until the pain goes away, okay?
Speech.きゃっ！？ ……詰まってたかしら。|皆が怪我をしないで元気だから、使うのが久々だ: Kya!? ...Was it clogged?|Since everyone is healthy without injury, it's been a while since I used it... don't look too much.
Speech.……大丈夫？ 痛くはないかしら？|私も何度も経験したから怪我が辛いのは分かるわ…: ...Are you okay? Is it painful?|I've experienced it many times so I know injuries are tough... so tell me properly, okay.
Speech.さーて、今日はどこを食べ歩きしようかなー。もう、この周辺のお店は全部食べちゃった: Now then, where should I go food touring today~ I've already eaten at all the shops around here.
Speech.この学校に来た理由はね、好きなだけ暴れられるから！乗ってる間は、敵をどれだけ壊し: The reason I came to this school is because I can go wild as much as I want! While piloting, it's fine to destroy as many enemies as I want! ...Though people get scared of me sometimes.
Speech.うー、暴れ足りないよー！……ちょっとくらい何か壊してもいいかな？ ……やっぱりダ: Ugh, I haven't rampaged enough~! ...Is it okay if I break something just a little bit? ...As expected, no, right.
Speech.……退屈だなぁ。早く戻ってこないかなぁ……待ちくたびれちゃうなぁ……: ...Boring~. I wonder if they'll come back soon... tired of waiting...
Speech.聞いたよ！ 誕生日なんだよね！ お祝いに、一緒に遊びに行こ♪どこでもついていくよ: I heard! Today's your birthday, right! To celebrate, let's go play together♪ I'll follow anywhere! Inside the Maze is fine too!
Speech.あけましておめでとう！なんだか新しい年ってだけでワクワクしちゃうね♪: Happy New Year! Just it being a new year gets me excited♪
Speech.バレンタインデー？ 知ってる、チョコがもらえる日だよね！もしかして、くれるの！？: Valentine's Day? I know, it's the day you get chocolate! Don't tell me you're giving me some!? Excited...!
Speech.ホワイトデーだって！ お菓子をくれる日なんだよね！……お返しを貰う日？ うう、あ: It's White Day! It's the day you give sweets! ...The day you receive return gifts? Ugh, I didn't give any...
Speech.実は私、乱暴な事って大嫌いなんだよね……なーんて、エイプリルフールだよ♪ ……あ: Actually I hate violent things... Just kidding, April Fools' Day♪ ...Huh? Not funny?
Speech.結婚式かぁ。ああいうお嫁さんもいいんだけど……あのヒラヒラとした服、ビリビリに破: Weddings, huh. A bride like that is nice, but... those frilly clothes, I'm scared I'll rip them to shreds...
Speech.願い事？ もう叶ってるんだ♪あ、でも……もっといっぱい、君と一緒に暴れたいかも！: A wish? It's already come true♪ Ah, but... I might want to rampage with you way more!
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ イタズラかお菓子か選んでね？私の希望は……どっちでしょう: Trick or treat! Choose a trick or candy! My wish... which do you think it is♪
Speech.メリークリスマス！ 今日はご馳走を食べてケーキを食べるんだ♪後片付けでツリーを壊: Merry Christmas! Today I'm eating feast and cake♪ Looking forward to smashing the tree during cleanup too! ...Eh? We don't smash it?
Speech.えっ、誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの！？わーい！ それじゃあ、お腹いっぱいになるまで: Eh, you're celebrating my birthday!? Yay~! Then let's food tour together until we're stuffed♪
Speech.体育祭ではパン食い競争にも参加するんだ！ 優勝には関係ない競技だけど、 絶対に一: I'm participating in the bread-eating race at sports day too! It's an event unrelated to overall victory, but I'll definitely take first place! Because running in front lets me eat the tastiest bread!
Speech.優勝かぁ……今まで関係ない話だって思ってたから、 本当に優勝を目指すんだーってな: Overall victory, huh... I thought it had nothing to do with me, but aiming for victory for real... feels strange. Maybe I'm excited.
Speech.このハチマキ可愛いでしょ？ こう、ぎゅって頭に巻いたら不思議とやるぞー！ って元: This headband is cute, right? Tying it tight around my head strangely brings out 'Let's do this~!' energy! %usernameusernameuserna%, want to match with me?
Speech.この服を着てると動き出したくなってソワソワしちゃうなぁ…… よーし、ちょっと走っ: Wearing this uniform gets me restless and wanting to move... Alright, gonna go run a bit!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ えへへ、お祝いに何かしてほしい事ある？ 折角なら、背負って: Happy Birthday! Ehehe, anything you want done for celebration? Want me to piggyback you to your favorite place? ...Is that embarrassing?
Speech.あけましておめでとー！ 折角の新年だから、日の出に向かって一緒に走ろ！: Happy New Year~! Since it's a new year, let's run together towards the sunrise!
Speech.えへへ、バレンタインデーだね！ チョコレートは運動の後にもいいんだよ！ だから、: Ehehe, Valentine's Day! Chocolate is good after exercise too! So, have one♪
Speech.わ、ホワイトデーのお返しをくれるの！？ ありがと！ えへへ、嬉しいな！ 運動後に: Wh-White Day return gift for me!? Thanks! Ehehe, so happy! I'll eat it after exercise!
Speech.実は私、走るのが嫌いなんだよねぇ……なーんて、嘘だよ♪ ……え？ 全然騙されない: Actually I hate running... Just kidding♪ ...Eh? Not fooled at all? As expected, failed...
Speech.こうやってみると、結婚式をするのは楽しそうだけど準備が大変そうだよね。 体操服み: Looking at it like this, hosting a wedding looks fun but preparations seem tough. If only there were a dress easy to put on like a gym uniform. Is there one?
Speech.七夕にお願いしたのは、プレクラス-Ａの皆と、ずっと一緒にいれますように！ 前より: My Tanabata wish was 'May I stay with everyone in Pre-Class A forever!' Everyone has become way more precious to me than before♪
Speech.ハッピーハロウィン！ ……体操服のままだと、お菓子を貰えないかな？ うーんうーん: Happy Halloween! ...Can't I get treats while in a gym uniform? Mmm, mmm... how do you think I should beg for candy?
Speech.メリークリスマス！ ……え？ 寒くないのかって？ ……ちょっと寒いかも……でも走: Merry Christmas! ...Eh? Is it cold? ...A bit cold maybe... but running should warm me up, so off I go running!
Speech.えっ、誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ えへへ、ありがと！ プレゼントのおねだりじゃ: Eh, celebrating my birthday? Ehehe, thanks! Not asking for a gift, but... will you help me pick new running shoes?
Speech.はぁ、はぁ……よし、順調……|ここを超えればゴール……みんなのために頑張るよ……: *Haah, haah*... alright, smooth...|Overcoming this is the goal... I'll do my best for everyone...!
Speech.ぐむむ！ 邪魔だけど……が、がまん……！|うう、こんな網に拘束されて……全部めち: Gumm... annoying... endure...!|Ugh, restrained in a net like this... makes me want to wreck everything...!
Speech.あ、皆だ。おーい！ って、あわわ！|うっかり絡まっちゃう所だった……！ あぶない: Ah, everyone. Hey~! ...Wait, awawa!|Almost got accidentally tangled...! Close one, close one...!
Speech.さてと、そろそろ来月からの料理計画を練らないとな……あたしが栄養バランスから管理: Now then, time to draft next month's meal plan... Since I manage the nutritional balance, I make proper plans.
Speech.あたしとお嬢は小さい頃からの付き合いでな……まあ、色々とあったんだよ。お嬢はあた: The Miss and I go back to when we were little... well, lots happened. The Miss is like a little sister to me... a precious child.
Speech.あたしの口調？ ……まあ、あんまりいい育ちじゃないんだよ。畏まった場じゃないなら: My speech style? ...Well, I didn't have the finest upbringing. Unless it's a formal venue, I talk normally. Though I act polite in proper settings.
Speech.……暇だな。そうだなぁ……久々にカービングでもするか？石鹸とか蝋燭はあったよな…: ...Bored. Let's see... carve something after a long time? Soap or candles were around... What pattern? Flower pattern, maybe?
Speech.あんた誕生日なんだって？ そういうお祝い事はちゃんとしないとな。プレゼントは準備: It's your birthday? Celebrations like that gotta be done properly. Since I didn't prepare a gift... I'll take care of you for a day.
Speech.あけましておめでとう……あたしはお嬢と一緒に挨拶周りだ。大変そうだけど、これも貴: Happy New Year... I'm doing greeting rounds with the Miss. Seems tough, but it's a noble's duty too. Gotta support her firmly.
Speech.ほら、チョコレート。まあ、普段から世話になってるしな。そんなに手が込んだものじゃ: Here, chocolate. Well, you take care of me normally. It's not elaborate, but... eat it when you get hungry.
Speech.これはホワイトデーのお返しか？そんなに気を遣わせるつもりじゃなかったんだけど……: Is this a White Day return gift? Didn't mean to make you worry... Thanks, I'll take it.
Speech.あら、旦那様。どうされました？ 私は普段通りですけども。……あー、堅苦しい。お嬢: My, Master. What is it? I am as usual. ...Ah, so stiff. Count that as a lie replicating when I act serious attending the Miss.
Speech.へぇ、ウェディングドレスか。お嬢が着たらさぞかし似合うんだろうな。……あたし？: Heh, a wedding dress. It'd surely suit the Miss. ...Me? Doesn't suit me so whatever... don't go imagining it, okay?
Speech.願い事か……お嬢のためにこれからも働けるようにかな。まあ、願うだけじゃなくて自分: A wish... Being able to continue working for the Miss, I guess. Though I intend to fulfill it myself rather than just wishing.
Speech.さーて、ミリアム達がどうせお菓子をねだってくるだろうし……ちゃんと渡すための準備: Now then, Miriam and the others are bound to beg for candy anyway... gotta prepare proper ones to hand over.
Speech.メリークリスマス。それじゃ、折角だから手伝ってくれないか？お嬢が開催するんだから: Merry Christmas. Well then, won't you help out since we're here? Since the Miss is hosting, we gotta make it a splendid party anyone would admire.
Speech.ん？ ……あたしの誕生日？ 祝ってくれるのか？……いや、なんだ、その……お嬢たち: Hm? ...My birthday? You're celebrating it? ...No, well, it's my first time getting celebrated by anyone besides the Miss and others... it's embarrassing.
Speech.ん？ 待ちきれないか？|ちゃんと蒸らさないとダメだからお預けだ。まあ、その価値は: Hm? Can't wait?|It won't work unless properly steeped, so hold on. Well, I'll treat you to tea worth the wait.
Speech.……うん、言い香りだな。|茶葉の管理も大切だからな……これだけ質がいいなら、美味: ...Yup, good scent.|Managing tea leaves is important... With this quality, it'll make delicious tea.
Speech.っ……あんたなぁ……！|はぁ……まあ、悪戯に目くじら立てるのも大人げないか……大: Tch... you...!|*Sigh*... well, getting upset over a prank is childish... wait quietly.
Speech.……アークトゥルスだとか、融和だとか言ってるが……あたしには、迷惑な話だ。ただ、: ...Talking about Arcturus or harmony... it's a pain to me. Just wanting to remain the Miss's maid... is that a selfish wish.
Speech.昔は本当に荒れてたんだよ。まあ、お嬢に出会って変わったわけなんだが……一歩間違え: I was really wild back then. Well, meeting the Miss changed me... One wrong step and my life... would've been pretty ruined.
Speech.こうやって、こんな衣装に身を包んでると考えちまうんだよ。 ……いつか、あたしもメ: Dressed in an outfit like this makes me think. ...Will the day come when I quit being a maid too? Not like me to think that though.
Speech.あー、くそ。メイド服じゃないのは落ち着かないな……もうずっと、あっちの方を着続け: Ah, damn. Not being in a maid dress feels unnatural... I've been wearing that one for so long... Ah geez, feels uncomfortable!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。あんたが生まれた日だって聞いてたから、お嬢に許可を取って、今日: Happy Birthday. Heard it was the day you were born, so I got permission from the Miss and came to be your personal maid for today. So, orders?
Speech.あけましておめでとう……なんだ、せっかくの新年なんだ。メイド服じゃなくて、こうい: Happy New Year... Well, it's a fresh new year. An outfit like this to turn over a new leaf instead of a maid dress isn't bad.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%、ほら。チョコレート。……あんた: %usernameusernameuserna%, here. Chocolate. ...You help me out in various ways... so it's a thank-you.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？ 本当に律儀だな……ふふ。でも、こうやってくれる気持ちが嬉: A White Day return gift? Really dutiful... fufu. But the feeling of giving like this makes me happy. Thanks.
Speech.ああ？ なんだ、テメエ！ あたしはもうメイドでも何でもねえんだよ！……って、まあ: Aah? What, you bastard! I ain't no maid or anything anymore! ...Well, it's April Fools' Day... don't take it so seriously. Makes me feel down...
Speech.ジューンブライドか……結婚なぁ。ずっとお嬢のメイドとして付き従う事を考えてたけど: June bride... marriage, huh. I only thought about serving as the Miss's maid, but marrying someone someday might not be bad...
Speech.願い事は決まってんだ。お嬢にミリアムにハリエットにケイトに……それに、あんた。あ: My wish is set. The Miss, Miriam, Harriet, Kate... and you. Wishing happiness for everyone who worked hard for my sake.
Speech.……はぁ、成長したと思ってたんだがなぁ……ミリアム達、相変わらずお菓子を強奪して: ...*Sigh*, thought they grew up... Miriam and the rest were happily extorting candy as usual... Honestly, helpless kids. Really.
Speech.メリークリスマス。なんだ、３人とお嬢とあたしでプレゼント交換をしてな……その時に: Merry Christmas. Well, the three, the Miss, and I did a present exchange... accidentally bought too many presents... Sharing some with you. Here.
Speech.……あたしの誕生日なんて、よく覚えてたな。嬉しいけど……ああ、やっぱダメだ！ お: ...Remembered my birthday well. Happy, but... ah, can't do it! Never been celebrated like this by anyone other than the Miss, so it's embarrassing!
Speech.……あー、息が詰まる。|メイド服と違って着慣れてないからな……着替えたくなってき: ...Ah, suffocating.|Not used to this unlike a maid dress... starting to want to change.
Speech.なんだ？ あたしに合ってる？|まあ、昔は男と勘違いされるくらいにヤンチャな子供だ: What? Suits me?|Well, back then I was a naughty kid mistaken for a boy...
Speech.んん……はぁ、疲れたな。|見られたのがあんたで良かったよ。ミリアムとかだと、大騒: Mmm... phew, tired.|Glad it was you who saw me. If it were Miriam, it'd have been a huge fuss.
Speech.ヒーローが好きなんだけど、子供の頃に見た、『超機神ジャスティオン』ってヒーローが: I love heroes, especially 'Super Machine God Justion' which I watched as a kid, and becoming a hero like Justion is my dream!
Speech.ん？ リリーに弱点？ ヒーローには弱点なんてないよ！ ……って言いたいんだけど、: Hm? Lily's weakness? Heroes have no weaknesses! ...is what I'd like to say, but shellfish is my weakness... Picky eating isn't good for a hero, but I really can't handle it...
Speech.今度一緒に街で探検しにいかない？ パルクールを練習してるから、一緒に駆け回りたい: Want to go urban exploring next time? Practicing parkour, so I want to run around together! Dash through rooftops or obstacle roads... Too dangerous? ...Fair point!
Speech.うーん、そろそろパトロールの時間だから行かないと……でも%usernameuse: Hmm, time for patrol soon so I gotta go... but when %usernameusernameuserna% comes back... ugh, what to do~!
Speech.お誕生日！？ うわわ、どうしよう！ 何の準備もしてない！えーっと、お祝いに……ヒ: Your birthday!? Uwa, what to do! Didn't prepare anything! Umm, for celebration... not as a hero, but as plain Lily... stay together with you...?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ 新年だからこそ、気を引き締めないとね！……とはいえ、ちょ: Happy New Year! Gotta brace myself for the new year! ...Though a little break to watch hero movies might be fine?
Speech.バレンタインデーはチョコレート絡みでトラブルが起きるから、リリーが取り締まりをす: Valentine's Day causes chocolate troubles, so Lily will crack down! ...Um, if you want chocolate from Lily... after Disciplinary Committee duties, okay?
Speech.えっ、リリーにバレンタインデーのお返しをくれるの！？……うう、受け取るべきか……: Eh, giving Lily a White Day return gift!? ...Ugh, accept it or decline as a bribe... Accept! Thanks!
Speech.嘘はダメだよ！ 嘘は悲しい思いしか生まれないからね……エイプリルフールに、ジャス: Lies are bad! Lies only bring sadness... Lily decided that after being tricked by a lie about a new Justion series on April Fools'!
Speech.ジューンブライドかぁ……お嫁さんのドレス姿って素敵だよね。まあリリーはヒーローだ: June brides, huh... A bride's dress is lovely. Well, Lily's a hero so distant from weddings! ...Though I might want to wear it once.
Speech.願い事かぁ……変形合体するＭＧがいつか開発されて乗れますように……！ヒーローアニ: A wish, huh... May a transforming/combining MG be developed and piloted someday...! Admired it ever since seeing it in hero anime...
Speech.ハロウィンだね！ 正義のヒーローはお菓子を強奪する悪い子は見逃さないよ！捕まえた: It's Halloween! The hero of justice won't overlook bad kids extorting candy! When caught, I'll tell them no pranks and give candy to obedient good kids!
Speech.クリスマスはちょっと憂鬱なんだよね。だって、色んなヒーローのオモチャが出てくる時: Christmas is a bit gloomy. Because all sorts of hero toys come out this season... my wallet gets light...
Speech.えっリリーの誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの！？ ……えへへ、嬉しいな！ ありがとう！: Eh, celebrating Lily's birthday!? ...Ehehe, happy! Thanks! Um, as a present... host a hero movie viewing party together?
Speech.……あれ？ 何を見てるの？|やっぱり汗をかいて健康的な体作りは大切だからね。あな: ...Huh? What are you looking at?|Sweating and building a healthy body is important. Want to do it together?
Speech.……ふぅ、ちょっと休憩。|ヒーローは一日にしてならずだから……大変でもちゃんとト: ...Phew, a little break.|A hero isn't built in a day... gotta keep up training even if it's tough!
Speech.……ど、どこ見てるの！？|は、恥ずかしいなぁ……リリーのこんなところ見ても、別に: ...W-Where are you looking!?|I-It's embarrassing... Looking at a part like this on Lily isn't fun, right...?
Speech.ヒーロースーツ以外の服を着るのも結構久しぶりだから、ちょっと恥ずかしいんだよね…: It's been a long time since I wore clothes other than a hero suit, so it's embarrassing... Partner, does it suit me? ...Suits me? Ehehe... glad then...
Speech.ヒーローとしての想いって、歌だけでも伝えれるんだね。それが分かっただけでも、今回: Heroic feelings can be conveyed through song alone. Just learning that makes participating in this live concert worth it.
Speech.……うーん、なんとかして普段のスーツにヒーローガジェットで、カラオケ機能を組み込: ...Hmm, can't I somehow build a karaoke function into my normal suit using hero gadgets... Want to make an entrance while playing my theme song...
Speech.うーん、何を歌おっかな……ライブの曲もいいんだけど、ジャスティオンメドレーも歌い: Hmm, what should I sing... Live songs are nice, but I want to sing the Justion medley too... Might as well sing everything!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう！ うーんうーん……せっかくの誕生日なら、シエナ達を呼んで、皆で: Happy Birthday! Hmm, mmm... Since it's your birthday, should I call Siena and the others to sing a celebration song together? Yup, let's do that!
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ ヒーローとしての挨拶！そしてライブのボーカルとしての挨拶: Happy New Year! A greeting as a hero! And a greeting as a live vocalist! Double the value!
Speech.……びっくりしちゃった。リリーにってチョコレートがたくさん送られてきて……ね、ね: ...I was surprised. So much chocolate sent for Lily... H-Hey. Can't eat it all alone, so eat together with me?
Speech.うう……ホワイトデーのお返しが大変だよぉ……誰かに手伝ってほしい……でも、リリー: Ugh... Returning White Day gifts is so much work... I wish someone would help me... But since they were sent to Lily, Lily has to return them properly herself...!
Speech.今のリリーは歌って踊れるアイドルヒーローになったんだよ！なんちゃって……え？ あ: Right now, Lily has turned into an idol hero who can sing and dance! Just kidding... Huh? Wait... What is that device...? A video? D-Delete it!?
Speech.こういう結婚とかの時に、お祝いの歌ってあるけど……今ならリリーも歌えるかな？えへ: There are celebration songs for times like weddings... I wonder if Lily can sing one now too? Ehehe, if a close friend gets married, Lily will deliver the absolute best song for them!
Speech.お願いかぁ……うーん、また皆と一緒にライブで演奏をして、色んな人と一緒に凄い盛り: A wish, huh... Hmm, I'd love to perform live with everyone again and get super hyped up together with all kinds of people... But instead of just wishing, I want to make it happen myself!
Speech.ヒーローはお休み！ 今日は仮装をして楽しんでる子たちのために、ハロウィンで盛り上: Taking a break from being a hero! Today, I'm planning to sing exciting Halloween songs for the kids having fun in costumes! Walking through the city singing in a chorus sounds like fun too♪
Speech.ふっふっふ、クリスマスソングならリリーにお任せ！ 今日はリクエスト通りに歌うよ！: Fuffuffu, leave Christmas songs to Lily! Today, I'll sing whatever you request!... is what I'd love to say, but my Disciplinary Committee patrol takes priority... so I don't have time to sing, ugh...
Speech.えっ、誕生日のお祝い！？ そんな、いいの！？……それなら、一緒にデュエットしてほ: Eh, a birthday celebration!? Really, is that okay!? ...In that case, I want you to sing a duet with me! Let's sing a medley at karaoke!
Speech.はぁ、歌って楽しいね！|今どきはヒーローも歌って演奏出来るから、リリーもアップデ: Haa, singing is so much fun! These days, heroes can sing and play instruments too, so Lily got an upgrade as well!
Speech.……えへへ、かっこよかった？|ファンサービスってやつだよ！ レイラから教わったん: ...Ehehe, was I cool? It's called fan service! Layla taught me!
Speech.はぁ、うーん！ スッキリしたー！|どのくらい歌ったかな？ うーん、でもまだまだ歌: Haa, ahh! That felt so refreshing! How long did I sing for? Hmm, but I could probably keep singing even more!
Speech.生徒会――いえ、生徒会長を支えて、学園の秩序を維持すること……これは風紀委員会の: Supporting the student council—no, supporting the Student Council President and maintaining the academy's order... This is the duty of the Disciplinary Committee, as well as my own guiding principle.
Speech.幼い頃は身体が弱くて、そのときからある健康法を続けているんです。元は武術だったの: I was sickly as a child, so I've been practicing a certain health method ever since. It was originally a martial art adapted into health calisthenics... If you'd like, would you care to join me?
Speech.リリーさんは頑張り屋さんで正義感が強く、風紀委員会に入っただけあって優秀な子です: Lily-san is a hard worker with a strong sense of justice, and she's an excellent girl who truly belongs in the Disciplinary Committee. However, she's so energetic that she can be a bit reckless. I just hope she doesn't get injured...
Speech.あの……%usernameusernameuserna%さん？ 寝ているのでしょ: Umm... %usernameusernameuserna%-san? Are you asleep? In that case, it's best to leave you undisturbed... Fufu, please rest well.
Speech.ふふ、誕生日おめでとうございます。誕生日がいつかの記憶が残っていてよかったです。: Fufu, happy birthday. I'm glad your memories of when your birthday is remained intact, so that I can celebrate you like this today.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。まさかこうして%usernameusername: Happy New Year. I never imagined back when I was at my family home that I would welcome the New Year with %usernameusernameuserna%-san—with a gentleman.
Speech.どうぞ、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。バレンタインチョコ: Here you go, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. Valentine's chocolates. ...Fufu, don't worry, there aren't any strange ingredients inside. Though there might be something else in there that's invisible to the eye.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しですか？ そんな律儀に返さなくても……ふふ、でもいただきます: A White Day return gift? You didn't have to be so dutiful... Fufu, but I will gladly accept it. This is my first time receiving something like this, so I feel rather happy.
Speech.嘘をついてもいい日ですか……でもこういう日こそ、正直でいたくありませんか？なので: A day when it's okay to lie... But don't you want to be honest on a day like this instead? Therefore, '%usernameusernameuserna%-san, I love you'... Fufu, was that a lie or the truth, I wonder?
Speech.ジューンブライド……ですか。え？ わたくしのウェディングドレス姿を見てみたい……: June Bride... is it? Eh? You want to see me in a wedding dress...? In that case... would you put it on me, %usernameusernameuserna%-san? Fufu, just a joke.
Speech.貴方は叶えたい願いはありますか？ わたくしはそうですね……今の夕闇のような立ち位: Do you have a wish you'd like to fulfill? As for me... perhaps I'd like to step out of my current twilight-like position. ...? Is that too abstract? Fufu, that's just what wishes are like.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート……？ あら、わたくしにイタズラをしたいのですか？ふふ、: Trick or treat...? Oh, do you want to play a trick on me? Fufu, I don't mind. That is... if you've carefully thought through what comes after.
Speech.大型の年間イベントとなると、あちこちで浮かれた生徒達を取り締まらないといけないの: When it comes to major annual events, we have to crack down on excited students all over the place, so I rarely have time to enjoy my own Christmas.
Speech.まさか貴方に誕生日を祝っていただけるなんて……実家にいた頃は、そういう経験皆無だ: I never expected you to celebrate my birthday... Back when I was at my family home, I had zero experience with such things. I'll engrave your words of congratulations, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, deep in my heart.
Speech.あら？ そうなんですか？|でもそろそろお話も終わりにしましょう？ 他の人に見られ: Oh? Is that so? But let's wrap up our conversation soon, shall we? Other people might see us.
Speech.ふふふ……まったく、もう。|もっとわたくしと戯れていたいのですか？ こちらもヒマ: Fufufu... Goodness, honestly. Do you want to play around with me more? I'm not entirely free either, though...
Speech.あれは……お仲間かしら？|貴方もあの子達と一緒に、群れのボスのもとへ帰ったほうが: Are those... your companions? I think you should head back to your pack's boss alongside those kids too.
Speech.こっちの世界に来てから、なんだか嘘みたいに平和な時間を過ごしてるなぁ……このまま: Ever since coming to this world, I've been spending time that feels unbelievably peaceful... I wonder if it'd be nice to just stay here and relax forever... Just kidding, of course.
Speech.むむむ……こっちだとタケルちゃん、自分で起きちゃうからわたしが起こせない……毎朝: Mmm... In this world, Takeru-chan wakes up on his own so I can't wake him up... Even though waking him up every morning is my job! Takeru-chan should definitely oversleep more!
Speech.めるちゃんとはすっかり仲良しになったんだよ！今度は女子会を開いて、お菓子を持ち寄: Meru-chan and I have become super close friends! Next time we're gonna host a girls' night, bring snacks, drink tea, and chat♪
Speech.……むむむ、ヒマだなぁ。タケルちゃんは今何してるんだろ？おーい！タケルちゃーん！: ...Mmm, I'm so bored. What's Takeru-chan doing right now? Hey~! Takeru-chan! Taaakeeeruuu-chaaan!! Where are you~!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ お世話になってるから、お祝いをしてあげないとね！たくさんご: Happy birthday! You take such good care of me, so I gotta celebrate for you! I'll make a huge feast, so look forward to it!
Speech.あけましておめでと！ ふっふっふ、めるちゃんとおせちを作ったんだ！みんなを呼んで: Happy New Year! Fuffuffu, Meru-chan and I made New Year's osechi! Let's invite everyone over and relax while eating osechi for the New Year!
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーだね！ みんなとチョコレートを作ってるんだ。いっぱい作った: Today's Valentine's Day! I'm making chocolates with everyone. We made a lot, but... of course, the true-love chocolate is for Takeru-chan♪
Speech.えへへ、ホワイトデーのお返しをタケルちゃんから貰えるなんてびっくり！……これは大: Ehehe, I was so surprised to get a White Day return gift from Takeru-chan! ...I have to savor this carefully♪
Speech.エイプリルフールかぁ……うーん、何を言ってみようかな……タケルちゃんにはいっつも: April Fools', huh... Hmm, what should I say... Takeru-chan always tricks me, so this time I'm definitely gonna trick him...!
Speech.わぁ……この世界でもジューンブライドがあるんだね！……いつか、あんな風にウエディ: Wow... They have June Brides in this world too! ...Someday, I want to wear a wedding dress like that and have a wedding ceremony.
Speech.こっちの世界にも七夕ってあるんだね。何をお願いしたの？わたしはね、タケルちゃんが: They have Tanabata in this world as well, huh. What did you wish for? As for me, I wished that Takeru-chan stays happy forever and ever!
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ ふっふっふ、お菓子をよこさないとイタズラしちゃうぞ～！…: Trick or treat! Fuffuffu, if you don't hand over the candy, I'll play a trick on you~! ...Ugh, now that I think about it calmly, was that a bit childish...?
Speech.元の世界では、毎年クリスマスにタケルちゃんとお祝いをしてた気がするんだ。だから、: I feel like Takeru-chan and I celebrated Christmas together every year back in our original world. So this year, we plan to wait for Santa while eating cake together too♪
Speech.わっ、お誕生日のお祝い……！？ありがとう！ えへへ、こんな風にお祝いされて嬉しい: Wah, a birthday celebration...!? Thank you! Ehehe, I'm so happy to be celebrated like this♪
Speech.……どうしたの？ 変なタケルちゃん♪|こんな風にお買い物出来て幸せだね……これか: ...What's wrong, silly Takeru-chan?♪ Being able to go shopping like this makes me so happy... Let's go shopping together lots from now on, okay?♪
Speech.うわぁ！？ ……タケルちゃんのえっち……|……タケルちゃんって、変なタイミングで: Uwaa!? ...Takeru-chan, you pervert... ...Takeru-chan, you always get mean at the weirdest times! Don't do strange things!
Speech.……うーん……結構いいかも♪|うっ、でもお値段がちょっとしちゃうかも……やっぱり: ...Hmm... This might actually be pretty good♪ Ugh, but the price is a bit high... Maybe I should think about it a little more after all...
Speech.……確かに平和な世界ではあるが、メイズという戦場もある。勘を鈍らせて帰るわけには: ...It is indeed a peaceful world, but there is also the battlefield known as the Maze. I cannot let my instincts dull before heading back... I must ensure I do not neglect basic training.
Speech.たとえ記憶がなくなっても剣技や戦術機の操縦は忘れぬものなのだな……体が覚えている: Even if my memories are lost, swordsmanship and TSF piloting are not forgotten... The skills ingrained in my body remind us that we are soldiers.
Speech.こちらの世界でも見所のあるものが何人もいるのだな。かつて行ったスカラ校舎もそうだ: There are several promising individuals in this world as well. The Scalar School Building we went to before was one example, but there seem to be other interesting people... I would like to spar with them someday.
Speech.……ふぅ、こうして空いた時間に瞑想もよいものだ。最近は想像も出来ないような事ばか: ...Phew, meditating like this during free time feels good. Things beyond imagination have been happening one after another lately, after all...
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……どこの世界でも生まれた日を祝う気持ちは同じなのだな。ふふ、私: Happy birthday... The sentiment of celebrating one's birth remains the same in any world. Fufu, allow me to give you a small token of my appreciation as well.
Speech.謹んで新年のお慶びを申し上げる……少し硬い言い回しであったか？だが、一年の計は元: I offer my respectful congratulations on the New Year... Was that phrasing a bit too formal? Still, the plan for the year is made on New Year's Day. One can only welcome a good year by observing proper decorum.
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーというものらしいな……私も鑑に誘われて、チョコレートを作っ: Today seems to be something called Valentine's Day... Kagami invited me to make chocolates as well, but... I wonder if Takeru will be pleased with them?
Speech.ホワイトデー……？ というものでタケルから貰ったお返しだが……ふふ。普通の焼き菓: This is a return gift I received from Takeru for... White Day, was it? Fufu. Even if it's ordinary baked goods, knowing it's from Takeru makes it feel like a waste to eat.
Speech.今日は嘘をついていい日とはいうが……やはり私には馴染まんな。とはいえ、そなたが望: They say today is a day where lying is permitted... but as expected, it doesn't suit me. That said, if you wish to, say as you please.
Speech.結婚か……ふむ、私には縁の遠い話だと思っていたが……この平和な世界で白無垢を着て: Marriage, huh... Hmm, I thought it was a concept far removed from me... but trying on a traditional white wedding kimono in this peaceful world might not be so bad...
Speech.七夕か……願いを書くのであれば、そうだな。元の世界に戻れるように……いや、それよ: Tanabata, is it... If I were to write a wish, let's see. 'May we return to our original world'... No, rather than that, 'May our memories return'? Mmm, troublesome choice.
Speech.仮装をしている生徒たちが楽しそうにしている様子を見たが……珍しい光景だったな。ハ: I saw the students in costumes looking like they were having fun... It was quite an unusual sight. Halloween, was it called? I prepared a box of sweets, but I was turned down...
Speech.鑑たちが計画をしていたパーティーに誘われたのだが……どの様な格好をしていけばよい: I was invited to a party planned by Kagami and the others... What kind of attire should I wear...? Hm? My current clothes are fine?
Speech.誕生日を祝ってくれて感謝する。ふふ、タケルと私は誕生日が同じ日でな。折角だ。タケ: Thank you for celebrating my birthday. Fufu, Takeru and I share the exact same birthday. Since we're here, let's bring Takeru along and celebrate together.
Speech.ああ……今日はタケルに任せるぞ？|こうして、タケルに手を引かれて歩くというのは…: Ah... I'll leave things to you today, Takeru. Walking like this while being led by the hand by Takeru... truly makes my heart flutter.
Speech.少し恥ずかしいぞ……|だが、こうしてタケルに撫でられるというのは悪くない気分だ…: This is a little embarrassing... But being patted like this by Takeru doesn't feel half bad...
Speech.……ふふ、良い風だな。|こうして吹く風は私の覚えている世界と変わらないのだな。: ...Fufu, what a nice breeze. The wind blowing like this is no different from the world I remember.
Speech.……こっちの世界だと、可愛いものがいっぱいありますし……猫ちゃんもいっぱいいて…: ...In this world, there are so many cute things... and so many kitties... Sometimes my heart throbs thinking I might have come to heaven.
Speech.こっちでも、毎日の基礎訓練をしちゃうんですよね。メイズ探索もありますし……やっぱ: Even here, I end up doing basic daily training. We have Maze exploration too... I'm afraid my instincts will get dull, so I just end up exercising without thinking.
Speech.こっちの世界でも、お友達を増やしたいなーって思うんですけどなかなか増えなくて……: I want to make more friends in this world too, but it's not happening easily... I love kitties, so it'd be great if I could make friends through a shared love of cats...
Speech.……ふわぁ……ひとりになっちゃうと……んん……眠くなっちゃいます……ぐう……はっ: ...Fuwah... Whenever I'm alone... mm... I get sleepy... *snore*... Huh!? I-I wasn't sleeping, okay!?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます！こういうおめでたいことは、皆で共有しないといけませ: Happy birthday! Happy occasions like this must be shared with everyone, after all♪
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます！新年になりましたし、ちゃんとこっちの世界でもお参: Happy New Year! Since a new year has started, we should make sure to visit a shrine in this world as well!
Speech.純夏さんたちと一緒にバレンタインデーのチョコレートを作ってみたんです！いっぱい作: I tried making Valentine's Day chocolates with Sumika-san and the others! We made a lot, so I'm going to distribute them to various people♪ Of course, I'll give some to Takeru-san too!
Speech.えへへ、ホワイトデーにこんな風に色んな人からお返しを貰えると思ってなかったので、: Ehehe, I didn't expect to receive return gifts from so many people on White Day, so I was super surprised! I can't eat it all by myself, so I'll share it with everyone♪
Speech.嘘をついてもいい日ですか……なんだか引っかかるものが……！嘘をついた事でいろんな: A day when lying is okay...? Something about that bothers me...! I have memories of causing trouble for lots of people by lying... Auu auu...
Speech.ふわぁ……綺麗なウエディングドレスですね……わたしにも、あんな綺麗なドレスを着て: Fuwah... What a beautiful wedding dress... I wonder if I'll ever be able to wear a gorgeous dress like that and have a wonderful ceremony...
Speech.七夕は何をお願いしましたか？わたしは皆で、いつまでも仲良くいられるようにってお願: What did you wish for on Tanabata? As for me, I wished that everyone can stay close friends forever!
Speech.ええっと、ハロウィンって行事があるんですよね！ わたしも仮装しないか誘われちゃい: Umm, there's an event called Halloween, right! I was invited to dress up in a costume too!... A bell and a tail? That sounds kind of like a cat~
Speech.今日はめるさんたちから教えてもらった、クリスマスパーティーをするんです！……こん: Today we're having a Christmas party that Meru-san and the others told us about!... Being able to celebrate harmoniously like this with everyone makes me so happy...
Speech.えっ、お誕生日のこと知ってくれてたんですか！？ ありがとうございます！えへへ……: Eh, you knew about my birthday!? Thank you so much! Ehehe... Just the sentiment of celebrating it makes me more than happy enough!
Speech.ふわぁ……気持ちいいです……|たけるさん、とっても上手です……自分でやるよりも、: Fuwah... That feels so good... Takeru-san, you're really good at this... It's way more gentle than when I do it myself...
Speech.……えへへ、なんですかー？|もう、イタズラは……ちょっとならいいですけど、やりす: ...Ehehe, what is it~? Geez, playing tricks... A little bit is fine, but you shouldn't overdo it, okay?
Speech.……んっ、ふふ、あはは……！|くすぐったいです、たけるさん。でも……なんだか平和: ...Nn, fufu, ahaha...! That tickles, Takeru-san. But... it feels peaceful and nice somehow...
Speech.私たち、すっかりこっちの世界にも馴染んできたわね……むしろ、衛士としての勘を忘れ: We've completely adjusted to this world, haven't we... In fact, it feels harder to not forget our instincts as surface pilots.
Speech.こっちにも私たちが知ってるのと同じスポーツがあるのね。でも、公式MG競技みたいに: They have the same sports we know here too. But there wasn't anything like official MG competitions competing with TSFs. ...Well, ours was a world without the luxury to be doing things like that...
Speech.この世界でも戦術機を整備できる環境を用意してもらえて本当に安心したわ。元の世界に: I was really relieved that they set up an environment where we can maintain TSFs in this world too. It makes me feel that the possibility of returning to our original world still remains...
Speech.まず、この後に生徒会の依頼を確認してから……ああ、そうだ。メイズ探索の方もまとめ: First, after I check the student council request... Ah, right. I have to summarize the Maze exploration details too... Things are getting busy.
Speech.今日が誕生日？おめでとうございます！……そうだ、今晩お時間ありますか？もし良かっ: Today is your birthday? Happy birthday! ...Oh, right, do you have time tonight? If you'd like, why don't we go grab a meal with everyone?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。一年の計は元旦にありと言いますけど、あなたの今年: Happy New Year. They say the plan for the year is made on New Year's Day, but what is your goal for this year?
Speech.これ、受け取っていただけますか？今日は親しい人やお世話になってる人にチョコを贈る: Would you please accept this? Apparently today is a day to give chocolates to close friends or people who take care of you. You always look after me, so I thought of this as a token of my gratitude.
Speech.え？これどうしたの？ホワイトデー？……ああ、なるほど。バレンタインデーのお返しを: Eh? What's this for? White Day? ...Ah, I see. It's the day to return the favor for Valentine's Day. Thank you, I'll gladly accept it.
Speech.あら？あなたもウソをつきに来たの？今日は軽いウソなら許される日だって聞いてるんだ: My? Did you come to tell a lie too? I heard today is a day where light lies are forgiven, so... Eh? That was yesterday? I'm sorry... Wait, that's a lie in itself, isn't it!
Speech.ウエディングドレス……とても綺麗ね……。着られるときが来るといいのだけれど……。: A wedding dress... It's so beautiful... I hope a time comes when I can wear one... Do I have a partner? ...Mind your own business!
Speech.七夕でのお願いって、自分に言い聞かせるためでもあると思うの。言葉にして書くことで: I think making a wish for Tanabata is also a way to tell yourself what you want. Don't you think writing it down as words strengthens your resolve even more?
Speech.ハロウィンって収穫を祝うお祭りのはずなんだけど……みんな仮装に力を入れちゃってる: Halloween is supposed to be a festival celebrating the harvest... but everyone is putting so much effort into costumes. Do I have to dress up too? ...Even if you say that, it's a bit...
Speech.クリスマスはキリストの誕生日だけど、こっちにもあるなんて何だか不思議ね。トナカイ: Christmas is Christ's birthday, but it feels somewhat strange that they have it here too. Reindeer seem to exist as well. I saw a girl in costume in the city.
Speech.私の誕生日？ああ、忙しくしてたらすっかり忘れてたわ……。覚えていてくれてありがと: My birthday? Ah, I was so busy I completely forgot... Thank you for remembering. I'm really happy.
Speech.きゃあ！？ ……びっくりした。|ごめんなさい。ちょっと加減を間違えちゃって。かか: Kyaa!? ...That startled me. I'm sorry. I misjudged my force a little. Did it splash on you?
Speech.……っとと、ふぅ……|……喉の渇きがもう限界だったわ……汗もすごくかいちゃったし: ...Whoops, phew... My thirst was really at its limit... I sweated so much too... Don't laugh.
Speech.ん、どうかしたの？|……何か気になる？じっと見られると恥ずかしいわ。: Hm, what's wrong? ...Is something bothering you? It's embarrassing when you stare so intently.
Speech.こっちの世界って、色々と面白そうな場所があるみたいなんだよね。大きい湖とか、樹海: This world seems to have a lot of interesting places. Like giant lakes, dense forests... I'd love to go visit them.
Speech.うーん、すっかりこっちの世界に馴染んじゃったんだけど……ボクの元居た世界に端末と: Mmm, I've completely settled into this world... but I wonder if I can take a device back to my original world... I can't bear to part with it...
Speech.もしこっちの世界に生まれてたら、ボクは何をしてたんだろうね？やっぱり探検家？あっ: If I were born in this world, what would I be doing? Still an explorer? Ah, unless my dad were my dad in this world too, maybe that wouldn't happen? ...Wait, right?
Speech.……うーん、山を登ってみようかな？ 温泉を探すのもいいかなあ？せっかく知らない場: ...Hmm, maybe I'll try climbing a mountain? Or searching for a hot spring? Since I'm in an unfamiliar place, I definitely want to explore!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！プレゼント考えてみたんだけど、これってのが思いつかなくてさ。: Happy birthday! I tried thinking of a present, but I couldn't come up with 'the one.' I want it to be something you'll love as much as possible, so if you're free, why don't we go look together now?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！新年といえば初日の出！富士山は無いけど、あの高い山なら見ら: Happy New Year! Speaking of the New Year, it's the first sunrise! There's no Mt. Fuji, but I think we can see it from that high mountain over there! Want to go together?
Speech.チョコレートを皆で一緒に作ったんだけど、はい！ お裾分け！やっぱりチョコレートは: We all made chocolates together, so here! A portion for you! Chocolate really is great. It's convenient and high in calories, making it perfect for field rations.
Speech.ホワイトデー？お菓子をくれるの！ありがとう！うーん、どうしようかな……保存しとく: White Day? You're giving me sweets! Thank you! Hmm, what should I do... Save them or eat them right away... It's a tough choice.
Speech.これから、一週間くらい山に入ろうと思うんだけど、一緒に行く？え？エイプリルフール: I'm thinking of heading into the mountains for about a week starting now, wanna come? Eh? April Fools'...? What are you talking about?
Speech.ウエディングドレスかぁ……一度は着てみたいなぁ……。その目は何？ ボクだって女の: A wedding dress, huh... I'd like to wear one at least once... What's with that look? I'm a girl too, you know!
Speech.短冊にはなんて書いた？ ボクはねえ、希少な生き物を発見できますようにとか、あとは: What did you write on your paper strip? As for me, stuff like 'May I discover rare creatures' or 'May I eat rare and delicious vegetables and fruits', I guess?
Speech.仮装をしたり、お菓子を貰いに行ったりするらしいよ。ボクも貰えたりするのかなあ？: Apparently people dress up in costumes and go get treats. I wonder if I can get some too?
Speech.クリスマスパーティーかぁ。もみの木が必要って聞いたから取りに行くんだけど、この辺: A Christmas party, huh. I heard a fir tree is needed, so I'm going to get one, but I wonder where they grow around here? Carrying it with a TSF should be fine, right?
Speech.え？誕生日おめでとう？わぁ、ありがとう！急に言われたからびっくりしたよ！でもすご: Eh? Happy birthday? Wow, thank you! I was surprised because you said it out of nowhere! But I'm super happy!
Speech.うわっ！？ さっきの何！？|もしかして新技？面白いね！よーし、ボクも真似してみよ: Uwa!? What was that just now!? A new technique, maybe? How interesting! Alright, I'm gonna try copying it too!
Speech.これで……出来た！|端末でやってたら出来なかった技だよ！ 筐体だと違うね！: With this... done! That's a trick I couldn't do on a mobile device! Arcade cabinets really hit different!
Speech.あはは、負けちゃった。|でも、動きのパターンは分かったよ！ 次は絶対に勝つからね: Ahaha, I lost. But I figured out your movement patterns! I'm definitely winning next time!
Speech.公式MG競技？……平和っていいね。: Official MG competitions?... Peace is nice.
Speech.メイズ探索の報酬は何に使う？……知りたい？…………秘密。: What will I use the Maze exploration rewards for?... Want to know? ...Secret.
Speech.こっちにもやきそばパンがあって良かった。無かったら生きていけなかったかも。: I'm glad they have yakisoba pan here too. If they didn't, I might not have survived.
Speech.……お腹すいた。やきそばパン買いに行くね。: ...I'm hungry. Going to buy yakisoba pan.
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。お祝いは…やきそばパンでいい？: Happy birthday. For a gift... is yakisoba pan fine?
Speech.あけましておめでとう。……今年も楽しく過ごせたらいいね。: Happy New Year. ...Hope we can have fun this year too.
Speech.はい、チョコ。お返しは…わかってるよね？: Here, chocolates. As for the return gift... you know, right?
Speech.…1ヶ月経った。やきそばパン以外はいらない。: ...A month has passed. I don't need anything other than yakisoba pan.
Speech.私と付き合ってほしい。……ウソ。……わりとヘコんだ？ゴメン。: I want you to go out with me. ...Just kidding. ...Did that actually bum you out? Sorry.
Speech.……ウェディングドレス？なに？ もしかして、着て欲しい？: ...A wedding dress? What? Do you want me to wear one, by any chance?
Speech.願い事……やきそばパンの大流行。: My wish... for yakisoba pan to become super popular.
Speech.トリックオアトリート？イタズラかやきそばパン、選んで。: Trick or treat? Choose between a trick or yakisoba pan.
Speech.クリスマス……って何かするの？パーティー？いいね。やきそばパンもある？: Christmas... Do people do something? A party? Nice. Is there yakisoba pan too?
Speech.……誕生日？ 私の？ありがとう……すっかり忘れてた。: ...Birthday? Mine? Thank you... I completely forgot.
Speech.……あっ、セーフ。|やきそばパンは死守出来た。: ...Ah, safe. I managed to protect the yakisoba pan to the death.
Speech.いい天気……|空はこっちの世界も変わらない。: Nice weather... The sky doesn't change, even in this world.
Speech.参ったな……今度の仕事、ライブの日と被ってしまった……え？ なんのライブかって？: This is trouble... My upcoming job overlaps with a concert date... Eh? What concert? That's... um, an idol group's... No, it's nothing.
Speech.故郷のみんなは元気にしているだろうか。最近は忙しくて、なかなか顔を出せていないか: I wonder if everyone back in my hometown is doing well. I've been busy lately and haven't been able to visit much. I'd love to eat my mother's home cooking once in a while.
Speech.昼だし、何か食べないかって？ これでもモデルをやっているからな。食事には気をつけ: It's lunchtime, want to grab something to eat? I am a model, after all, so I watch my diet. Eating freely is... Eh? You're cooking...? ...Well, guess I can't help it then.
Speech.別に話すことがないというのなら、それでも構わない。何もしない時間というのは必要だ: If you don't have anything specific to talk about, that's fine too. Time spent doing nothing is necessary. I don't dislike that kind of thing either.
Speech.お前の誕生日か。それはめでたい。プレゼントなんだが、カルンバ伝統のアクセサリーな: It's your birthday, huh. That's cause for celebration. As for a present, something like traditional Karumba accessories... Ah, no, you probably don't want this. Eh? You're happy? Th-To have you be so happy makes me embarrassed...
Speech.あけましておめでとう。年末年始は仕事が入っていないから、一緒にのんびりと過ごせそ: Happy New Year. I don't have work scheduled for the holidays, so it looks like we can spend time relaxing together. How about staying in and unwinding in our room without going out?
Speech.そ、その……一応チョコレートあるんだが、いるか？ 同性のファンからもらうことはよ: Th-That... I have some chocolate, do you want it? I often receive them from female fans, but giving them to someone... especially someone of the opposite sex is a first for me. So I don't know if you'll like it, but...
Speech.ホワイトデー？ そのマカロンをくれるのか？ ファンの女子からよくもらうことはある: White Day? You're giving me these macarons? I get them from fan girls a lot, but come to think of it, receiving them from the opposite sex is a first. I almost feel like it's a waste to eat them.
Speech.エイプリルフールか……嘘をつくのはあまり得意ではない。こういう日こそ、意識的に誠: April Fools', is it... I'm not very good at lying. On a day like this, I want to consciously remain sincere.
Speech.そういえば、この前ジューンブライドの特集の撮影があったな。私はタキシードを着たよ: Speaking of which, I had a shoot for a June Bride feature the other day. I wore a tuxedo. Eh? A dress would suit me better...? Th-Then... will you dress me in one? J-Just kidding!
Speech.願い事……そんなの決まっている。『生まれ故郷が再び活気を取り戻すこと』だ。だが、: A wish... that's already set in stone. 'For my hometown to regain its vitality once more.' But lately, other wishes have been coming to mind too... Fufu, it's your fault, you know.
Speech.ハロウィンに便乗して、街全体で仮装パーティーをするイベントとかどうだろうか。これ: How about taking advantage of Halloween to throw a city-wide costume party event? If this could revitalize my hometown... Eh? Public safety would worsen? You might have a point there...
Speech.クリスマスだな……もしよければなんだが、仕事のあと少し会わないか？もちろん、ふた: It's Christmas... If it's alright with you, want to meet up for a bit after work? Of course, just the two of us...
Speech.私の誕生日……？ すっかり仕事ばかりで忘れていたな。まさか本人よりも%usern: My birthday...? I was so focused on work I completely forgot. To think that %usernameusernameuserna% remembered better than I did... Thank you.
Speech.どうだ、変なところはないか？|……って、そんなジロジロ見られると少し照れくさいな: How is it, does anything look weird? ...Wait, staring so intently makes me a little self-conscious.
Speech.このポーズでいいか？|撮り直しには何度でも応えよう。読者には最高のワンカットを届: Is this pose fine? I'll do as many retakes as needed. I want to deliver the best single cut for the readers.
Speech.このパターンはどうだ？|いろいろ試して、ベストを見つけたい。: How about this pattern? I want to try various things and find the best one.
Speech.昔から本を読むのが好き……というか、一緒に遊ぶような友達がいなくて、それくらいし: I've liked reading books for a long time... Or rather, I didn't have friends to play with, so that was about all I could do... But now I have companions who accept me, so my reading time might have decreased a bit.
Speech.少女漫画や恋愛ドラマのような恋に……少し憧れます。私なんかじゃ、できないってわか: I admire love stories like those in shojo manga or romance dramas... a little bit. I know someone like me can't have that... but if someone ever fell for someone like me, I... might fall head over heels for them.
Speech.甘いものが好きなのは美味しいから……というのはもちろんなんですが、食べていると心: I like sweet things because they're delicious... of course, but eating them also soothes my heart. I know I should go on a diet... but because of this, I just can't stop eating...
Speech.あれ？ %usernameusernameuserna%さん、今いないんですかね: Huh? Is %usernameusernameuserna%-san not here right now...? When I'm doing nothing, I get kind of hungry, and sleepy too, and, ah, also... Ugh.
Speech.た、誕生日、おめでとうございます……その……男の子にプレゼントなんて、人生初めて: H-Happy birthday... Um... giving a present to a boy is a first for me in my life, so I didn't know what to give... So, u-um... why don't we go shopping together?
Speech.あ、あけましておめでとうございます。お正月って、ずるいです。外はあまりお店やって: A-Ah, Happy New Year. The New Year holiday is so unfair. Not many shops are open outside, it's cold... so I just end up eating in my room and gaining weight... It's not my fault, right?
Speech.ちょ、チョコレートです。こういうの……異性にあげるの初めてで、気に入っていただけ: C-Chocolates. Giving something like this to a guy is a first for me, so I wonder if you'll like it... Eh? Eat them together...? I'm drooling...? I-I'm so sorry...!
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しにパフェ……チョコより好きだろうって？ ダ、ダイエット中なの: A parfait as a White Day return gift... You thought I'd like it more than chocolate? Even though I'm on a d-diet... I can make today a cheat day...? Th-Then I'm taking off the limiters, okay!? You're really sure!?
