Speech.新年おめでとうなのじゃ。今年も儂がそなたの右腕となり、勝利へと導いてやろう。……: Happy New Year. This year as well, I shall act as your right hand and lead us to victory. ...What, you want New Year's money? Just how old do you think I am? We're the same age, you know...
Speech.今日はバレンタイン。チョコレートを渡す良い催しじゃな、糖分は脳の活性化に必要不可: Today is Valentine's. A fine occasion to give chocolates; sugar is essential for brain activation. ...These are my favorite baked goods. I'll share them with you as a special exception. You better be grateful, alright?
Speech.ホワイトデー？ お返しとは律儀じゃな。うむ、せっかくだし、いただくかの。中身は…: White Day? A return gift shows proper etiquette. Mm, since you offer, I'll accept. The contents are... baked goods? You remembered my preference well. Hehe, perhaps that attentiveness is the secret to your popularity.
Speech.実は儂、本当は八十歳なのじゃよ……ふふ、驚いたかえ？ 今日は嘘をついても許される: Actually, I am eighty years old in truth... Fufu, surprised? Today is a day where lying is permitted, right? Eh? You thought it was true...? You really ought to treat that as a lie instead.
Speech.結婚か。人生における重大な契約の一つじゃな。共に歩む相手を選ぶのは、有効な戦術を: Marriage, is it? One of life's significant contracts. Choosing a partner to walk alongside might be more complex than choosing an effective tactic... I'd like you to tell me what kind of board state you would design.
Speech.短冊に願いを、か。儂はそなたや仲間たちとの平穏が続くようにと書いた……非合理な願: A wish on a paper strip, huh. I wrote that peace with you and our companions may continue... Go ahead and laugh at such an irrational wish. I am human too, so occasionally I wish to rely on a prayer.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリートじゃ！ 菓子をくれぬなら、そなたのＭＧにイタズラするぞ？: Trick or treat! If you don't give me treats, I'll mess with your MG! ...Fufu, surprised? Just a joke. However, I don't dislike sweet snacks. Hand them over quickly.
Speech.メリークリスマス。雪の降る夜も、そなたの隣にいれば寒くはないのう……さあ、今夜は: Merry Christmas. Even on a snowy night, it isn't cold when I'm beside you... Come, tonight is special. I shall permit you to spend it by my side. You... wish to spend it with me too, right?
Speech.儂の誕生日を祝ってくれるのかえ？ 感謝するのじゃ。同年代の異性に祝われたのは初め: You're celebrating my birthday? You have my thanks. This is the first time I've been celebrated by a male peer. I'd be happy if you celebrated it with me next year, the year after, and beyond.
Speech.ほれ、たくさん撫でるのじゃ。|うむ、儂からもよしよししてやるぞい。いい子なのじゃ: Here, pat me lots. Mm, I'll pat you too. Good boy.
Speech.そなたの手は大きいのう……|こうして撫でられていると、儂もおなごであることを思い: Your hands are so big... Being patted like this reminds me that I am a girl too.
Speech.くすっ、顔が赤くなっておるのう。|もっと素直に甘えていいのじゃぞ？: Hehe, your face is turning red. You can be more honest and pamper yourself, you know?
Speech.私たちが操縦する戦術機とこちらのＭＧ……奇妙なほどに共通点がある……。それを解明: The TSFs we pilot and the MGs here... share a strange number of common points... If we can unravel this, we might be able to bring back new technology.
Speech.初めて天然の食材を収穫したが、まさか篁示現流が通用しないとは……。私もまだまだ未: It was my first time harvesting natural ingredients, but to think the Takamura Jigen-ryu wouldn't work... I am still far too inexperienced...
Speech.ブリッジス少尉や他の皆と共に転移をしたのは不幸中の幸いだった。正直なところ、私一: Transferring here together with Lieutenant Bridges and the others was a blessing in disguise. Honestly, what would have become of me if I were alone...
Speech.う、うぅむ、やはり落ち着かないな……確かに、ヘイワード殿たちが勧めてくれた店で買: U-Umm, as expected, I can't settle down... It's true that what I bought at the store Hayward-dono and the others recommended fits perfectly and is easy to move in... But thinking that I am wearing something so cute... ugh.
Speech.誕生日おめでとうございます。あなたの一年が幸多きものになるように願っております。: Happy birthday. I wish you a year filled with happiness.
Speech.新年あけましておめでとう。振袖を着る文化がこちらにもあるのだな。ふふふ……いやな: Happy New Year. So the culture of wearing furisode exists here too. Fufufu... No, I just felt a bit nostalgic. I look forward to working with you this year as well.
Speech.今日は菓子を贈って感謝を表す日と聞いた。部下達とピクシス・マスールの方々にも渡し: I heard today is a day to express gratitude by giving sweets. I just finished handing them out to my subordinates and the people of Pyxis Ma Soeur. Please allow me to give some to you as well.
Speech.ほわいとでー……？バレンタインデーのお返し？そんなつもりではなかったのだが…。い: White Day...? A return gift for Valentine's Day? I didn't intend it that way... No, refusing would be rude. Then, I shall gratefully accept.
Speech.な、なに！？不知火・弐型が破損しただと！？よし、すぐに現地へ向かう！……ウソだと: Wh-What!? The Shiranui Second is damaged!? Alright, I'm heading to the site immediately! ...A lie? What broke was just a replica made for testing? —I am not amused.
Speech.家を繋いでいくには跡取りが必要。つまり結婚して子を儲けなければならない。しかして: An heir is necessary to carry on the family line. Meaning I must marry and bear a child. However, I have no fiancé, nor any gentleman I wish to take as a groom... None! C-Certainly none! Yep!
Speech.世界が平和になりますように……短冊に書くだけでそれが叶うのならば私たち衛士は必要: 'May the world become peaceful'... If writing that on a paper strip could make it come true, we surface pilots wouldn't be needed. ...Yet, I can't help but wish for it anyway.
Speech.……とりっく、おあ、とりーと……。いや、その、こういった催しにも進んで参加して、: ...Trick, or, treat... No, um, I was advised that actively participating in such events to understand the world is important for one who protects the people...
Speech.このあと催されるクリスマスパーティーで出される料理の一品を私が担当させてもらった: I was put in charge of one of the dishes served at the Christmas party held after this. I'd be glad if you tasted it too.
Speech.ああ、今日は私の誕生日だったか……パーティーを用意したから来てほしい？……偶には: Ah, today was my birthday, was it... You prepared a party and want me to come? ...Taking it easy once in a while sounds nice... Thank you.
Speech.ふむ、なるほど……|ここのエリアは重要だな。皆にも共有しなければ……: Hm, I see... This area is important. I must share this with everyone...
Speech.ここにもコンビニが……ふふっ……|すまない、昔の事を思い出してしまったんだ。: There's a convenience store here too... Fufu... Sorry, I just remembered something from the past.
Speech.このシティというエリアは本当に広いな……|案内されたところは……確かこのエリアだ: This area called the City is truly vast... The place I was guided to... should be in this area, if I recall...
Speech.こっちの世界の飯って種類多すぎないか？毎回違うもの見つけるたびに、つい試したくな: Isn't there way too much variety of food in this world? Every time I find something different, I can't help wanting to try it.
Speech.この前ちょっと街を見て回ったんだけどさ、面白いもの多いよな。見慣れない店とか物と: I looked around the town a bit the other day, and there are so many interesting things. Unfamiliar shops and items always make me stop out of curiosity.
Speech.ベテランのメイドを見るとさ、すげーなって思うことがあるんだ。動きに無駄がなくて、: Whenever I see a veteran maid, I think 'wow, that's amazing.' There's no wasted motion, and watching them is actually kind of cool.
Speech.うーん、なんか暇だなぁ……。体動かさないと落ち着かないし、ちょっと走ってくるかな: Mmm, I'm kind of bored... I feel restless if I don't move my body, maybe I'll go for a run.
Speech.誕生日おめでと！今日はお前が主役なんだから、遠慮しないで楽しまなきゃ損だぞ！: Happy birthday! You're the star today, so if you don't enjoy yourself without holding back, you're missing out!
Speech.あけましておめでとさん。せっかくだし今年は楽しいこといっぱいやりたいよな。……ま: Happy New Year. Since it's a new year, I wanna do tons of fun things. ...Well, I'll do my missions properly too, of course. Looking forward to working with you this year!
Speech.今日は世話になってるやつにお菓子を渡す日なんだってな。ほら、あたしからもやるよ！: I heard today is the day to give treats to people who look after you. Here, I'm giving you some too! Don't take it the wrong way, okay!?
Speech.え、お菓子くれんの？ あ、この間のお返しか！へへ、それでも嬉しいよ。ありがとな！: Eh, you're giving me treats? Ah, a return gift for the other day! Hehe, I'm still super happy about it. Thanks!
Speech.ごきげんよう。あたくし、本日より気品溢れる令嬢として振る舞うことにいたしましたの: Good day. Starting today, I have decided to conduct myself as an elegant young lady... Pfft, ahaha, just kidding! I heard today is called April Fools', a day where it's okay to lie!
Speech.結婚式って、なんかキラキラしてていいよなー。……あたし？ いやいや、まだそういう: Weddings are all sparkly and nice, aren't they... Me? No, no, it's way too early for me!
Speech.願い事かぁ……みんなで笑って飯食える毎日、とかかな。平和な世界って、案外そういう: A wish, huh... Maybe 'every day being able to laugh and eat meals together with everyone.' A peaceful world might just be something like that after all.
Speech.とりっくおあとりーと！ ……へへ、言ってみたかったんだよな。ほら、お菓子くれよ！: Trick or treat! ...Hehe, I really wanted to say that. Come on, hand over the treats! If you don't, I'll play a trick on you~
Speech.街中キラキラしてるし、なんかテンション上がるよな！せっかくだし今日は難しいこと抜: The whole town is sparkling, it really pumps you up! Since we're here, let's just enjoy today without thinking about complicated stuff!
Speech.あたしの誕生日……覚えてたのかよ。ま、せっかくだし今日は遠慮なしで楽しませてもら: You remembered my birthday... Well, since you did, I'm gonna enjoy myself today without holding back!
Speech.うおっ……ベッドの上で朝飯って贅沢すぎないか？|しかもこれ、普通にうまいな！: Whoa... Isn't eating breakfast in bed way too luxurious? Plus, this is genuinely delicious!
Speech.これこれ！なあ、こういうのがお嬢様ってやつだよな？|想像してた通りって感じで、ち: This, right here! Hey, this is what being a rich young lady is like, right? It feels just like I imagined, makes me kinda happy!
Speech.え、朝からここまで全部やってもらっていいのかよ？|なんかダメ人間になりそうだけど: Eh, is it really fine to have everything done for me since morning? Feels like I'm gonna turn into a total slacker... well, once in a while is fine!
Speech.お茶の世界も、思っていたよりずっと奥深いのね。香りや温度だけで、こんなに印象が変: The world of tea is much deeper than I thought too. It's fascinating how much the impression changes just from scent and temperature.
Speech.メイド服って、もっと窮屈なものだと思っていたの。でも意外と機能的で、よく考えられ: I thought maid outfits would be much more restrictive. But they are surprisingly functional and well thought out.
Speech.この前使った新鮮な食材、本当に美味しかったわね。……ああいう平穏を知れたことは、: Those fresh ingredients we used the other day were truly delicious. ...Experiencing that kind of peacefulness will surely be a source of support after returning to our original world.
Speech.この世界は、本当に穏やかな時間が流れているのね。……こういう空気は、嫌いじゃない: Time truly flows peacefully in this world. ...I don't dislike this kind of atmosphere.
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。あなたにとって良い一年になることを願っているわ。: Happy birthday. I hope this year brings wonderful things for you.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。今年もいい一年になるように気を引き締めて、でも時には緩める: Happy New Year. Let's stay focused to make this a great year, but remember to loosen up once in a while, too.
Speech.はい、チョコレート。ふふ……ちゃんと、あなたのためを思って選んだものよ。大事に味: Here, chocolates. Fufu... I selected them carefully with you in mind. Savor them carefully.
Speech.お返しを用意してくれたのね。ありがとう。……もしかして、結構真剣に悩んで選んでく: You prepared a return gift for me. Thank you. ...Could it be that you thought really hard while choosing it?
Speech.ねえ、実はずっとあなたのこと……ふふ、そんなに赤くならないで。今日はエイプリルフ: Hey, actually I've always thought of you... Fufu, don't turn so red. Today is April Fools', isn't it?
Speech.幸せそうな花嫁を見ると、こちらまで温かい気持ちになるわね。誰かと穏やかな時間を重: Seeing a happy bride makes me feel warm inside too. Building peaceful moments with someone is a wonderful thing.
Speech.願い事を書く文化って、不思議だけれど嫌いじゃないわ。言葉にすることで、少し前を向: The culture of writing down wishes is intriguing, and I rather like it. Put into words, it can help one look forward a bit.
Speech.とりっくおあとりーと、だったかしら。……ふふ、お菓子をくれないなら少し困らせてし: 'Trick or treat', was it? ...Fufu, if you don't give me treats, I might trouble you just a little.
Speech.メリークリスマス。街の灯りが綺麗ね。こういう静かな賑わいは、見ていて落ち着くわ。: Merry Christmas. The city lights are beautiful. This quiet bustle is soothing to watch.
Speech.誕生日を祝ってもらえるのね。……ありがとう、素直に嬉しいわ。: So you're celebrating my birthday. ...Thank you, I am genuinely happy.
Speech.ふふっ、おつかれさま。|お茶を淹れたから良ければどうぞ。熱いから気を付けてね。: Fufu, good work. I brewed some tea, so please have some if you'd like. It's hot, so be careful.
Speech.まさか私がメイドさんになるなんてね……|ちょっと恥ずかしいけれどこれもいい経験…: To think that I'd become a maid... It's a bit embarrassing, but it's a good experience... I'm having a nice dream.
Speech.もしよかったら話を聞かせてもらえるかしら？|私に何が出来るかはわからないけれど…: If you'd like, would you tell me what's on your mind? I don't know what I can do, but... I want to be of help to you.
Speech.……頭を使うと甘いものが食べたくなるのよ。あんた、今から私と一緒にパフェを食べに: ...When I use my brain, I crave sweet things. You, come go get a parfait with me right now. Naturally, it's your treat.
Speech.偽善者や自由を縛ってくるようなやつ……特に自分より上に立って見下してくるようなや: I hate hypocrites and people who restrict freedom... especially those who stand above me and look down on me. As for the drill commander... well, there's an exception to every rule.
Speech.私は神楽と同じ顔だけど、あいつみたいに手ぬるいやり方はしない。言い換えれば、あい: I have the same face as Kagura, but I don't use soft methods like she does. In other words, I execute what she can't... division of labor.
Speech.……やっと起きたわね。あんたの寝顔、無防備すぎてバカみたいだったわ。……でも、そ: ...Finally awake, huh. Your sleeping face was way too defenseless, you looked like an idiot. ...Though I guess I don't dislike that peaceful face either.
Speech.今日はあんたの誕生日でしょ。特別に双頭の斧総出で盛大にお祝いしてあげるわ。……感: Today is your birthday, right? As a special exception, the entire Twin-Headed Axe will celebrate lavishly for you. ...Be grateful, I'm personally helping with the preparations.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。まさかあんたなんかと年越しすることになるとはね……本当、人: Happy New Year. To think I'd be ringing in the New Year with someone like you... Life really is unpredictable. For now... well, I'll treat you well this year too.
Speech.これ、あげる。ただの義理なんだから、勘違いしないでよね。……でも、一応あんたの好: Here, take this. It's just out of obligation, so don't get the wrong idea. ...Though I made it specially tailored to your tastes, so make sure to savor it.
Speech.お返し……？ 別に期待なんてしてなかったけど、もらえるなら貰っておくわ。……味は: A return gift...? I wasn't expecting anything, but I'll take it if you're offering. ...The taste isn't bad. Make sure you prepare at least this much next year too.
Speech.実は私、組織のリーダーを辞めて、普通の女の子になろうと思ってるの。……は？ 本当: Actually, I'm thinking of stepping down as leader of the organization and becoming an ordinary girl. ...Huh? Of course it's not real. I was just teasing.
Speech.ウェディングドレス……綺麗だとは思うけど、私には縁がないわね。……えっ、似合うと: A wedding dress... I think it's pretty, but it has nothing to do with me. ...Eh, you think it'd suit me? Wh-What, don't say weird things all of a sudden...
Speech.短冊の願い事？ そもそも自分より上位の存在にすがって、願い事なんてしたくないわ。: A wish on a paper strip? I don't want to cling to some higher being and make a wish in the first place. Wishes are things you fulfill with your own power.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリートよ。お菓子をくれないなら、あんたの全財産をうちの組織に没: Trick or treat. If you don't give me treats, our organization will confiscate your entire net worth. ...Obviously a joke. Instead, hurry up and buy me a parfait.
Speech.シティが浮かれてるわね。双頭の斧のみんなに、少しくらい美味しいものを食べさせてあ: The City is making a fuss, huh. Maybe I'll let everyone in Twin-Headed Axe eat something nice for once. So you, figure something out using your Student Council authority.
Speech.私の誕生日？ 同位生成体の私にそんなもの祝う意味なんて……えっ、プレゼント？ …: My birthday? What's the point of celebrating that for a clone like me... Eh, a present? ...Th-Thanks. If it's from you, I'll accept it.
Speech.何……じっと見ないでくれる？|いちいち私の反応が面白い……？ あんた、ぶん殴られ: What... Stop staring at me, will you? Finding my reactions funny every single time...? You wanna get punched?
Speech.ん？ あんた、どこ見て……！|さっきから変な視線感じると思ったのよ！ 覚悟はでき: Nn? Where are you looking...! I thought I felt a weird gaze on me for a while! Hope you're prepared...!
Speech.双頭の斧……ね。|ただただ駒として使い捨てるためだけの組織……だったはずなのに。: Twin-Headed Axe... huh. It was supposed to be an organization purely meant for throwing away pawns...
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……なんで、皆さんお菓子を渡: %usernameusernameuserna%-san... Why is everyone trying to hand me treats...? I just forgot my change of clothes after going to inspect the pool...
Speech.……うーん、誰もいないのかぁ。んん……ちょっと寂しくなってきちゃったかも……よー: ...Mmm, nobody's here, huh. Mm... I might be feeling a bit lonely... Alright, I'll go see if I can find someone I know♪
Speech.あけましておめでとう。さっそく驚かせちゃおうって、この服で来たけど……ふふっ、そ: Happy New Year. I wore this outfit to surprise you right off the bat, but... Fufu, judging from that face, it looks like it was super effective♪
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます……っ！ こっ、今年の目標は、ドジの回数を減らすこ: Happy New Year...! M-My goal for this year is to reduce the number of clumsy mistakes I make! Eh? Why am I in a swimsuit...? Well, I spilled a drink on my uniform earlier...
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ えへへ、新年は大好きなんだ！皆がとっても楽しい空気になっ: Happy New Year! Ehehe, I love the New Year! Everyone gets into such a fun mood, just watching makes my heart feel warm!
Speech.あたしに夢中になっちゃいそう？|じっくり見てちょうだい、そのための水着なんだから: Are you about to fall head over heels for me? Take a good look, that's what this swimsuit is for...♪
Speech.あたしの水着を見て、ただで帰れるなんて思わないことね。まずは、じっくり感想を聞か: Don't think you can see my swimsuit and just walk away for free. First, let me hear your detailed thoughts♪
Speech.あっ……！ な、なんでしょうか……？|うう……じ、じっと見られると恥ずかしいです: Ah...! Wh-What is it...? Ugh... B-Being stared at so intently is embarrassing...!
Speech.あははは……！|ふぅ……こうやって童心に帰って遊ぶのも、悪くありませんね。: Ahahaha...! Phew... Playing around like this and returning to a child's heart isn't bad at all.
Speech.ありがとうって誰かに言ってもらえると、自分がすっごく満たされるの！だから、%us: Hearing someone say thank you fills me up with happiness! So I'm gonna have you say 'thank you' lots to me too, okay, %usernameusernameuserna%-san?
Speech.いきますよ、えいっ！ えいっ！|こ、こうして誰かと水をかけ合って遊ぶなんて……わ: Here I go, take that! Take that! Sp-Splashing water and playing like this with someone... Is someone like me really fine...
Speech.いつも私を支えてくれる仲間達だからこそ、きちんと休んでほしいですし、楽しんでほし: Precisely because they are companions who always support me, I want them to rest properly and have fun. Not a single person can be missing; the Disciplinary Committee exists because of everyone.
Speech.うぅ……この格好でひとりだと、心細いです……どこか人気のない、涼しくて、それでゆ: Ugh... Being alone in this outfit feels so helpless... Isn't there somewhere quiet, cool, and relaxing around here...
Speech.え、えっと……実はわたし、今度の公式戦にも、水着で出ますっ！……うぅ……う、嘘で: U-Umm... Actually, I'll be participating in the next official match in a swimsuit too! ...Ugh... I-It's a lie. April Fools' is definitely too much of an event for me...!
Speech.えっ、ホワイトデーのお返し？ えへへ、ありがと！せっかくなら温かい飲み物を入れて: Eh, a White Day return gift? Ehehe, thanks! Since we're here, let's pour a hot drink and have tea together♪
Speech.えっ、私の誕生日……？ あ、ありがとう……えへへ……こんな風にお祝いをされるなん: Eh, my birthday...? Th-Thank you... ehehe... I was so surprised to be celebrated like this... but I'm really happy.
Speech.えーっと、ちょっと位置調整……|男の人の背中って大きいね！ ちょっと普段と感覚が: Umm, adjusting position a bit... A man's back is so big! The feeling is a bit different from usual...!
Speech.お、お誕生日、おめでとうございます……っ！水着だと喜んでもらえるって、アニスちゃ: H-Happy birthday...! Anise-chan said that you'd be happy if I wore a swimsuit... A-Are you happy...?
Speech.お客さん、凝ってますね～|色んな本を読んでしっかり勉強したんだよ♪ 結構気持ちい: Customer, you're really stiff~ I read lots of books and studied hard♪ Feels pretty good, right~?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます、%usernameusernameuserna%さ: Happy birthday, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. Fufu, since we're here, why don't we swim together and make memories just for today?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。プレゼントは用意しているので、後でお渡ししますね。: Happy birthday. I prepared a present, so I'll give it to you later. ...Eh? Me in this outfit is the greatest present? What do you mean by that?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ 今日はあなたのやりたいこと、できる限り叶えてあげるよ！それ: Happy birthday! Today, I'll grant as many things you want to do as possible! So starting right away, what do you wanna do~!?
Speech.お願い事は『もっと%usernameusernameuserna%があたしに夢中: My wish is 'May %usernameusernameuserna% become even more head over heels for me'... But just wishing isn't enough, I have to make it real myself. So I'll tempt you in this outfit♪

Speech.ふふっ……とってもきれいですね……！|とってもきれいな夕陽……一緒に見られて、ほ: Fufu... It's so beautiful...! Such a beautiful sunset... I'm tr-truly glad we could watch it together.

Speech.私より、誰かの願いが叶った方がいい。私の願いは、もう叶わないから。でも、もしかし: Rather than mine, it's better if someone else's wish comes true. Because my wish won't come true anymore. But maybe... I can find a new wish. If I'm together with %usernameusernameuserna%.
Speech.結婚式って超高いらしいじゃん？ だから絶対やらないって決めてるんだよね。おまえは: Weddings are supposedly super expensive, right? That's why I decided I'm definitely never having one. What about you? Well, not like you have the means to pay full price... No no no, scratch that last part!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。プレゼントはちょっと待ってて、今狩ってくるから。……それとも、: Happy birthday. Wait a bit for your present, I'm going to hunt for it now. ...Or do you want to come along?
Speech.足……あんまり、見ないで。|不思議……%usernameusernameuser: My legs... Don't look so much. Strange... When being looked at by %usernameusernameuserna%... I feel a bit unusual.
Speech.騒動が終わってからでいいけど……もっと、父さんのことを知りたい。まだ、私の知らな: It can wait until after the disturbance ends... but I want to know more about my father. There are still so many things I don't know...
Speech.あけましておめでとう……これでよいか？ 式典などならいざ知らず、格式ばった季節事: Happy New Year... Is this fine? Setting ceremonies aside, I am not good with formal seasonal events. Normally I leave it to Nina... but I thought I should at least give greetings to you myself...
Speech.あけましておめでとう。ジーナは、堅苦しいのは嫌いだから～って、こういうお祝い事は: Happy New Year. Gina says she dislikes formal atmosphere, so she leaves these celebrations entirely to me. I wish she'd come out once in a while.
Speech.いつも代わりに戦ってもらってばかりで……本当はもっとジーナの力になりたい。だから: Always having you fight in my place... Honestly I want to be of more help to Gina. So I'll work harder too. Will you watch over me by my side?
Speech.えっと……これ、もらってくれないかな。私とジーナ、ふたりからのチョコレート。その: Umm... Could you accept this? Chocolates from both me and Gina. Well, we argued over making it sweet or bitter, so it ended up with a normal taste... How is it?
Speech.え？ これって、ホワイトデーのお返し？ えへへ、ありがとう♪開けてみるね……わぁ: Eh? Is this a White Day return gift? Ehehe, thank you♪ I'll open it... Wow, delicious-looking caramels. I love these kinds of things.
Speech.お前のためのチョコレートだ、受け取るがいい。味わいは……我は苦味を強く出そうとし: These chocolates are for you, accept them. As for the taste... I tried to make the bitterness stronger, but Nina said sweet was better. It ended up with a flavor right in between, but well, it shouldn't be bad.
Speech.お前の誕生日が今日だと聞いた。ニーナと共にケーキを作ったから、受け取ってくれ。…: I heard your birthday is today. I made a cake together with Nina, so accept it. ...It may be blunt, but please continue to look after Nina in the future.
Speech.と、トリックオアトリート……ええっと、その……お菓子は、持ってる？ジーナは力で奪: Tr-Trick or treat... Umm, so... do you have treats? Gina says to take them by force... but I think I'd rather eat them together, just the two of us.
Speech.はっ、はっ、はっ……|……ええい、くしゃみが出そうで出ないぞ！ なんとかしてくれ: Ha, ha, hach- ...Agh, a sneeze is coming but won't come out! Do something, %usernameusernameuserna%!
Speech.ふっ、やはりレドフカ文学を読む時間は何にも代えがたい。この重厚さは他では味わえん: Hmph, reading Redovka literature is truly irreplaceable. This depth cannot be tasted anywhere else. Hm? What's wrong, Nina... You want something lighter? Agh, don't be selfish!
Speech.む、これはなんだ？ バレンタインデーの返礼品……？礼には礼で返すというわけか、い: Mm, what's this? A return gift for Valentine's Day...? Repaying courtesy with courtesy, a admirable attitude. In that case, I shall gratefully accept!
Speech.やっぱり、こういう大衆向けの小説はいいなぁ。ゾリャーだとなかなか読むことがないし: Popular fiction like this really is great after all. We rarely get to read it in Zorya... Eh? Make it military history? Geez, Gina, you're always all about that, aren't you?
Speech.わっ、ありがとう……！ 私の誕生日、覚えててくれたんだね……えへへ、せっかくなら: Wow, thank you...! You remembered my birthday... Ehehe, since we're here, I want to stay together a bit longer. Ah, but... make sure to celebrate for Gina too, okay?
Speech.わぶっ！ な、何だ！？|ええい、悪戯な風というやつか。我にちょっかいを出すとは、: Wabuh!? Wh-What is it!? Agh, a mischievous wind? meddling with me, I shall acknowledge that spirit of yours.
Speech.ウェディングドレスって、やっぱり憧れちゃうなあ……もし私が式を挙げるなら、どうな: A wedding dress really is something I admire after all... If I were to hold a ceremony, I wonder how it'd be? My dress, Gina's dress, plus outfit changes for each... Four dresses would be essential, I guess.
Speech.ジューンブライド……こういった催しは、我でなくニーナの方が似合うだろう。我が纏う: June Bride... An event like this suits Nina rather than me. What I should wear is combat armor... Y-You say a dress would suit me? Wh-What are you saying!
Speech.ジーナが表に出てる時でも、何を見てるか、何を聞いてるか、起きていれば一緒に感じら: Even when Gina is out on the surface, as long as I'm awake I can feel what she sees and hears. Even if I fell asleep, I can just have Gina tell me later.
Speech.ジーナは、気づいたら私の中にいた。今はもう、何より大事な……家族みたいな感じかな: Gina was inside me before I realized it. Now she's most important... like family, I guess. What we can do is different and we divide duties... but relying entirely on her for battles makes me feel inadequate.
Speech.トリックオアトリート、さあ菓子を寄越すがいい！ ……ん？ そんなに菓子を食べたい: Trick or Treat, now hand over the sweets! ...Hm? You ask if I want to eat sweets that much? Naturally! I shall eat the sweets taken from you, together with you!
Speech.メリークリスマス。肌寒いと、故郷を思い出して……少し懐かしくなっちゃうんだ。ねぇ: Merry Christmas. When it's chilly, I remember home... and feel a little nostalgic. Hey, will you stay with me today? Including Gina, I think three of us would be fun.
Speech.メリークリスマス！ この季節は故郷を思い出し、気分が高揚するな！さぁ、今日は我ら: Merry Christmas! This season brings memories of home and raises the spirits! Come, spend today with us! Nina, and, well... I-I wish for it too!
Speech.与えられるだけの明日など不要だ！ 今日を生きて、自分の意思で掴み取らねば、未来に: A tomorrow merely handed to us is unnecessary! Unless we live today and grasp it with our own will, the future has no value. That is precisely why we fight, is it not?
Speech.嘘をつくのって、苦手だな……でも、そういう日なんだよね。えっと、それじゃあ……あ: I'm bad at lying... but it's that kind of day, right? Umm, then... 'I don't want to be with you, because it's uncomfortable'... Is this kind of feeling right?
Speech.我が表に出ている間、ニーナはどうしているのかだと？寝ている時もあれば、起きて我と: You ask what Nina does while I am out on the surface? Sometimes she sleeps, other times she is awake seeing and hearing the same things as me. The same applies to me while Nina is out.
Speech.我が誕生日はニーナと同一！ それを祝おうとは、殊勝な心掛けだな！ならばこの我と一: My birthday is the same as Nina's! Celebrating it shows an admirable attitude! Then I shall grant you the right to spend a day with me! ...Don't forget to celebrate Nina later, got it?
Speech.我の願い？ それは――端的に言えば、最も大切な存在に、幸福に暮らしてほしいという: My wish? Simply put—I want my most precious presence to live happily. But entrusting this wish to stars is impossible. Until I seize it with my own hands at the end of the struggle!
Speech.我は『今日』を生きる！|与えられた明日など要らぬ、我らは今日という日に燃え上がる: I live for 'today'! We need no handed-down tomorrow, we are the flames burning brightly in this very day!
Speech.生きるということは、幸せなことだ。お前も、ニーナも、当たり前のように生を享受でき: To live is a happy thing. You and Nina enjoying life as a matter of course... that is fine.
Speech.突然だが、我という人格はもうじき消える。ニーナのことを、よろしく頼むぞ……なんて: Suddenly, my persona will vanish soon. Please take care of Nina... Just kidding. Today is that kind of day, right? But seeing you genuinely shaken was quite a sight. Hmph... honestly...
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。ジーナと一緒に、頑張ってケーキを作って来たんだ。良かったら一緒: Happy birthday. I worked hard with Gina to make a cake. Want to eat it together? May your next year be a wonderful time... Also, please look after Gina too if you like.
Speech.願い事……いつもジーナに戦ってもらってるから、ジーナが無事に帰ってきますように、: A wish... Since Gina always fights for me, 'May Gina return safely', I guess. But honestly, I wish I could fight as much as her too...
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん、あけましておめでとうござい: Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%-san! When you're ready, let's go for the first shrine visit. Spending New Year's sleeping is not allowed.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%は留守ですか……ナージャ、しばし: Is %usernameusernameuserna% away...? Nadja, we'll have to wait a short while, is that alright? | Yes. When %usernameusernameuserna%-san returns, let's greet him together.
Speech.……今回はナージャにどのようなプレゼントを贈るべきでしょうか。いえ、案が尽きたわ: ...What kind of present should I give to Nadja this time? No, it's not that I ran out of ideas. It's just that if you think about it with me, that child would surely be happier...
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。ナージャと初詣に行くのですが、あなたも来ますか？: Happy New Year. I am going for the first shrine visit with Nadja, will you come too? ...Yes, she will surely be delighted. Then please prepare immediately.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。今日は、お母様と一緒に三人で初詣に行きましょう。: Happy New Year. Today let's go for the first shrine visit, all three of us with Mother. Mother is already waiting, so let me know when you're ready.
Speech.いつかはナージャも、ウェディングドレスを着る日が来るはずです。……どのようなデザ: Someday a day will come when Nadja wears a wedding dress too. ...Should I start considering what kind of design to make from now on?
Speech.いつか私も、お母様みたいな素敵な、ドレスの似合う女の人になりたいです。[3]|ナ: Someday I want to become a wonderful woman who looks great in dresses like Mother too. | Nadja's dress... I must consider the design and details. Naturally, your opinion is necessary for that as well.
Speech.お母様、お誕生日おめでとうございます！ また次の一年も、一緒にいてくださいね。[: Mother, happy birthday! Please stay with me for another year too. | ...Yes, of course. I am here to raise Nadja into a fine person, after all.
Speech.お母様みたいなパイロットになりたい――その願いに変わりはありません。でも今は、た: I want to become a pilot like Mother—that wish remains unchanged. But now, it's not just that... I want to see more outside of Zorya...
Speech.お母様も、%usernameusernameuserna%さんも、クラスナの皆さ: Mother, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, and everyone from Krasna aren't here... Somehow... it feels very quiet...
Speech.お誕生日、おめでとうございます。お母様に手伝ってもらって、ケーキを作ってみました: Happy birthday. I tried making a cake with Mother's help. I hope it suits your taste... Will you accept my celebration?
Speech.きっとお母様なら、どんなドレスも似合うんでしょうね。私もそういう素敵な女性になれ: Surely Mother would look great in any dress. If I could become such a wonderful woman too... at that time, um, will you praise me?
Speech.きっとこれから、ゾリャーは他の校舎と関わっていって……色んな事が変わっていきます: Surely from now on, Zorya will interact with other school buildings... and various things will change. But if %usernameusernameuserna%-san is with me, I'm not afraid of anything.
Speech.こ、このパイロットスーツ、身体のラインが出ちゃって、ちょっと恥ずかしいですね。で: Th-This pilot suit reveals body lines, so it's a bit embarrassing. But Mother isn't shaken in the slightest... As expected. I must follow her example.
Speech.こうしてひとりで過ごすのは、久々かもしれません。最近は任務続きでしたから。……静: Spending time alone like this might be the first time in a while. It was mission after mission lately. ...It's quiet. I should have liked silence more before, though...
Speech.ここに来るまでに、仮装をしていると勘違いされ、随分と菓子をねだられました。しかし: On the way here, people mistook me for wearing a costume and begged for quite a few treats. However, I prepared plenty extra, so there are shares for Nadja, and for you as well.
Speech.このスーツに着替えてから、普段よりも%usernameusernameusern: Ever since changing into this suit, I feel like %usernameusernameuserna%'s gaze is stronger than usual... | Ah... W-Well, %usernameusernameuserna%-san does seem like he'd like this kind of style after all...
Speech.この季節は、レドフカで過ごしていたころを思い出します。お母様が任務の合間に会いに: This season reminds me of the time I spent in Redovka. Mother would come visit me between missions, and I couldn't wait for those days to come... But now we can stay together all the time, so I'm very happy.
Speech.この戦い、ふたりなら……[2]|最も信頼するあなたと共に操縦するのならば、恐れる: This battle, with the two of us... | If I am piloting alongside you, whom I trust the most, there is nothing to fear. | Me too... since I can fight alongside Mother, I'll do my absolute best!
Speech.これ、バレンタインのお返しですか……？ ありがとうございますっ。せっかくですから: Is this... a return gift for Valentine's...? Thank you so much! Since we're here, why don't we have some tea? I'd love to eat them together with you.
Speech.これから先、ゾリャー、そしてレドフカは外部との交流を避けて通れないでしょう。なら: From now on, Zorya, and Redovka as well, won't be able to avoid interactions with the outside world. If that is the case, we should at least aim for a good, mutually beneficial relationship. Please lend us your strength for that purpose.
Speech.これが新型のパイロットスーツ……恥ずかしくないのか、ですか？機体を操縦するために: So this is the new pilot suit... Am I embarrassed, you ask? It's necessary to pilot the unit, so not particularly.
Speech.どうぞ、バレンタインのチョコレートです。ナージャと相談し、異なる風味のものを用意: Here, these are Valentine's Day chocolates. I consulted with Nadja and prepared ones with different flavors. The one I made is dark chocolate. Please enjoy it together with this tea.
Speech.どうぞ、私からのバレンタインチョコレートです。お母様と相談して、違う風味にしてみ: Here, these are Valentine's Day chocolates from me. I consulted with Mother and tried making a different flavor. The one I made is sweet white chocolate... Please enjoy every bite.
Speech.わ、私の誕生日祝いですか？ ありがとうございますっ……！えっ、何でも欲しいものを: A-A birthday celebration for me...? Thank you so much...! Eh, tell you whatever I want? In that case... could you stay by my side all day today?
Speech.チェック、オールグリーン……[2]|全火器、並びに遠隔攻撃端末『ストレラ』の待機: Check, all green... | All weapons, as well as the remote attack terminal 'Strela', have been confirmed to transition to standby mode. | Yes, with this we can begin combat at any time... I'll be relying on your strength, Mother.
Speech.ト、トリックオアトリート……！ あ、あの、お菓子をいただければと……！え？ もっ: T-Trick or treat...! U-Umm, I was hoping to get some treats...! Eh? I should be more confident? T-Trick or treat! ...Ugh, this is tough.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート……このように、もう一度です。今度は迫力を出すイメージで: Trick or treat... Like this, try it once more. This time, imagine projecting impact. | T-Trick or treat! Ugh... As expected, I can't pull it off smoothly like Mother does...
Speech.ナージャ、新しいスーツには慣れましたか？ 着心地に違和感などあれば言ってください: Nadja, have you gotten used to the new suit? Tell me if there's any discomfort in how it fits. | Thank you, Mother. I'm fine... although it's a little embarrassing.
Speech.ナージャ、誕生日おめでとうございます。またひとつ年を重ね、大きくなりましたね。[: Nadja, happy birthday. You've grown another year older and bigger. | Yes! But... when will I ever become a wonderful woman like Mother...
Speech.バレンタインのお返しを、私とお母様に？ わあ、ありがとうございます……！[3]|: A Valentine's return gift for both me and Mother? Wow, thank you so much...! | Since we're here, shall we eat them together? I'll go prepare some tea, so please wait here with Nadja.
Speech.バレンタインの返礼ですか……律義な人ですね、ありがたく受け取ります。\nせっかく:
A return gift for Valentine's Day...? You are quite a dutiful person, I gratefully accept.
Since we're here, let's eat them together. I'll go brew some tea now.
Speech.他の校舎の皆さんと話していると、ザルトゥームは広いんだなって思います。行ったこと: Talking with everyone from other school buildings makes me realize how vast Zartum truly is. Places I've never been, food I've never tasted... Just listening to them sparks my interest.
Speech.嘘をつく日をうまく活用できれば、欺瞞作戦の対策になるのではと思い、計画を立ててい: I was devising a plan thinking that if we utilized a day meant for lying effectively, it could serve as counter-measures against deception operations. However, Nadja and the others from Krasna told me that's not what the day is for...
Speech.嘘をつく日を利用して、全部隊に欺瞞情報を撒き、対応訓練を行いたいのですが……[2: I want to take advantage of the day for lying to scatter false intel to all units and conduct response training... | Umm... I don't think April Fools' is that kind of day, though...?
Speech.外の世界に触れたナージャが、これからどのように成長していくのか。あなたも一緒に見: How will Nadja grow from now on, having touched the outside world? Will you watch over her together with me?
Speech.実は……私ナージャの方が母親で、オ、オルガが娘だったんです！……す、すみません。: Actually... I, Nadja, am the mother, and O-Olga was the daughter! ...S-Sorry. No matter how you look at it, that lie was way too unreasonable. Plus it's rude to Mother.
Speech.新型の複座式、訓練は十分にこなしましたが、実戦となるとやっぱり緊張します。[3]: I've practiced enough with the new tandem-seat unit, but when it comes to actual combat, I still get nervous. | It's alright, Nadja, I'm by your side. The two of us should be able to overcome any difficulty.
Speech.機体の反応は……よし。[3]|最終シミュレーションと、齟齬ありません。反応のズレ: Unit responsiveness is... good. | There are no discrepancies with the final simulation. Reaction latency is well within acceptable limits. | It is the trump card created for this decisive battle, so it had better be.
Speech.私と%usernameusernameuserna%で用意したクリスマスプレゼン: This is a Christmas present prepared by %usernameusernameuserna% and me. Please accept it. | Woah... Thank you so much! To think I'd get to spend Christmas with the three of us feels like a dream...
Speech.私とナージャで、それぞれチョコレートを作りました。どうぞ受け取ってください。[2: Nadja and I made chocolates individually. Please accept them. | We made sure to make different flavors, so I want you to compare them. I think both turned out delicious.
Speech.私の誕生日、ですか。特に祝い事だと思ったことはありませんね。しかし、あなたに祝福: My birthday, is it? I have never thought of it as a particular cause for celebration. However, being blessed by you... doesn't feel half bad.
Speech.私の願いは……短冊に書き星に託すというよりは、自分の行動で叶えるものです。[2]: My wish... rather than writing it on a paper strip to entrust to the stars, is something I will fulfill through my own actions. | Yes. Fighting and claiming victory ourselves feels much more like our Krasna style.
Speech.誕生日おめでとうございます。ナージャと相談し、プレゼントも用意しました。……今後: Happy birthday. After consulting with Nadja, we prepared a present for you. ...Please continue to cherish Nadja in the future. She will be very happy as well.
Speech.願い事……前と変わりません。レドフカのために尽力し、ナージャが幸せに暮らせる世界: My wish... remains unchanged from before. To devote myself to Redovka and build a world where Nadja can live happily. And precisely for that reason—we must unite now and fight for the future.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……まだ戻ってないんですね。: %usernameusernameuserna%-san... still hasn't come back yet. Then I'll practice while I can... 'If you're free on your next day off, would you like to go out with...' Ugh, is that a bit too formal? Oof, I'm just trying to ask you out, why am I so nervous...
Speech.……え？ ホワイトデーだし、いつものお礼も兼ねて、欲しいものならなんでもくれる…: ...Huh? Since it's White Day, as thanks for everything you'll give me whatever I want...? You can't take those words back, okay? I might get greedy and ask for 'all sorts of things'... Fufu.
Speech.あ、あのっ……！|いえ……なんでもありません。い、いつかちゃんとお伝えします。: U-Um...!|No... it's nothing. I-I'll tell you properly someday.
Speech.えへへ、星が綺麗ですっ。|こうやってふたりで夜空を見れるような平和がこれからも続: Ehehe, the stars are so pretty.|I hope this kind of peace where the two of us can gaze at the night sky together continues forever.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございますっ！ その……今日って他の誰かと約束してますか？ …: Happy Birthday! Um... do you have plans with anyone else today? ...? Not yet...? I-In that case... why don't we go out right now? Just the two of us to celebrate.
Speech.この服、どうでしょう……？ 普段より少しだけおしゃれにしてみたんです。べ、別に誰: How is this outfit...? I tried dressing up a little more than usual. I-It's not like I have plans to go out with someone or anything... Um, could you just tell me if it suits me?
Speech.す、少しだけわがままを言ってもいいですか？ %usernameusernameu: M-May I be just a little selfish? Could you... give me your whole day, %usernameusernameuserna%-san? I want to spend some quiet time with just the two of us.
Speech.もし今度、少し遠くまで出かけるとしたら……どんな場所がいいですか？ いえ、参考に: If we were to go somewhere a bit further next time... what kind of place would be good? No, I'm just asking for reference! I-It's not like I'm making plans or anything!
Speech.クリスマスって、大切なことを伝えるにはいい日だとは思いませんか？ 私はまだそこま: Don't you think Christmas is a great day to convey something important? Though I don't think I can go that far just yet... instead, just one thing. Could you spare a little time for me on your next day off?
Speech.ジューンブライド……ですね。私はまだそんな先のことより……まずは、大切な人に自分: A June bride... isn't it. Rather than something so far in the future... first, I want to be able to properly express my feelings to the person I care about... and gather the courage to do so.
Speech.ハロウィンのせいか、みんなの服がとても華やかです。私も何か仮装したほうがよろしい: Maybe because it's Halloween, everyone's outfits are so colorful and fancy. Should I put on a costume too...? Huh? This outfit is cute enough so I don't need one? Ehehe... then I'll stay like this.
Speech.七夕のお願い事は、秘密です。でもちゃんと%usernameusernameuse: My Tanabata wish is a secret. But I definitely plan to tell you first someday, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. After all, it's about our 'future' together...
Speech.今日はエイプリルフールですよね。%usernameusernameuserna%: Today is April Fools' Day, right? %usernameusernameuserna%-san... what would you do if I said... I want to go on a 'date' with you?
Speech.今日はバレンタインですね。こういう日ですし、私も少しくらい勇気を出してみようと思: Today is Valentine's Day, isn't it? Since it's a day like this, I thought I'd try gathering a little courage too. So, um... please give me a little bit of your time later. What we'll be doing is still a secret!
Speech.各校区の復興もだいぶ進んできましたね。もし完全に日常が戻ったら……その……ま、ま: Reconstruction in each school district has progressed quite a bit. If daily life completely returns to normal... um... w-would you like to go out together again?
Speech.新しい年が始まりましたね。今年は、今までより少しだけ勇気を出せる年にしたいです。: A new year has started. This year, I want to make it a year where I can gather just a bit more courage than before. ...For instance, asking someone out somewhere. %usernameusernameuserna%-san, would you like to go for Hatsumode... together?
Speech.（わっ……！ 目が合っちゃった……！）|（やっぱり私……%usernameuse: (Waah...! Our eyes met...!)|(I really do... like %usernameusernameuserna%-san after all...)
Speech.……まだ戻らないの？ じゃあ、その間に授業の資料でも読んでおくわ。学園に入ったば: ...Still not back? Then I'll read through the class materials in the meantime. Just because I newly joined the academy doesn't mean I'm comfortable spending my days knowing nothing.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。新年の挨拶ね……ここ最近、顔を合わせる相手が急に増えたわ。: Happy New Year. A New Year's greeting, huh... The number of people I meet face-to-face has suddenly grown lately. ...I'm not saying it's a hassle. They're comrades I fought alongside with, so I intend to handle this much properly.
Speech.ありがと。学園に入ってからの私は、知らないことばかりだけど、誕生日までこうしてあ: Thanks. Ever since entering the academy, there's been so much I didn't know, but having even my birthday celebrated by you like this... makes me feel like the days spent at Hiiragi School Building have truly become my own.
Speech.ありがとう……|あんたのおかげで、自由と未来を取り戻せた。こんなこと、今日くらい: Thank you...|Thanks to you, I was able to reclaim my freedom and my future. I'm only going to say something like this to you today.
Speech.あんたと私、ウワサになってるみたいよ。恋人なんじゃないかって……くすっ、驚いた？: There seem to be rumors going around about you and me. People wondering if we're lovers... Hehe, surprised? Of course it's a lie. But you don't look annoyed by it...? Hmmm...
Speech.せっかく制服着てるんだし、クリスマスはこの格好で写真を残すのも悪くないかも。……: Since I'm wearing a uniform, taking a photo in this outfit for Christmas might not be a bad idea. ...If you want to be in the photo too, don't make that face and just be honest about it.
Speech.な、何よ……じっとこっち見て……|あんたに見つめられると……その……な、なんでも: W-What is it... staring at me like that...|When you gaze at me like that... um... N-Never mind!!
Speech.ホワイトデー……私はそういうのに疎いし、興味ないけど……あ、あんたはどうするつも: White Day... I'm ignorant about those kinds of things and don't care about them, but... w-what do you plan to do? I just thought I'd ask! Huh...? You prepared properly? H-Hehe, well of course you did!
Speech.仮装？ この格好のままで十分よ。お姉ちゃんと同じ顔なんだから、見間違えたやつを驚: Costumes? Staying like this is more than enough. I have the exact same face as my sister, so I could probably shock anyone who mistakes me for her. ...I don't actually plan on doing that, though.
Speech.前は放課後に友達と寄り道するなんて、自分には縁がないと思ってた。でも今は、そうい: I used to think hanging out with friends after school had nothing to do with me. But now, I think I'd like to try living that kind of ordinary academy life too. ...Kick your butt if you laugh.
Speech.双頭の斧のアジトにも時々顔を出してるわ。ストリートの治安を守ったり、行き場のない: I drop by the Twin-Headed Axe hideout occasionally. They seem to be properly active, keeping order on the streets and taking in kids with nowhere to go. I just don't like how they tease me about my school uniform.
Speech.柊校舎を歩いてると、日に日に、色んな人に挨拶されるようになって……まだ慣れないけ: Walking through Hiiragi School Building, day by day, more and more people greet me... I'm still not used to it, but places I didn't know are gradually becoming part of my daily routine. This kind of thing isn't bad either.
Speech.校舎では、バレンタインが近づくとみんな妙にそわそわするのね。何よ、あんたまでこっ: In the school building, everyone gets strangely restless as Valentine's Day approaches. What is it, don't you look over here too. Whether you'll get anything from me is... a secret until the moment comes. I won't tell you even if you ask.
Speech.短冊に、お姉ちゃんと毎日一緒に登校できますように……って、書くわけないでしょ！: Writing 'I wish I could go to school with my sister every day' on a paper strip... Like I'd ever write that! I only thought about it for a second. Forget it if you saw it. Don't go reading people's wishes without permission.
Speech.結婚？ 今の私には先の話すぎるわ。まずは今の生活に慣れるので手いっぱい。……まあ: Marriage? That's way too far off for me right now. I have my hands full just getting used to my current life. ...Well, but if you don't treat it as 'far off'... that's... a different story, though.
Speech.誕生日なんでしょ。おめでとう。学園に来てからも世話になってるし、今日は%user: It's your birthday, right? Happy Birthday. You've been looking after me since I came to the academy, so today I'll hang out with you, %usernameusernameuserna%. ...What's with that happy face? Don't get carried away.

Identification.試作メイズガーダー統制機: 試作メイズガーダー統制機

Description.メイズ大深度での指揮統制に特化した機体。\n急遽導入が決定され運用試験中。\nそ: A unit specialized for command and control in the deep levels of the Maze. Its emergency introduction was abruptly decided, and it is currently undergoing operational testing. To evaluate its true effectiveness, its fire control system has been sealed. Unidentified mechanisms can be seen in its details, but this is reportedly because it remains incomplete. Incidentally, its pet name was bestowed by Student Council President Shiouten Kagura.
Description.アマツ初の純正メイズガーダー。アマツは他地区製ＭＧをライセンス生産していたが、メ: Amatsu's first pure, in-house Maze Guarder. Amatsu had previously licensed MG models produced by other districts, but shifted its policy under the judgment that Maze exploration is an inter-district competition and its core MGs should be pure native builds. However, development of the new unit was delayed due to failing to meet high requirements, so this unit was introduced as a stopgap technology demonstrator. Additionally, because the performance gap between older units and the new model is vast, it also serves as a training unit. Bestowing it a name that signifies the dawn of Amatsu apparently stirred up quite a stir.
Description.低コスト重視で生み出されたメイズガーダー。メイズ内の環境は多岐に渡り、未踏域で現: A Maze Guarder built with a heavy focus on low cost. The environments within the Maze vary greatly, and since it is unknown whether current MGs will prove effective in uncharted zones, the core concept was to save costs and allocate them toward manufacturing tailored modifications without delay. It lacks extensibility, but this stems from the pragmatic assumption that new environments will be far harsher than before, rendering mere feature expansions insufficient. Though compact, it boasts a highly stylish design with a strong presence, leaving no impression of being cheap.
Description.ベース機から改修を重ねた実証実験機。\nベース機の外観を保ちつつ内部は全く別物と: A technology demonstrator that underwent repeated modifications from its base model. While maintaining the appearance of the base machine, its internals are so radically different that they belong to an entirely different class of performance. Separately, there is also a unit that aims for low-cost performance gains by adding modules to the base model, and the development teams are fiercely competing for official adoption.
Description.ノヴァセレスの特徴である貴族階級が生み出した機体。\nドロテア・カークランド率い: A machine created by the aristocracy characteristic of Novaceres. For the team led by Dorothea Kirkland, the Kirkland family took charge of a stalled development project and brought it to completion. It is a spared-no-expense, "all-inclusive" unit—an exquisitely luxurious masterpiece. Its performance is second to none within the academy.
Description.ザルトゥーム学園所有の練習機。\nメイズ探索の黎明期、過酷な環境に適応するためベ: A trainer unit owned by Zartum Academy. During the dawn of Maze exploration, it was one of many variants derived from a base model to adapt to harsh environments; through repeated modifications, it racked up a long and proven track record over many years. Even after being retired, rumor has it that depending on the pilot, it can still hold its own on the front lines today.
Description.治安維持用のＭＧで風紀委員会が搭乗する。輝映の系譜でありベースは旧型機だが、長年: A public safety MG piloted by the Disciplinary Committee. It belongs to the Kiei lineage and is based on an older model, but through years of modifications specifically focused on mobility and output enhancements, it is said to match even cutting-edge MGs in certain aspects. However, this also makes it a high-maintenance, finicky machine that chooses its pilot.
Description.『パスファインダー』の名はチーム『トリニティ・ジュエル』のリーダー・レイヴェルの: The name "Pathfinder" was given by Ravel, leader of team Trinity Jewel. It was praised for embodying both the spirit of freedom and frontier championed by the LOC, as well as the identity of Ravel herself, a famous model. The machine is a massive unit over 20 meters tall, radiating a powerful presence capable of taking the lead in forging through the Maze. The canards on its shoulders and chest are designed to grant high mobility to such a large frame, and they are also considered highly energy efficient.
Description.アマツ製ＭＧ。開発の遅れにより先に本機の実証実験機『黎明』が導入されていたが、よ: An Amatsu-made MG. Due to development delays, its technology demonstrator, "Reimei," was introduced first, but this unit has finally seen the light of day. Although Amatsu was late to develop native MGs, this machine turned out to possess high performance even when compared to those of other districts. However, low extensibility and poor maintainability have been noted as concerns—trade-offs made to meet strict requirement specs, coupled with the fact that its deployment could no longer be postponed.
Description.四王天神楽が極秘に開発したワンオフ機。メイズ深層で発見された１万年程前のものとさ: A one-off unit developed in complete secrecy by Shiouten Kagura. It was built using analysis data from a "mysterious machine" discovered in the deep layers of the Maze, believed to date back around 10,000 years. Theoretically, its potential is extremely high, but because of its top-secret development, there was almost no time for tuning; it is said that even veteran pilots can at best draw out 80% of its capability (which merely puts it on par with other standard MGs). Its villainous appearance was ordered directly by Kagura, though whether out of personal taste or a joke remains uncertain.
Description.オベレーグの名は『護符』『魔除け』を意味するが、製作者がこの機体に込めた『護る』: While the name Obereg means "talisman" or "amulet," the concept of "protection" embedded in this machine by its creator likely refers to hand-to-hand combat. High-torque wheels driven by dedicated motors located in the knees are embedded in its feet (instep and heel); by skillfully adjusting the output of small boosters mounted on its back flight unit, it can fly, leap, and dash freely through the Maze in all directions. Additionally, its overall shape is said to be modeled after an insect.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。搭乗する純夏達は: A machine resembling an MG, built using technology that does not exist in Zartum. Sumika and the others who pilot it refer to it as a Tactical Surface Fighter. Its control system utilizes technology completely different from MGs, making it impossible for Zartum Academy pilots to operate. As its silhouette suggests, its mobility characteristics make it excel at three-dimensional maneuver combat in tight spaces like the interior of the Maze. It is a humanoid machine of such high perfection that every ounce of waste seems to have been stripped away, and according to its pilots, it is remarkably easy to handle relative to its performance. Fixed armaments include daggers stored in knife sheaths on both arms. Main weapons consist of an "Assault Cannon" made up of a 36mm chain gun and a 120mm smoothbore gun, a super-carbon "Long Sword," shields, missile containers, and more.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。不知火に近しい部: A machine resembling an MG, built using technology that does not exist in Zartum. While sharing similarities with the Shiranui, its mobility is on an even higher level. The frame of a Tactical Surface Fighter is constructed primarily around "Carbonic Actuators" that expand and contract depending on applied voltage; electricity is supplied by a main engine consisting of storage batteries and magnesium fuel cells, while jumping and flight are handled by a propulsive jump system equipped on the waist—commonly known as a "Jump Unit," which features both jet engine and rocket motor functionality. This purple Takemikazuchi boasts maximum output in both areas upgraded by over 70% compared to the Shiranui, requiring exceptionally high skill to master its characteristics. For some reason, it has been locked to restrict its pilot exclusively to Mitsurugi Meiya.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。ある傑作機の上位: A machine resembling an MG, built using technology that does not exist in Zartum. Developed with the goal of being a superior upgrade to a certain masterpiece, it was poured with uncompromising technology and materials. Controlling the unit is extremely difficult, and its procurement and maintenance costs are astronomical, but it boasts top-tier performance in close-quarters mobile melee combat. Because it was originally designed assuming the presence of highly trained, elite pilots and maintenance crews, handling and maintainability were compromised to an extent, requiring exceptionally high skills to master its traits. A prototype was once deployed into actual combat during a defensive battle, and a bright yellow unit was reportedly delivered to a certain expeditionary base.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。2機造られた、と: A machine resembling an MG, built using technology that does not exist in Zartum. It is Unit 2 of a certain technology demonstrator of which two were produced. For comparative testing against Unit 1, the high-output engine mounted in its waist propulsive jump system (Jump Unit) differs from that of Unit 1. Its color scheme features a dark purple-gray base so it can be distinguished from Unit 1 at a glance. After surviving brutal exercises, numerous real battles, and deadly fights against unknown enemies, it was heavily damaged in a certain battle and slated for disposal, but miraculously rebuilt by gathering whatever remaining spare parts could be found.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。ある傑作機を最新: A machine resembling an MG, built using technology that does not exist in Zartum. Born from a plan to upgrade a certain masterpiece to performance levels equivalent to the latest generation. Previous modification programs suffered from costs exceeding new builds, but this unit successfully achieved efficient performance enhancements by utilizing the existing airframe structure while swapping electronic armament and adding modules. Its defining feature is increased mobility: thruster units were added to the shoulder armor blocks and rear weapon racks, and the waist propulsive jump system (Jump Unit) was replaced with a high-output model. Additionally, to improve precision bombardment during high-speed cruising, the head sensors were upgraded, drastically altering its appearance from the original unit.
Description.エクスプローラーに試作兵装を搭載した対イザナミ決戦機Ⅰ型。機体バランスは最悪で、: An Anti-Izanami Decisive Battle Unit Type I featuring prototype weaponry mounted on an Explorer. Its machine balance is terrible, rendering it practically unmovable for anyone other than Julia. The EN cannon attached to the rear shoulder was originally a long-range rifle, but it assumed its current form due to Julia's strong insistence: "I want to hold an EN shotgun (with EN saber equipped) in my hands, and having it on my back looks cool!" Both are weapons packed with the pinnacle of Scalar technology, but as Julia barely listens to explanations, the engineers reportedly have mixed feelings.
Description.エクスプローラーに試作兵装を搭載した対イザナミ決戦機Ⅱ型。両肩部リアに装着した巨: An Anti-Izanami Decisive Battle Unit Type II featuring prototype weaponry mounted on an Explorer. Massive magazines mounted on the rear of both shoulders feed ammunition to the 40mm multi-barrel Gatling guns on both arms. Boasting a variable rate of fire from 300 to 900 rounds per minute, standard firing at 600 RPM, max firing at 1,200 RPM, and an effective range of 1.5 to 3 km, performance of this caliber is a first in Zartum. Including the frontal shoulder armor, its weight increased considerably, turning it into a machine that abandoned mobility to go all-in on firepower.
Description.レドフカで開発された試作機。複座型で1名は機体制御、もう1名は『ストレラ』と呼ば: A prototype unit developed in Redovka. It is a tandem two-seater, with one pilot controlling the airframe and the other managing the remote attack terminals known as "Strela." Each Strela is equipped with a dedicated AI that acts autonomously, though overall management must be performed by a human. Furthermore, the Strelas exhibit strange gravity-defying movements; it is rumored that this applies cutting-edge gravity control tech developed in recent years, though details remain a mystery. Perhaps because of this, operations can be somewhat unstable, putting the operator's skill to the test.
