Description.やりぃ♪ じゃあ、遠慮なく！ パフェの専門店、パンケーキ、ステーキハウス ぜーん: Yay♪ Then I won't hold back! Parfait specialty shop, pancakes, steakhouse—I'm going to ALL of them!
Description.あっ、そうだ、思い出した。いいもの見せてあげる。\\nこれは結成してすぐに取って: Oh, right, I just remembered! Let me show you something nice.\nThis is a photo taken right after we formed. Look, look, isn't it cute?
Description.う～ん、すっごく柔らかいねぇ～、うりうりうり～。\\nきゃって、んっ、うぅう……: Mmm~ it's so super soft~, squish squish squish~.\nEek— wait, ngh, ugh... C-Chiyuru-san...
Description.やったやった！勝ったわ！勝ったわよ！ うん！みんな頑張ったよね！やったね！ この: Hooray, hooray! We won! We won! Yeah! Everyone worked so hard! We did it! I'm so glad to be in this team!
Description.……説明……ううん、普通のお化け屋敷じゃない、恐怖の館。ドキドキして、ちょっとハ: ...An explanation... No, it's not an ordinary haunted house; it's a house of horrors. Heart-pounding, a bit intense, and with a shocking twist at the end.
Description.わたしが食べさせてあげる！はい、これ！ あーん！\\nわわわっ！ す、純夏さん凄: I'll feed you! Here, take this! Say ahh!\nW-Wawa! S-Sumika-san, you're so bold! ...To actually feed me like this...!
Description.みんなのお願いごとをおたすけして、\\nえがおにしたい。みんなのえがお、とっても: I want to help with everyone's wishes and make them smile.\nEveryone's smiles feel so warm and cozy.
Description.……大丈夫です……\\nですが…………いつまで揉んでるんですか、変態。: ...I'm fine...\nHowever... just how long are you going to keep groper-ing me, you pervert?
Description.ふふ……誰かとカラオケに行くなどめったになくてな。\\nつい思い出して、立ち止ま: Fufu... I rarely go to karaoke with anyone.\nI just happened to remember and stopped in my tracks.
Description.翠蘭ちゃんがね、指揮官へのプレゼントは一番あげたいものがいいって！\\nだから私: Suiran-chan said that for a present to the Commander, it's best to give what you want to give the most!\nSo I'm giving you me~♪
Description.この、カオスメイデンというチームは……気づいたら、\\n私のことを知っても受け入: This team called Chaos Maidens... before I knew it, had become a precious place that accepted me even knowing who I was.
Description.一気に全部を知ってもらうんじゃなくて、\\n少しずつ今のわたしの『本当』をみんな: Rather than having everyone know everything all at once,\nI'll gradually convey my current "truth" to everyone—
Description.まだ見ていない景色は沢山ありますわ。\\nその時には……その、ご一緒してもよろし: There are still many sights I have yet to see.\nWhen the time comes... well, may I join you?
Description.私がアークトゥルスに相応しい実力を\\n備えていると判断していただけたからです。: Because you judged that I possess the ability fitting for Arcturus.
Description.ＭＧのことはもっとよく知っておきたいわね。\\n戦術機とすごく良く似てるけど、い: I'd like to learn more about MGs.\nThey're very similar to TSFs, but there seem to be various differences.
Description.本当に私ってば、ダメダメですね……\\n人を助けようとしたつもりが、一緒に助けら: I'm really useless, aren't I...\nI intended to help others, only to end up being saved right alongside them...
Description.うん、想像していたよりも遥かにいいな。\n皆の個性が出ていて、とてもよく似合って:
Yeah, it's far better than I imagined.
Everyone's individuality shines through, and it suits you all very well.
Description.『感度3000倍ぬるぬる液』発売中！ネットの海で出会ったとある２人――彼女達のノ: "3000x Sensitivity Slippery Liquid" now on sale! Born from the chemistry of two people who met in the sea of the internet—please try this new product out in maiden sumo.
Description.とりゃー！捕まえたぞ、犯人めー！\n皆から盗ったものを返せー！:
Toryaa! I caught you, you culprit!
Give back what you stole from everyone!
Description.もしあたしが勝ったら、あたしに心を込めて耳元で\n『愛してる』って囁くというのは: If I win, how about you whisper "I love you" into my ear with all your heart!
Description.皆そなたにいろいろ求めすぎなのじゃ。\nたまには休んでも誰も責めんよ。: Everyone expects too much of thee. Nobody will blame thee if thou takest a rest once in a while.
Description.大会がペア戦なのよ！ 私が勝つから、あんたはただ座ってればいいわ！: The tournament is a tag-team match! I'll win it, so you just sit there and relax!
Description.大賀「カリナ！こちらが似顔絵です！」 カリナ「...さすがいいんちょ～！」: Ooga: "Karina! Here is the portrait!" Karina: "...As expected of the Prez~!"
Description.あたしはこんなの滅多に着ないから、 今のうちにその目に焼き付けといたほうがいいよ: I rarely wear things like this, so you'd better burn this view into your eyes while you can~
Description.なっ！？ 先ほど巻き込んだことをまだ怒っているのか！？ あれはいつも我の逃げ先に: What!? Are you still angry about getting dragged into that earlier!? Elena, who was always at my escape route, is also to blame...!
Description.その……私……シリウスシュガーのみんなのために、もっと何かできることはないかな、: Um... I... was wondering if there was anything more I could do for everyone in Sirius Sugar...
Description.わたくしでよろしければ、喜んで。\\n１から花の扱い方を説明させていただきますわ: If you're fine with me, gladly.\nI shall explain how to handle flowers from step one.
Description.うわー、それはもったいないね！あたしと一緒に外に遊びに行こ！うん、そうしよう、け: Uwaa, that's such a waste! Come play outside with me! Yep, let's do that—it's decided!
Description.美少女に頼られて、おまえめっちゃラッキーじゃん！\\n……で！ 一緒に行くの！？: You're super lucky to be relied on by a pretty girl!\n...So! Are you coming with us or not!?
Description.シルバー系のものが可愛くて好き。\\n落ち着いた色だし……わたしの髪色にも合うか: I like silver things because they're cute.\nIt's a calm color... and it matches my hair color too.
Description.私を嫌い、悪し様に言う者もいる。\\nだが、私が悪者になることで、皆を守れるので: There are those who hate me and speak ill of me.\nHowever, if becoming the villain allows me to protect everyone, I don't care how much I am hated.
Description.あっ……こ、こ、こんにちはっ！お、お待ちしてました！！\\n部屋の前で待っていれ: Ah... H-H-Hello! I-I was waiting for you!!\nI thought if I waited in front of your room, you'd eventually come out...
Description.しゃらぁーっぷ！！ その名前を口にしないで！！\\n手帳の中、見たの！？ 見てな: Shut up!! Don't say that name!!\nDid you look inside my notebook!? Did you or didn't you!!?
Description.ちょ、ちょっと！ 何笑ってるのよ！？\\nぜ、絶対にいつか吠え面かかせてやるんだ: H-Hey, wait! What are you laughing at!?\nI-I'll definitely make you cry uncle someday, so prepare yourself!
Description.１度で全部聞いちゃうのはもったいないでしょ？……だから、またいつかデートに誘うわ: Isn't it a waste to hear everything all at once? ...So, I'll ask you out on a date again sometime. Tell me the rest slowly then, okay?
Description.今はこのエアガンがブームってわけ！\\n結構体を動かすし、パイロット活動の訓練に: Airsoft guns are all the rage right now!\nIt gets you moving quite a bit and serves as training for pilot activities too.
Description.まったく……仕方のない人ですね。\\n出口まで案内しますので、私について来てくだ: Goodness... You really are hopeless.\nI will guide you to the exit, so please follow me.
Description.もっともっと、制御しなければ！この快感を！ この昂りを！ この高揚を！もっと、私: I must control it more, much more! This pleasure! This excitement! This exhilaration! To make them even more mine!
Description.商店街にあるものを見て、これが１番欲しいって思ったの。\\nいつもは自分で買うけ: Looking at the things in the shopping district, I thought I wanted this the most.\nI usually buy things myself, but having someone buy it for me feels special.
Description.お願いだから……いなくならないでぇ……！\\n置いてかないで……あたしを、ひとり: Please... don't disappear...!\nDon't leave me behind... don't leave me all alone...!
Description.んむ……んぅ……すぅ、すぅ……\\n寝床を貸してもらうね。ここでなら、安心できる: Mmm... ngh... zzz, zzz...\nI'll borrow your bed, okay? I feel safe here.
Description.格好悪い行動は大嫌いで、仲間のことはとても大事で……\\n何ものにも囚われない、: I hate uncool actions, treasure my friends deeply...\nand I absolutely love the free-spirited gal vibes that aren't bound by anything!
Description.赤くない！ ゆ、夕日！ 夕日のせい！\\nもう……こんなの……コスパ……悪いのに: It's not red! I-It's the sunset! It's because of the sunset!\nGeez... even though doing this... has such bad... cost performance.
Description.この学園で頑張るつもり。だって、仲間や色々な人を笑顔にできるから…\\n期待して: I plan to work hard at this academy. Because I can make my friends and various people smile...\nLook forward to it, okay? Someday I'll sing for you, Commander.
Description.こういうファッションが趣味だからね♪\\nしっかりキミをコーディネートしてあげる: Fashion like this is my hobby, after all♪\nI'll make sure to style you properly.
Description.ほら、はーやーくー。いいからいいから、早く部屋に帰るわよ。ハイヨー！後輩クン！: Come on, hurry up~. It's fine, it's fine, let's head back to our room quickly. Giddy-up, underclassman-kun!
Description.こちらのお店のお洋服、とても素敵です！見てください、どれも可愛い……！ふふっ、見: The clothes at this shop are so wonderful! Look, every single one is so cute...! Fufu, just looking at them makes my heart flutter.
Description.ははは、あたしらしくないだろ？こんな風に悩んでるなんてさ。\\n悪いな、こんな情: Hahaha, it's not like me, right? Worrying like this.\nSorry for showing you such a pathetic side of me.
Description.喧嘩をするのは仕方ないよ。リリーだってするからね。\\nでも、殴ったり叩いたりす: Fights are unavoidable sometimes. Even Lily gets into them.\nBut hitting or slapping is definitely wrong!
Description.またもや人に籠絡されてしまうなんて……\\nわたくし、スパイの才能がないのかもし: To be won over by someone yet again...\nI might not have any talent for being a spy.
Description.――ここだっ！ あれぇ？ ここにいたと思ったのにぃ…… ねえ、どこにいるの～！？: —Right here! Huh? I thought you were here... Hey, where are you~!? Hey, I'm talking to you~!
Description.そうそう。そうやって走れば疲れが減るわ。 \\nもしわからなければ、何度だって聞: That's it. Running like that reduces fatigue.\nIf you don't get it, feel free to ask me as many times as you need.
Description.お世話になっている指揮官さんへ。感謝の気持ちをお届けです！ これからも末永くよろ: To the Commander who always takes care of me. Delivering my feelings of gratitude! Please continue to take good care of me for a long time to come♪
Description.お、お着替えをしてるだけですから、そんな大変な事になったりしませんよ！: I-I'm just changing my clothes, so nothing crazy like that is going to happen!
Description.え？ そうだよ。そのために資料とか道具とか全部ベッドの上に持ってきたんだから。: Huh? Yeah, that's right. That's why I brought all the documents and tools onto the bed.
Description.こんな風にゆっくりするのもいいね……みんなと過ごすのももちろんだけど。\\nわた: Relaxing like this is nice too... though spending time with everyone is great, of course.\nI'd like to be alone with Takeru-chan again.
Description.ここから見える景色は……まさに平和だな。\\n私はこの景色を知らない……だが、そ: The view from here... is truly peaceful.\nI don't know this scenery... but I feel like I was fighting in pursuit of it.
Description.えっ？ ……これって、雑貨屋で売ってたぬいぐるみ……！たけるさん……これ……いい: Huh? ...Isn't this the stuffed animal sold at the general store...! Takeru-san... is this... really okay? For me to take it...
Description.私は、基本のヘアセットやメイクくらいなら自分でやる。\\n自分でできることは自分: I do my own basic hair styling and makeup.\nI try to do things myself whenever I can.
Description.ううぅ～ん……むにゃむにゃ……\\nえへへ……美味しい……もう……食べられない…: Mmm... mumble mumble...\nEhehe... so tasty... I can't... eat anymore...
Description.星と月しかない。\\n……でも、この６人で一緒に見る夜空は特別で、ちょっと違う気: There are only stars and the moon.\n...But watching the night sky together with the six of us feels special and a little different.
Description.フィーちゃん、勝負だよ～～～～！！\\n……と見せかけて、アニスちゃんにえーいっ: Fii-chan, let me challenge you~~~~!!\n...Or so you thought—take this, Anise-chan!
Description.抜け駆けの独り占めはよくないけど……\\nせめて、今この時間くらいは、いいよね…: Stealing a march to keep you to myself isn't good, but...\nat least for this moment right now, it's okay, right...?
Description.……改めて、綺麗ね。真っ暗な中で揺れるろうそくって。\\n安心するというか、落ち: ...Looking at it again, it's beautiful. A candle flickering in the pitch darkness.\nIt's reassuring, or rather, calming.
Description.おまえみたいなザーコ、ラミがいなきゃ何もできないんだから。\\nしゃーなしで……: A weakling like you can't do anything without Rami, after all.\nGuess I have no choice... I'll keep taking care of you from now on.
Description.ぽやぽやする……\\nおにいちゃんのなでなで、リディアの一番さん。: Feeling all fluffy...\nOnii-chan's headpats are Lydia's absolute favorite.
Description.はーい、ふたりともそこまでー。\\n道端でケンカしないの。他に歩いている人達いる: Alright, both of you, that's enough.\nDon't fight on the roadside. There are other people walking by, you know?
Description.ねえねえ、それよりどう？ 似合う？\\nホント？ 見飽きてない？: Hey, hey, more importantly, how is it? Does it suit me?\nReally? You're not sick of looking at it?
Description.な、なんでぇ～！？ちゃんと練習もしてるし、\\n普段から特訓だって……いだぁああ: W-Why~!? I've been practicing properly,\nand I do special training all the time... Owwwww!!?
Description.お姉ちゃんとして……弟と妹には、\\nカッコいい姿を見せてあげたいなーって思うの: As an older sister... I want to show my younger brother and sister a cool side of myself.
Description.こんな麺料理、初めて見ました。\\n見ているだけでも、わくわくしてしまいます！: I've never seen a noodle dish like this before.\nJust looking at it makes me so excited!
Description.……はぁ、まったく。\\nあたしが必要じゃなくなるまでは面倒をみてやるよ。: ...Sigh, geez.\nI'll look after you until you don't need me anymore.
Description.起きなさい、白銀！\\nもうとっくに約束の時間は過ぎてるわよ！: Wake up, Shirogane!\nThe promised time has already long passed!
Description.タケルもきっと驚くよ！じゃあ見ててね！\\nまずはこうやって後ろから前に紐を渡し: Takeru will definitely be surprised too! Okay, watch this!\nFirst, you pass the string from back to front like this...
Description.携帯食にもバッチリ。冷めてても美味しい。完璧。: Perfect as portable rations too. Delicious even when cold. Flawless.
Description.ある意味裸よりも恥ずかしい格好だから、\\n最初何かの間違いなんじゃないかって驚: It's an outfit more embarrassing than being naked in a way,\nso I was shocked at first, thinking there must be some mistake...
Description.実戦になったら、迷ったりしてる余裕なんてない……\\n今の内に上手く使えるように: In actual combat, there won't be time to hesitate...\nI need to get good at using it while I still can.
Description.行くところがないんでしょ？\\nそれなら私が『行くところ』を用意してあげる。: You have nowhere to go, right?\nThen I'll prepare a "place to go" for you.
Description.私、ワガママって初めて言ったから。\nきっと本当はもっと早く、言ってもよかったん:
That was the first time I've ever spoken selfishly.
I guess I really could have said it much sooner, right...?
Description.……リリーがジャスティオンに変えてもらったみたいに、\nその人をもっと良い方向に:
...Just as Lily was changed by Justion,
I want to guide that person in a better direction too.
Description.カリナ「絵上手いね～。ウチといいんちょ、こんなふうに見られてるんだぁ」\\n真桜: Karina: "You're good at drawing~ So that's how people view me and the Prez."\nMao: "Naughty stuff is a disciplinary violation! Wait, why are you uploading that without permission!?"
Description.マスター！ ボクが清書しましたよー！: Master! I inked the final copy!
Description.普段はしーっかりとサボって、\n必要な時にはバーンって活躍するくらいでいいんだか:
Slacking off properly on regular days,
and making a splash when it really counts is totally fine.
Description.す、すみません！ ご迷惑をおかけして……\nその、あまり動かれると……そ、その…: I-I'm sorry! For causing you trouble...\nUm, if you move too much... t-that's...
Description.さすがにあなたに迷惑を掛けるくらいなら、\nこの程度の勝負、私が受けて立ちますよ:
If it's going to cause you trouble, then
I'll accept a match of this level myself.
Description.別にふたりして同じロッカーに\n入らなくてもよかったですよね……:
We didn't really need to get into
the same locker together, did we...
Description.え……えっと、その……あの……\n……すみません。あまり話をできなくて。: U-Um, well... that is...\n...I'm sorry. I couldn't talk with you very much.
Description.娘の希望で『グリズリームーン』に変身しています。\n――クマに代わって、オシオキ:
I'm transforming into "Grizzly Moon" at my daughter's request.
—In the name of the bear, I shall punish you!
Description.私は今、ハリエットじゃない……\nハリエットじゃないから、恥ずかしくない……:
Right now, I'm not Harriet...
Because I'm not Harriet, I'm not embarrassed...
Description.ボクは後悔したくない！ ケイとハリィ。\n大切になった友達とやり残したことを作り:
I don't want to have regrets! Kei and Harrie.
I don't want to leave unfinished business with friends who became so important to me!
Description.『この剣にかけて、貴方を襲うあらゆるものを打ち払いましょう。\nこの心臓にかけて: "Upon this sword, I swear to strike down anything that attacks you.\nUpon this heart, I swear to remain by your side."
Description.あ、ああ、いえ……申し訳ありません、この世界の…… その、商品名に不慣れなもので: A-Ah, no... I am deeply sorry, I am unfamiliar with... well, product names in this world.
Description.うるさいって何だうるさいって！ あたしは……ちょっと考えが変わっただけだ！: What do you mean, annoying!? I... just had a slight change of mind, that's all!
Description.大人しくして。 ……これ以上、乱暴なことはしたくないわ。: Be quiet. ...I don't want to do anything more violent than this.
Description.もうすぐ夏なのでスイカ割りなんていかがでしょうか！ 夏らしいアマネさん素敵ですね: Summer is coming soon, so how about splitting watermelons! Amane-san looking summery is wonderful!
Description.や、やめてください！ 私の記憶にもないような昔の話など恥ずかしいことを言うのは！: P-Please stop! Bringing up embarrassing old stories that aren't even in my memory!
Description.ふふ……ダンスは勝負じゃないから、勝ち負けはないわよ？: Fufu... Dancing isn't a competition, so there's no winning or losing, you know?
Description.よく頑張ったのう……そなたのことは、 ちゃんと儂が見ておったぞい……: Thou hast worked hard... I was watching thee properly, thou knowest...
Description.ふぅ……いやあ、お客さん凝ってますねえ♪ もうガッチガチ！ 腕の振るいがいがある: Phew... My, customer, you're so stiff♪ Completely rock-solid! It makes it worth putting my skills to work!
Description.鳴滝七彩をリーダーとした落ちこぼれチーム。仲の良さならトップにも負けない。: A team of underachievers led by Nanairo Narutaki. When it comes to how well they get along, they won't lose to top teams.
Description.生駒葵をリーダーにした校舎内トップクラスチーム。規律の取れた連携が強み。: A top-class school team led by Aoi Ikoma. Disciplined teamwork is their main strength.
Description.リーダーのユリアの性格を反映したような自由さが売りの校舎内トップクラスチーム。: A top-class school team whose selling point is freedom, reflecting the personality of leader Julia.
Description.ドロテアをリーダーとした学園でも指折りのチーム。統率の取れたチームワークが強み。: One of the top teams in the academy, led by Dorothea. Well-organized teamwork is their strength.
Description.フルートをリーダーとしたチーム。全員がパイロット以外に別の肩書きを持つ。: A team led by Flute. Every member holds another title besides pilot.
Description.あ、あの、大丈夫ですか？目が覚めたみたいで、良かったです……\\n……そ、それで: A-Um, are you okay? I'm glad you woke up...\n...S-So, well... here is a towel for now.
Description.んっ、あっ、はぁ、はぁ……んぅうううう！やっ、ああ、こ、これ以上は、む、むりぃ…: Ngh, ah, haa, haa... Nnnngh! Ah, aaah, a-any more than this is i-impossible...!
Description.だって、怖くて動けないんです……！お願いです、どうかわたくしの側にいてください…: Because I'm too scared to move...! Please, stay by my side...!
Description.……ふふふ……ぐにゅってしてる……♪これは……面白い。癖になる。お言葉に甘えて…: ...Fufu... It's squishy...♪ This is... interesting. It's addicting. Taking you up on your offer... poke, poke.
Description.はぁ……はぁっ……こ、こんな姿のフルートを、\\nあんまり映さないでくださ～い…: Haa... haa... P-Please don't record Flute looking like this too much~...!
Description.あら、指揮官……ふふ、とても大胆ね。\\nあたし達の裸……そんなに見たかったのか: My, Commander... fufu, how very bold. Did you really want to see us naked that much?
Description.え、えっちなトナカイ！？\\nえっ、ええええ、そ、そんなこと……！: A-A naughty reindeer!?\nE-Eh, w-what... no way...!
Description.レイヴェルをリーダーとする才能豊かなチーム。３人編成を最適解とみなしている。: A talented team led by Ravel. They consider a three-person squad to be the optimal setup.
Description.ん～、やっぱりお母さんの黒豆最高～っ！\\nお母さん！ この黒豆のレシピ、あとで: Mmm~ Mom's black beans are the best after all~!\nMom! Teach me the recipe for these black beans later!
Description.あけましておめでとうございます。ザルトゥーム学園がより素晴らしくなるよう精進いた: Happy New Year. I will devote myself to making Zartum Academy even more wonderful.\nI hope to have your support again this year.
Description.あはは！ 楽しいかも！ ほらほらー！\\nおしくらまんじゅう、押されて泣くなー！: Ahaha! This might be fun! Look, look~!\nDon't cry if you get pushed in the huddling game~!
Description.何事じゃありませんよ！\\nこの変態！ 鬼畜！ 覗き魔！ 極悪人！！: It's not 'nothing'!\nYou pervert! Fiend! Peeping Tom! Absolute villain!!
Description.榊は意識ばっかりで健康じゃない。すぐ怒るのが証拠。: Sakaki is all about mindset and not actually healthy. Getting angry so easily is proof of that.
Description.どんだけ少ない時間で、完璧求めんの！\\n文句と要望だけはご立派に言いやがって！: How much perfection do you expect in such a short time!\nAll you do is voice splendid complaints and demands!
Description.振り返れば指揮官さんがいてくれる……それが一番の勇気になるんです。\\nこれから: Knowing the Commander is there when I look back... gives me the greatest courage.\nI look forward to working with you from now on as well!
Description.撮影は……スタッフを通して……\nぐぅ……出禁……: Filming... through staff...\nUgh... banned from entry...
Description.何をやってるんですか！終わっていいとは言っていませんよ！\n今から３分間！ 限界: What are you doing! I didn't say you could stop!\nFrom now on, for 3 minutes! Keep doing push-ups to your absolute limit!
Description.生徒会直下の治安維持チーム。各校舎から集められた生徒達で構成されている。: A public safety maintenance team directly under the student council, composed of students gathered from various school buildings.
Description.ほら、賭けて賭けてー！それそれ～！ 次もどんどん行こー！: Come on, place your bets, place your bets! Here we go~! Let's keep going for the next one too!
Description.これで皆お揃いね♪ このまま指揮官にも見せに行きましょ♪\nきっと、あたしたちが:
Now we're all matching♪ Let's go show the Commander just like this♪
I'm sure he'll compliment us in a way that will touch our hearts♪
Description.オルガ「対ＭＧ戦と対メイズシフター戦の違いを念頭にあなたの意見を述べてください。:
Olga: "Please state your opinion, keeping in mind the differences between fighting MGs and fighting Maze Shifters."
Nadja: "Y-Yes!"
Description.はぁ……これで取材だけで別に人前に出るってわけじゃないなら、\nまだいいんだけど:
Sigh... If this is just an interview and I don't actually have to go out in public, that's fine.
Like taking photos and getting published in the school magazine...
Description.……イーニァの隣にいられない夜が、 こんなにも寒いとは知らなかった……: ...I didn't know a night without being next to Inia would be this cold...
Description.誰がママですか…… ほら、ちゆるさん。もっと手を上げてくださる？: Who are you calling Mom... Look, Chiyuru-san. Could you raise your hands higher?
Description.マスタぁ！とてもおめでたいことですよね！ こういった嬉しいことはずーーっとつづい: Master! This is a very auspicious occasion, isn't it! I hope happy things like this continue for a long, long time!
Description.やっぱり……クラスナの皆さんといる時のお母様は、 厳しいようだけど、どこか安心し: As expected... when Mother is with everyone in Krasna, she seems strict, but somehow relieved...
Description.……ということでカリナ、あとはお願いします。 もうサボっちゃダメですからね？: ...So with that, Karina, please handle the rest. No more slacking off, okay?
Description.「ほらこっちだよめるちゃん！ 行こ行こー！」\\n「わわっ！ ユリアさん、落ち着: "Come on, this way, Mel-chan! Let's go, let's go~!"\n"Wawa! Julia-san, calm down...!"
Description.あはは、ぱっと見ただのヒモっぽいよね。 でもこれもちゃんとした水着だよ～: Ahaha, at first glance it just looks like strings, right? But this is a proper swimsuit~
Description.あら、一体全体どこを触るつもりなのかしら？ コワ～イ……ふふ♪: My, where on earth do you think you're going to touch? Scary... fufu♪
Description.わたくしは…… 皆さんと一緒にいる資格など、あるのでしょうか。: Do I... even have the right to be with everyone?
Description.わわわ、わたし……どうすれば……！？ あっあっ……えっ！？ あああぁぁ～～～！？: W-W-What should I... do...!? Ah, ah... eh!? Aaaaaahhhh~~~!?
Description.次のダイエットでは必ず激痩せして……！ いえ、いきなりは難しいですから、その次と: On my next diet, I'll definitely lose a ton of weight...! No, that's hard to do right away, so maybe the next time...
Description.水上スポーツ大会に来てるんだけど、ちょ～っと待ち時間があるから、 海の家を回って: I came to the water sports tournament, but since there's a little wait, I'll visit the beach shacks and introduce my top recommended items~!
Description.焼きイカも、味が濃くて美味しいです……！ この歯ごたえ、たまらな……ああ、もうな: The grilled squid has a rich flavor and is delicious...! This chewy texture is irresistible... Ah, it's already gone...!?
Description.レイヴェル、ルナ、おにいちゃん……リディア。 みんなといっしょが、きっといちばん: Ravel, Luna, Onii-chan... and Lydia. Being together with everyone is definitely the greatest treasure.
Description.ここが盛り上がって続いてほしいっていうのは、\nあたしにとっては恩返しの意味もあ: Wanting this place to stay lively and keep going is my way of giving back too♪
Description.その輪が広がっていく中で、最後に皆が笑顔になる……\nそんなビジネスの形が、私の: As that circle expands, everyone ends up with a smile in the end... That kind of business is my dream, you know?
Description.わっ、わあっ！？ ちょっと、同時に引っ張っちゃダメだよ！？\n先生、千切れちゃう: Wah, woah!? Hey, don't pull me at the same time!? Sensei, I'm going to get torn in half!
Description.終わった後に笑顔で、気持ちよかったって言ってもらえると、\nそれだけですごく嬉し: When people smile after it's over and tell me how good it felt, that alone makes me so happy.
Description.……さっき、父さんの話をしたでしょ。\nそうしたら、なんだか人恋しくなっちゃって:
...Just now, I was talking about my father, right?
When I did, I suddenly started feeling a bit lonely and craving company.
Description.あははっ♪ ここからは、私も本気出すってこと！\n皆、ライバルとしてよろしくねっ:
Ahaha♪ That means I'm getting serious from here on out!
I look forward to competing with all of you as rivals!
Description.うん……湯船に浸かってるだけで、\n身体がぽかぽかして、気持ちいい……:
Mmm... Just soaking in the tub
makes my body feel warm all over, it feels so nice...
Description.え、ええと……多分、使用中の札をかけていたはずですが……: U-Um... I'm pretty sure I hung up the 'In Use' sign, though...
Description.める「いらっしゃいませ、指揮官さん！ たくさん食べてくださいね！」\nラミ「ラミ:
Meru: "Welcome, Commander! Please eat up and enjoy!"
Rami: "Getting served by us is super lucky, you know? Cry tears of joy!"
Description.わ、わわわっ！？\nおい！ 急に何すんの、髪ぐっちゃぐちゃになるじゃんか！:
W-Woah, woah, woah!?
Hey! What are you doing all of a sudden? You're completely messing up my hair!
Description.任せて。こっちが今まで頼りにしてきた分、\nこっちも頑張らせてもらうよ。:
Leave it to me. Since I've relied on you so much up until now,
it's my turn to give it my all.
Description.紡いだ絆が、決戦の地に集う。\\n定められた運命を覆し、『箱庭』を壊す時が来た。: The bonds we've forged gather at the site of the final battle.\nThe time has come to overturn our predetermined fate and shatter the 'Miniature Garden.'
Description.オルガをリーダーとするチーム。チームの連携力は、他チームを凌ぐと言われている。: A team led by Olga. Their teamwork is said to surpass all other teams.
Description.ナージャ「どんなに厳しい戦いだったとしても、必ず乗り越えられます……！」\\n: Nadja: "No matter how tough the battle is, we will definitely overcome it...!"\nOlga: "I trust you as well. Together, the two of us surely can..."
Description.ニーナ「えっと……私は、ジーナがここ最近無理をしてると思ったんだ」 \\nジーナ: Nina: "Um... I just thought that Gina has been pushing herself too hard lately."\nGina: "I am merely fulfilling my duty as a pilot and a warrior."
Description.ナージャ「どんなに厳しい戦いだったとしても、必ず乗り越えられます……！」\\nオ: Nadja: "No matter how tough the battle is, we will definitely overcome it...!"\nOlga: "I trust you as well. Together, the two of us surely can..."
Description.いいんちょはいつもがんばってて、サボらないし……\\n委員長のことはウチがぜった: Prez is always working hard and never slacks off...\nSo I'm definitely gonna help Prez out—
Description.これからも見せてくれるんでしょ？\\nあんたと一緒に掴み取った、『未来』ってやつ: You'll keep showing it to me from now on, won't you?\nThat thing called 'the future' that we grabbed together.
Description.これから先もずっと、\\nあなたの隣でたくさんの思い出を作らせてくださいね。: From here on out, for always,\nplease let me make countless memories right by your side.
Description.すみません……でも、その……\\n今のことは、あまり意識しないでください……: I'm sorry... But, umm...\nplease don't pay too much mind to what just happened...
Description.それは―――無慈悲な一撃だった。魅力は無限大。: That was—a merciless strike. The charm is endless.
Description.もう、そろってからかわないでください～！: Jeez, stop ganging up on me to tease me~!
Description.仕方ないわね……\\nじゃあ、本当にひと口だけ味を見てあげる。: I guess I have no choice then...\nFine, I'll take just one tiny bite to taste test for you.

Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nシリウスシュガーとは重みも状況も違う。\\nあれは君た: @Nanairo_N\nThe stakes and circumstances are different from Sirius Sugar.\nThat was your victory.

Message.ふと気になったのよ。せっかく平和なんだし、何か新しいことに挑戦するべきなんじゃな: It just randomly crossed my mind. Since it's peaceful after all, shouldn't we challenge ourselves with something new...
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nボクはゲームかなぁ。対戦ゲームとか端末のゲームとか色々: @Chizuru_S\nFor me, games, I guess. Playing PvP games, mobile terminal games, all kinds~.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nふむ、私は意図して新たに始めたということは無いが、散歩: @Chizuru_S\nHmm, I haven't intentionally started anything new, but the frequency of going out for walks has increased a bit. I also hope it might serve as some sort of trigger to awaken memories.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nわたしもお買い物とかですね！: @Chizuru_S\nI go shopping and things like that too!
Message.……みんな、新しいことに挑戦してるのね。私も何かに挑戦すべきかしら？: ...Everyone is challenging new things, huh. Should I challenge something too?
Message.あー、しまった！ 依頼先で財布忘れた！: Ah~ shoot! I forgot my wallet at the client's place!
Message.@Takeru_S\\nああ、白銀のだったのね。ここで聞こうと思ってたのよ。私た: @Takeru_S\nAh, so it was Shirogane's. I was planning to ask here. Someone delivered it saying it might belong to one of us.
Message.@Takeru_S\\n私じゃなくて、拾ってくれた人に感謝しなさい。全く……違う: @Takeru_S\nDon't thank me, thank the person who picked it up. Honestly... you aren't slackening off just because this is a different world, are you?
Message.いやー、ゲームが楽し過ぎて……: Well~, games are just way too fun...
Message.改めて思うけど……端末で簡単に連絡が取れるのって凄いわよね。: Thinking about it again... being able to easily contact each other via terminal is amazing, isn't it.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nああ、慣れた今では手放せないものになっているな。: @Chizuru_S\nYeah, now that we're used to it, it's become something we can't part with.
Message.@Meiya_M\\n通信機器は私たちの世界にも色々あったけど……手軽で、使える: @Meiya_M\nThere were various communication devices in our world too, but... being handy and having such a wide usable range is truly amazing. I wonder if we could somehow memorize it and reproduce it back in our original world?
Message.こういうものがあれば、戦場で不意に孤立しても連絡が取れるし、連携の精度も高まるわ: If we had something like this, even if isolated unexpectedly on the battlefield we could establish contact, and coordination precision would increase too. It seems usable for reviewing task documents as well.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\n確かに持って帰れたらいいんですが……元の世界の知識も曖: @Chizuru_S\nIndeed, it would be great if we could bring it back... but when our knowledge of our original world is hazy, can we really return with it remembered?
Message.頑張って覚えても、元の世界に帰ったらなんだっけ？ ってなっちゃいそうだよね。: Even if we try hard to memorize it, once we return to our original world, we'd probably end up like 'what was it again?'.
Message.@Kei_A\\nぐっ……言い返せないわ。 確かに気持ちが逸ってたわ……: @Kei_A\nGugh... I can't talk back to that. I really was getting ahead of myself...
Message.まあ、あったら便利だけどなくても何とかなるんじゃないかなー？ サバイバルだってそ: Well, it'd be convenient to have, but we'll probably manage without it, right~? Survival is pretty much like that anyway!
Message.榊と彩峰が何やら言い争いをしていたのだが……詳しいことを知っているものはいるか？: Sakaki and Ayamine were arguing about something... Does anyone know the details?
Message.@Miki_T\\nこっちの世界でも仲の悪さは変わんねーんだな……: @Miki_T\nEven in this world, their bad relationship hasn't changed, huh...
Message.@Meiya_M\\nあ、ボク知ってるよ！ 確か、依頼先のやり方で喧嘩しちゃった: @Meiya_M\nAh, I know! Pretty sure they fought over the way to handle things at the client's place.
Message.うん、依頼先の人はやり方は好きにしていいって言ってたけど……: Yeah, the client said we could do it however we liked, but...
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\nだとしても、マニュアルがあるなら従うべきでしょ！ なのに: @Mikoto_Y\nEven so, if there's a manual, you should follow it! But Ayamine went ahead and did it her own way without permission!
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\n時間優先。さっさと済ませたほうがいい。: @Mikoto_Y\nTime takes priority. Better to finish quickly.
Message.@Kei_A\\n今後もお願いされるかもしれないんだから、丁寧にやるのが当然でし: @Kei_A\nWe might be asked again in the future, so doing it thoroughly is only natural! Doing a sloppy job just troubles the client!
Message.ねえ、勝手に山に入ったら怒られるかな？: Hey, will I get scolded if I enter the mountain without permission?
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n……当たり前でしょ。ちゃんと手続きをして申請をしないとだ: @Mikoto_Y\n...Of course. You have to go through proper procedures and apply.
Message.あー、やっぱりそうだよね。結構探検というか、行ってみたい場所があるんだけど……う: Ah~, thought so. I have quite a few places I want to explore or visit, but... mm, such a pain.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣、客人である以上は郷に入れば郷に従うべきだ。: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi, as long as you're a guest, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Message.まあでも、気持ちは分かるな。手続き面倒くさいんだよなぁ……: Well, but I get the feeling. Procedures are such a pain...
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nねー、面倒だよね。代わりに誰か手続きしてくれないかなぁ…: @Takeru_S\nRight~, it's a pain. I wonder if someone would do the procedures for me...
Message.それでやるっていう奴はいないだろ……: No one's gonna say they'll do it for that reason...
Message.そういえば、生徒会長さんに山に行っていいかってお願いしてきたよー！: Speaking of which, I asked the student council president if we could go to the mountain~!
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\nえっ、ピクニック！？ わたしもいきたい！: @Mikoto_Y\nEh, a picnic!? I want to go too!
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n美琴が行くんだぞ。ピクニックじゃなくてサバイバルに決まっ: @Sumika_K\nMikoto is the one going. It's obviously gonna be survival, not a picnic.
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\n良かったじゃない。折角の山登りなんだから楽しんできたら？: @Mikoto_Y\nIsn't that great. Since it's a mountain climb after all, why not enjoy it?
Message.＠Meiya_M\\nそうなんだよねぇ。一応、ここの近くの山は学園の管理外で外部: @Meiya_M\nYeah, that's right. Apparently, the mountains near here aren't under academy management and there are outsiders, so for our safety, a supervisor is necessary.
Message.おい、なんかオレ、オチが読めたぞ。: Hey, somehow I can read the punchline.
Message.うーん……端末の容量が足りない……: Mmm... The terminal storage isn't enough...
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\nあー、分かるぞ美琴。使ってないゲームは削除していかないと: @Mikoto_Y\nAh~, I get it, Mikoto. If you don't delete games you aren't playing, storage really exceeds its limit in the blink of an eye.
Message.ゲームってそんなに端末の容量を使うんですか？: Do games really take up that much terminal storage space?
Message.＠Miki_T\\nみたいだねー。うーん、結構やってないのもあるから消していこっ: @Miki_T\nSeems so~. Mmm, there are quite a few I haven't been playing, so maybe I'll delete them.
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nしかし、タケルはよく知っていたな。: @Takeru_S\nStill, Takeru was remarkably knowledgeable about that.
Message.もしかして、前に壊れたって半泣きで生徒会の人へ相談にいってたのって……: Could it be that the person who went to consult the student council almost crying because it broke before was...
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n純夏！ 飯奢ってやるから内緒にしといてくれ！: @Sumika_K\nSumika! I'll treat you to a meal so keep it a secret!
Message.うう、お金が足りないよ……: Ugh, I don't have enough money...
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\nえっ？ 足りない？ まさか仕事の報酬ぜんぶ使っちゃったの: @Mikoto_Y\nEh? Not enough? Did you blow all your mission rewards or something?
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n容量が空いたから、気になる新作ゲームを色々と買ってたら: @Chizuru_S\nSince storage freed up, I was buying various new games I was curious about... Plus folk art crafts I liked...
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣……あなたまで白銀みたいな無駄使いをしていたらダメよ: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi... You shouldn't waste money like Shirogane does.
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\nおい、俺は関係ないだろ！: @Chizuru_S\nHey, I have nothing to do with this!
Message.＠Takeru_S\\n私にであれば可能な限り善処するが、余人に無心を頼むのは感: @Takeru_S\nIf it's to me, I'll deal with it as best as I can, but asking others for money isn't praiseworthy. I think you should reflect on yourself before it becomes a major issue.
Message.あっ、それいいね！ ボクもお小遣いが足りない時は奢って貰おう！: Ah, that sounds great! I'll ask people to treat me too when my pocket money isn't enough!
Message.ダメな方で共鳴しないの！: Don't resonate on the bad side!
Message.鎧衣さんとタケルちゃん、ふたりともこっちの世界満喫してるね……: Yoroi-san and Takeru-chan, both of you are enjoying this world to the fullest, huh...
Message.ねえねえ、彩峰さんどこにいるのー！？ 依頼の日だよー！: Hey hey, Ayamine-san, where are you~!? It's the day of the commission~!
Message.＠Kei_A\\nええええ！？ わたしの方が遅刻ー！？ 今行くねー！: @Kei_A\nEhhhh!? I'm the one who's late~!? Coming right now~!
Message.……これどう考えても、彩峰が待ち合わせ無視して、さっさと依頼に行ったよな？: ...No matter how you look at this, Ayamine ignored the meeting point and rushed straight to the request, right?
Message.＠Kei_A\\n彩峰！こういう行き違いを防ぐために、一度集合するって話だったで: @Kei_A\nAyamine! We talked about gathering once to prevent this kind of miscommunication, didn't we!
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n早く着いて先に作業していれば早く終わる。何も問題はない: @Chizuru_S\nArriving early and working ahead finishes it early. No problem at all.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n問題大ありよ！ そのせいで鑑さんが困ってるじゃない！: @Kei_A\nThere's a HUGE problem! Thanks to that, Kagami-san is troubled, isn't she!
Message.＠Kei_A\\nあなたねぇ……！ 帰ってきたらお話があるからね！: @Kei_A\nYou...! We need to talk once you get back!
Message.やっぱり、やきそばパンは至高。: Yakisoba pan is supreme after all.
Message.こっちだと知らない食べ物も多いですし、なにより食事が美味しくて、ついつい食べ過ぎ: There are many unfamiliar foods over here, and above all, meals are delicious, so you end up accidentally overeating, don't you.
Message.＠Miki_T\\nそうね。和食もあるし、選択肢が多くて助かるわ。: @Miki_T\nIndeed. There's Japanese food too, and having many choices is a big help.
Message.ジャンクフードも美味いんだよなぁ……特に深夜に食うのは反則レベルだ。: Junk food is super tasty too... Eating it late at night is straight-up foul level.
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nあー、夜にゲームしながら食べるとなおさら美味しいよねぇ。: @Takeru_S\nAh~, eating it at night while gaming makes it taste even better~.
Message.……あなたたち、夜更かしして間食してるの？: ...Are you guys staying up late and snacking?
Message.柊校舎の屋上、悪くない。: The rooftop of Hiiragi building, not bad.
Message.見晴らしも良くて風も気持ちいい。: The view is great and the breeze feels good.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n気分転換によさそうですね！: @Kei_A\nSeems good for a change of pace!
Message.＠Kei_A\\n行政地区の建物は基本的に屋上が未開放だからなぁ。: @Kei_A\nBuildings in the administrative district basically don't have open rooftops, after all.
Message.私は一度あがったことがある。良い景色であった。: I've gone up once. It was a fine view.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n……嫌な予感がするんだけど、ちゃんと許可は貰ってるわよね？: @Kei_A\n...I have a bad feeling about this, but you got proper permission, right?
Message.＠Kei_A\\n多分じゃないわよ！？ ちゃんと許可は取らないと迷惑がかかるでし: @Kei_A\nDon't say 'probably'!? If you don't get proper permission, it causes trouble!
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n榊は堅苦しい。空は自由。: @Chizuru_S\nSakaki is stiff. The sky is free.
Message.こっちの世界、飯が美味いから太りそうなんだよな……\\n運動量増やすべきか？: The food in this world is so good I feel like I'll gain weight...\nShould I increase my exercise?
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nうう……わたしもあんまり人の事言えないかも……食べすぎち: @Takeru_S\nUgh... I can't really talk about others either... I might turn squishy from overeating.
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n食は人の天なりと言う。自堕落な食事は禁物だぞ。: @Sumika_K\nThey say food is heaven to the people. Self-indulgent eating is forbidden.
Message.＠Meiya_M\\nそうですね！何事も体が資本ですから！体にいいものを食べない: @Meiya_M\nThat's right! Health is wealth for everything! We must eat things good for the body!
Message.強化装備や軍装が入らなくなっちゃったら大変よ。: It'd be disastrous if fortified equipment or military wear stopped fitting.
Message.ボクはいくら食べても太らないけどなあ。: I don't gain weight no matter how much I eat, though.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣、その発言は世界を敵に回すわよ。: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi, that statement will make an enemy of the whole world.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n羨ましい。私は胸がキツくなる。: @Mikoto_Y\nJealous. Mine gets tight around the chest.
Message.＠Kei_A\\nそれはそれで世界を敵に回す発言です……: @Kei_A\nThat is a statement that makes an enemy of the world in its own right...
Message.新しいパイロットスーツ……\\n脱ぎ着するのにちょっとコツがいりますね。\\n脚: The new pilot suit...\nTaking it on and off takes a bit of a knack.\nMy leg got caught in a weird spot and I panicked...
Message.＠Meru_M \\n無理に引っ張って壊さないようにしなさいよ。\\n支給品なん: @Meru_M\nDon't force-pull it and break it.\nIt's issued equipment, after all.
Message.＠Meru_M \\n普段の制服と違って特殊な素材ですから、着るのが少し手間かも: @Meru_M\nUnlike regular uniforms, it's a special material, so putting it on might take a bit of effort.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n一癖二癖あるスーツよね。\\nでもちゃんと考えて着れば、慣れ: @Meru_M\nIt's a suit with a quirk or two.\nBut if you put it on thoughtfully, getting used to it won't take much time.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも……少し時間がかかりそう。\\nマニュアルがないと前: @Meru_M\nI'm... probably going to take a bit of time too.\nWithout a manual, I feel like I'd put it on backward...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうですね……訓練のとき以外でも着脱練習できれば…: @T_Commander\nIndeed... If we could practice putting it on and off outside of training too...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはいっ！ あとは数をこなすしかないですね。頑張りま: @T_Commander\nYes! All that's left is to do it repeatedly. I'll do my best!
Message.＠T_Commander\\n必ず本番までにスムーズに着られるようにしますね。: @T_Commander\nI will definitely make sure to put it on smoothly before the actual performance.
Message.天穹の操縦マニュアルを読み込んでるんですけど\\n機能がたくさんあって覚えるのが: I'm thoroughly reading the Tenkyu operation manual,\nthere are so many functions it's hard to memorize them all.\nBut it really is an awesome unit!
Message.＠Meru_M \\nめるちゃんなら気合でいけるいける！: @Meru_M\nMeru-chan can totally do it with willpower!
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしもマニュアルはまだよくわからないけど、確かにすごくいい: @Meru_M\nI don't really understand the manual well yet either, but I can certainly tell it's a super good unit.
Message.＠Meru_M \\n基本の操作は今までの機体と共通してますから、\\nそんなに: @Meru_M\nBasic controls are shared with previous units,\nso there's no need to panic that much.
Message.＠Meru_M \\nめるってば読むことに集中しすぎて、徹夜したりしてそう……: @Meru_M\nKnowing Meru, she's probably concentrating so hard on reading that she stays up all night...
Message.＠Rami_K \\nうぅ……図星です……\\n実際昨日も遅くまで読みふけってし: @Rami_K\nUgh... Hit the nail on the head...\nActually yesterday too I was engrossed in reading until late...
Message.＠Meru_M\\nほら言わんこっちゃない。作戦の前に寝不足で体調崩したりしない: @Meru_M\nSee, what did I tell you. Don't ruin your condition from sleep deprivation before the operation, okay?\nIt's not early today either, go to sleep now.
Message.『双頭の斧』一斉検挙……ＭＧ競技ともまた違う対人の作戦……しかも今度はこちらから: Simultaneous roundup of 'Double-Headed Axe'... A person-versus-person operation, different from MG competitions... Plus this time we're taking the initiative... Somehow I feel a bit hesitant.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n……そうですわね。ですが、彼らは人々の安全を脅かす存在でもあ: @Meru_M\n...Indeed. However, they are also entities that threaten people's safety.\nThere's no need for us to hesitate... That is how we should think.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n＠Nanairo_N\\nそーそー！\\n悪いことしてるやつ: @Nanairo_N\nYeah, yeah!\nLet's all smash those guys doing bad things!
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\n相手は違法パイロットの組織よ。\\n卑怯な手を使ってく:
@Chiyuru_T
The opponent is an illegal pilot organization.
They might use cowardly tricks.
Don't let your guard down~.
Message.＠Rami_K\\n……相手がどう動くか、予測しにくい。\\n罠とか仕掛けられて: @Rami_K\n...It's hard to predict how the opponent will move.\nTraps might be set as well.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……！\\nはいっ、私も皆さ: %usernameusernameuserna%-san...!\nYes, I will protect everyone with all my power too.\nLet's all return safely together!
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはい！ みんなで互いに助け合っていけば、何も危ない: @T_Commander\nYes! As long as everyone helps each other, nothing should be dangerous...!
Message.作戦本番まで時間はありませんわ。引き続き、その少ない時間を可能な限り天穹の習熟に: There is little time until the actual operation. Let's continue striving to familiarize ourselves with Tenkyu as much as possible within that brief time.
Message.来たる作戦に向けて、エネルギーと気合をしっかり補充しようと思うんです！\\nなの: For the upcoming operation, I plan to properly replenish energy and spirits!\nSo today, I'm getting the jumbo cutlet curry at the cafeteria!
Message.＠Meru_M \\nいいねいいね！ いっぱい食べるめるちゃん好きだよ。\\nあ: @Meru_M\nNice, nice! I love Meru-chan eating a lot.\nMaybe I'll get pumped up with a jumbo burger and mega-portion fries too~.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも……マカダミアナッツ大盛りを食べ納めしておく。\\n: @Meru_M\nI'll... eat a mega portion of macadamia nuts one last time too.\nNuts really are supreme.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nむしろわたくしは本番を見据えて、ここしばらくはバランスの良い: @Meru_M\nRather, looking ahead to the main performance, I intend to keep a balanced diet in mind for a while.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nそれが正解ね。というか、調子に乗って食べ過ぎて、スーツ: @Nanairo_N\nThat's the right answer. I mean, don't get carried away, overeat, and end up like 'I can't fit into my suit anymore~!', okay?
Message.このスーツ、すごくピチッとしてる。普通の制服とは全然違う感覚。: This suit is super tight. A completely different feel from normal uniforms.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nわかるー！ でも素材が柔らかくて意外と動きやすいよね。: @Shirona_I\nI know, right~! But the material is soft and surprisingly easy to move in.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n＠Chiyuru_T\\n天穹には間接思考制御が未搭載: @Chiyuru_T\nWas the story that because Tenkyu isn't equipped with indirect thought control, this suit compensates for it? Since specs are different, getting used to it seems tough.
Message.会長が言うには、天穹を動かすのに絶対必要なものなんですよね。: According to the president, it's something absolutely necessary to pilot Tenkyu, right.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nええ。これから双頭の斧の検挙という大作戦も控えていますし、早: @Meru_M\nYes. We have the big operation of arresting Double-Headed Axe ahead, so we must quickly get used to the unit and suit.
Message.＠Meru_M\n＠Nanairo_N\nうん。でもいくら黎明と似てると言っても: @Nanairo_N\nYeah. But no matter how similar it is to Reimei, I'm a bit anxious about whether I can handle it properly before the operation...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nありがとう。あなたがそう言って見守ってくれていると: @T_Commander\nThank you. Knowing that you say so and watch over us makes me feel strangely relieved.
Message.みんな、天穹の操作マニュアルってもう読んだ？: Has everyone read the Tenkyu operation manual already?
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nいや、まだ全然。着替えたばっかだし、これから読もうと思: @Shirona_I\nNo, not at all yet. Just changed clothes, was thinking of reading it now.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nあたしもパラパラって斜め読みしただけかなー。とりあえず: @Shirona_I\nI just skimmed through it loosely too~. Anyway, if we try moving it we'll get it!
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nちゆるさん……ちゃんとマニュアルには目を通してください: @Chiyuru_T\nChiyuru-san... Please properly go through the manual. Though, the volume is large so I understand how you feel, but...
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n私も少し読みましたけど、黎明とは細かいところで意外と違: @Shirona_I\nI read a bit too, but there are surprisingly different parts from Reimei in small details, so I'm confused. Basic parts are the same, but... can we really operate it well?
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも同じ。でも、少しでも早くみんなの役に立てるように、今: @Meru_M\nSame for me. But to be of help to everyone even a bit faster, I'll summarize just the key points and share them now.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nまぁ！ 白奈さん、すごく助かりますわ！ すぐに目を通し: @Shirona_I\nMy! Shirona-san, that helps so much! I'll go through it right away.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n白奈めっちゃ真面目じゃん。ラミもそれ見ておくわ。サンキ: @Shirona_I\nShirona is super diligent. Rami will check that out too. Thanks.
Message.作戦日が近づいてきて、なんだかそわそわしてきちゃった。: As the operation day approaches, I've gotten kind of restless.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nわかります！ 私も落ち着かないです。: @Shirona_I\nI understand! I can't settle down either.

Message.一種の慣れです。両手両足でそれぞれ別の文字を書くようなものですから、段階的に訓練: It's a kind of habituation. It's like writing different characters with both hands and feet, so with step-by-step training, you can master it to an extent.
Message.儂は何も言わんぞ。ただ……生きていく上で大きさは不要じゃ。うむ。: I won't say anything. Just... size isn't necessary for living. Mm.
Message.味方を撃つような下手な制御はしませんが……ストレリツィの性能を活かしきるためにも: I won't control it poorly enough to shoot allies, but... to fully utilize Strelitsi's performance, everyone's cooperation is essential.
Message.案ずるな盟友よ。我らクラスナも付いている。共に硝煙弾雨を駆け抜け、勝利を掴み取る: Worry not, sworn ally. We of Krasna are with you too. Together we shall charge through hail of gunfire and seize victory!
Message.盟友たちよ、今こそ己が存在証明のため、戦場へと赴く時だ！: Sworn allies, now is the time to march to the battlefield to prove our very existence!
Message.私たちはこの機体を用意してくれた仲間に感謝するだけでなく、この先の戦いで活躍し、: We must not only thank the comrades who prepared this machine for us, but active in upcoming battles and respond with results.\n
Message.複座型新型機『ストレリツィ』、これが新しい私とお母様の機体なんですね……。: Double-seater new machine 'Strelitsi', this is the new machine for mother and me...
Message.＠Elena_P\\nう……その、はい……私、みなさんやお母様のように大人っぽく: @Elena_P\nUgh... um, yes... because I'm not adult-like like everyone or mother...
Message.＠Elena_P\\nふっ、そんなもの全て躱せばいいだけだ。我に死角は無い！: @Elena_P\nHmph, all of those just need to be dodged. I have no blind spots!
Message.＠Elena_P\\n確かに……エレーナさんのココアは、ニーナさんもジーナさんも: @Elena_P\nIndeed... Elena-san's cocoa is drunk deliciously by both Nina-san and Gina-san.
Message.＠Elena_P\\n量だけじゃなくて、それぞれ好みも違うんだよね。でも、総合的: @Elena_P\nNot just amount, but preferences differ for each too. But overall, maybe it balances out.
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nあ、もしかして、みんなと比べられるのが嫌とか？: @Nadja_V\nAh, could it be you dislike being compared to everyone?
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nううん、『私』はいつも見ているだけ。一緒に戦っているのはジ: @Nadja_V\nNo, 'I' am always just watching. The one fighting together is Gina... In recent battles, I felt that deeply again...
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nうん。え？ ……ジーナが『我も同意見だ！』だって。ふふ。: @Nadja_V\nYeah. Eh? ...Gina says, 'I hold the same opinion!'. Fufu.
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nええ、そうです。私たちのために調整された、レドフカの技術の: @Nadja_V\nYes, that's right. It's a state-of-the-art machine adjusted for us, bringing together the best of Redofka's technology.
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nそうそう。まだまだこれからだよ！ 望みはあるって！: @Nadja_V\nYeah yeah. It's just getting started! There is hope!
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nそんなに気にしなくてもいいと思う。オルガさんの娘なんだし、: @Nadja_V\nI don't think you need to mind it that much. She's Olga-san's daughter, so she'll surely grow big.
Message.＠Nadja_V\\nふふ、あれは甘いからっていうより……心と身体が温かくなるか: @Nadja_V\nFufu, rather than because it's sweet... I like it because it warms the heart and body, maybe.
Message.＠Nadja_V\\n何か、どうしても困る理由でもあるのですか？: @Nadja_V\nIs there some reason that genuinely troubles you no matter what?
Message.＠Nadja_V\\n間接思考制御の補助のために必要なものです。割り切るしかない: @Nadja_V\nIt is something necessary to assist indirect thought control. We just have to accept it.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nええ……味方の攻撃まで気にしてたら、それこそキリがないよ～。: @Nina_M\nYeah... if you worry even about allies' attacks, there really will be no end to it~.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nお二人とも、お互いをリスペクトしているのですね。: @Nina_M\nYou both respect each other, don't you.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nそうじゃ。儂らのサポートをしてくれておる。: @Nina_M\nThat's right. She provides support for us.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nそのスピード感で寝れるの、すごいね……: @Nina_M\nBeing able to fall asleep at that speed is amazing...
Message.＠Nina_M\\nだって双子みたいなものなんだし、どっちかが姉でどっちかが妹な: @Nina_M\nBecause you're like twins, so I thought maybe one is older sister and one is younger sister.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nでもニーナさんは戦い以外のところで私たちを助けてくれてるじゃ: @Nina_M\nBut Nina-san helps us in places other than battle!
Message.＠Nina_M\\nジーナ、我らの出撃予定は延期になったのじゃ。: @Nina_M\nGina, our sortie schedule has been postponed.
Message.＠Nina_M\\nニーナさんって小食だもんね。ジーナさんはたくさん食べるけど。: @Nina_M\nNina-san is a light eater, after all. Though Gina-san eats a lot.
Message.＠Nina_M\\n急にどうしたんですか？ いつも一緒に戦ってるのに……: @Nina_M\nWhat happened all of a sudden? We always fight together, though...
Message.＠Nina_M\\n機体の修理に思ったより時間がかかってしまっているらしいです。: @Nina_M\nIt seems machine repairs are taking more time than expected.
Message.＠Nina_M\\n珍しいですね。必要なら、救護テントまで送りましょうか？: @Nina_M\nHow rare. If needed, shall I take you to the aid tent?
Message.＠Nina_M\\n結構両極端だもんね。あれ、でも……甘いものはどっちも好きじゃ: @Nina_M\nThey're quite opposite extremes, aren't they. Huh, but... didn't both like sweets?
Message.＠Olga_V\\nうん……どうやってるのか想像もつかない。: @Olga_V\nYeah... I can't even imagine how it's done.
Message.＠Olga_V\\nそうじゃな。今までのフォーメーションや連携からは意識を切り替: @Olga_V\nThat's true. Need to switch awareness from formations and cooperation until now. After all, the specs are too different.
Message.＠Olga_V\\nそう言いつつも、オルガは最初期の訓練から４機を動かしていたで: @Olga_V\nWhile saying that, didn't Olga operate 4 units from early training?
Message.＠Olga_V\\nそもそも４機を別々に動かせる時点ですごいと思うんだけど……: @Olga_V\nTo begin with, moving 4 units separately at this point is amazing, I think...
Message.＠Olga_V\\nちょっと休んだら大丈夫だと思う。ありがとう、オルガさん。: @Olga_V\nI think I'll be fine after a little rest. Thank you, Olga-san.
Message.＠Olga_V\\n私はお母様の力になれて、嬉しいですよ。: @Olga_V\nI'm happy to be able to help mother.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n……違うよ。ジーナは私ができないことをやってくれて: @T_Commander\n...No. Gina is doing what I cannot do.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nあ、ジーナが『我が姉に決まっている！ 姉は妹を守る: @T_Commander\nAh, Gina says, 'I am obviously the older sister! For an older sister is one who protects the younger sister!'
Message.＠T_Commander\\nえっとその……だからこそ気になるというか……: @T_Commander\nUmm, that... is precisely why I'm curious, or rather...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうかな？ ……うん、%usernameusern: @T_Commander\nIs that so? ...Yeah, if %usernameusernameuserna% says so, I might feel that way.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうかもしれないけど、ジーナの功績を自分のものだと: @T_Commander\nThat might be so, but I can't consider Gina's achievements as my own.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそれはいい案ですね。なるべく強いチームと模擬戦をす: @T_Commander\nThat's a good idea. Doing mock battles with as strong a team as possible will likely yield sufficient data.

Message.＠T_Commander\\nメイズシフター相手の実戦は、チームの連携を確かめる: @T_Commander\nActual battle against Maze Shifters might be just right for checking team cooperation.
Message.＠Tatyana_D\\nあまり考えたことなかったけど、どうなんだろう……。: @Tatyana_D\nI haven't thought about it much, but I wonder...
Message.＠Tatyana_D\\nうん……食事の後すぐに交代したから、まだお肉の感覚とか: @Tatyana_D\nYeah... since we swapped right after eating, the sensation and taste of meat still remains...
Message.＠Tatyana_D\\nなっ……！？ なぜだ！？ 戦場こそが我が魂の揺り籠だと: @Tatyana_D\nWha...!? Why!? Even though the battlefield is the cradle of my soul!
Message.＠Tatyana_D\\n問題ありません。ただ、やはり今のところ制御は４機までが: @Tatyana_D\nNo problem. However, currently controlling up to 4 units is the limit, as expected.
Message.＠Tatyana_D\\n確かに動かせてはいましたが、今のような制御は出来ていま: @Tatyana_D\nI could indeed move them, but couldn't control them like now.

Message.%usernameusernameuserna%さんとの約束、取り付けられました: I managed to set up the promise with %usernameusernameuserna%-san!
Message.……一体誰のせいだと思ってんのよ。: ...Whose fault do you think it is?
Message.あたしも行きつけの本屋に早く営業再開してほしいし、そっちを手伝いに行こうかなぁ。: I want my regular bookstore to reopen soon too, maybe I'll go help out there.
Message.うう、久しぶりに訓練で失敗しちゃいました……: Ugh, I failed during training for the first time in a while...
Message.ええ、わたくしたちもしっかりお手伝いしていかなければなりませんわね。: Yes, we must firmly help out as well.
Message.お、それいいね。それじゃ後で報告会ってことで。: Oh, that's good. Let's make it a debriefing session later then.
Message.お土産話、ならちょうどよさそう。: Tales of souvenirs seems just right then.
Message.そうだね。浮ついた状態で訓練すると危ないよ～。: True. Training while unfocused is dangerous~.
Message.そうですね……あの、その代わりお土産買ってきますから！: That's true... Um, instead I'll buy souvenirs and come back!
Message.でも、本当によかったんですか？ その、私だけ抜け駆けみたいに約束してしまって……: But was it really okay? Um, me making a promise ahead like stealing a march...
Message.なんにしても、わたくしたちも普段お世話になっているのですから、その恩を返すために: In any case, we are indebted normally, so let's do our best to return the favor.
Message.はい……その、私、頑張ります！ %usernameusernameuserna%: Yes... Um, I will do my best! So that I can convey my feelings to %usernameusernameuserna%-san...!
Message.ふふ、そうですわね。めるさんのお土産話を楽しみにしていますわ。: Fufu, indeed. I look forward to Meru-san's souvenir stories.
Message.まったく、ちゃんと集中しないとダメじゃない。訓練中に関係ないことばかり考えるから: Goodness, you must concentrate properly. Failing because you keep thinking about irrelevant things during training.
Message.もう……みなさん、自分の都合を優先してばかりですわね……: Geez... everyone keeps prioritizing their own convenience...
Message.少しずつですけど、復興が始まりましたね。: Little by little, reconstruction has begun, hasn't it.
Message.早くお気に入りの公園だけでも、復旧できるといいんだけど。: I hope at least my favorite park can be restored soon.
Message.確かに今日の訓練には身が入っていませんでしたわね……理由はなんとなくわかりますけ: Indeed today's training lacked focus... I can somewhat guess the reason though.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nうんうん。変な遠慮とかしなくていいよ。: @Meru_M\nYeah yeah. No need for strange hesitation.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nええ。めるさんが最初に勇気を出したんですもの。今回は譲ります: @Meru_M\nYes. Meru-san gathered courage first. I'll yield this time.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nま、頑張りなさい。肝心なところでヘタレないようにね。: @Meru_M\nWell, do your best. Don't chickening out at the crucial moment.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nそれはそうだけど、実況は厳しいでしょ、さすがに……: @Shirona_I\nThat's true, but live commentary is tough, as expected...
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n実況って、何させようとしてるのよ……: @Shirona_I\nWhat live commentary are you trying to make her do...

Message.＠T_Commander\\n確かに、モチベーションがあった方が頑張れそうですね: @T_Commander\nIndeed, having motivation makes it easier to work hard.
Message.……その、不束な妹ですが、みなさんよろしくお願いしますね。: ...Um, my incompetent little sister, please take care of her everyone.
Message.あぁ！？ 誰が狂犬よ？: Ah!? Who is a mad dog?
Message.ああ、すぐにこの学園の新たなボスになるんだからな！: Yeah, because I'll become the new boss of this academy soon!
Message.う、うん……あれ？ なんか、いいようにされたような……？: U-Yeah... Huh? Feels like I got taken advantage of somehow...?
Message.そ、そんなことしないわよ！ ……とにかく、お姉ちゃんは心配しなくていいから。: I-I won't do that! ...Anyway, big sister doesn't need to worry.
Message.そういえば、影具鎚に乗ったコトハとは\\nまだ一度も戦ったことがないな。\\n: Come to think of it, I haven't fought Kotoha riding Shadow Hammer even once yet.\n
Message.そんな、心配もさせてもらえないなんて……私はコトハにとって必要ない、ということで: To think I'm not even allowed to worry... Does that mean I'm unnecessary to Kotoha...?
Message.ち、違う、そんなわけないでしょ！ その、お姉ちゃんが気にかけてくれるのは、嬉しい: N-No, that's not it! Um, I'm happy big sister cares... I was just a bit embarrassed...
Message.ちょっとお姉ちゃん！ 悪くないって言っただけでしょ！: Wait big sister! I only said it wasn't bad!
Message.でも一度衝突しといた方が、後々仲良くなれるかもよ？: But clashing once might make us get along better later, you know?
Message.どうもこうも、まあ、悪くないんじゃない？: Regardless, well, isn't it not bad?
Message.なんか無駄に尖ってるね。さすが狂犬。: Somehow unnecessarily sharp. As expected of a mad dog.
Message.なんだか今更な気もするけど、柊校舎に通うことになったわ。改めてよろしく。: Feels a bit late now, but I'll be attending Hiiragi campus. Nice meeting you again.
Message.ふふ、よかったです。それではこれからも、コトハをしっかり見守っていますからね。: Fufu, I'm glad. Well then, I'll keep a close eye on Kotoha from now on as well.
Message.ふふ、安心しました。コトハが楽しんでいるようで。: Fufu, I'm relieved. Kotoha seems to be enjoying herself.
Message.ふふ、私はお姉ちゃんですから。もっと素直に甘えてくれてもいいんですよ？: Fufu, I am the older sister after all. You can depend on me more honestly, you know?
Message.ま、一応よろしくしといてあげる。: Well, I'll greet you for now.
Message.よ、よろしくお願いします……それで、あ、あの！ えっと……%usernameus: N-Nice to meet you... So, u-um! What kind of relationship do you have with %usernameusernameuserna%-san...?
Message.コトハなら嫌なことは嫌だとハッキリ言うでしょうから。『悪くない』ということは、そ: Kotoha would clearly say no to what she dislikes. Saying 'not bad' means she's enjoying it somewhat, right?
Message.ボスの強さは半端じゃないぞ！: The boss's strength is no joke!
Message.ラミさん、同じ校舎の仲間なんですから、仲良くしてくださいまし。: Rami-san, since we're comrades in the same campus, please get along.
Message.上等じゃない……！ どっちが格上かわからせてあげるわ！: Bring it on...! I'll show you who's superior!
Message.何か困ったことがあったら、何でも言ってくださいね！: If you have any trouble, feel free to say anything!
Message.同じ柊校舎に通う仲間として、切磋琢磨していこう。: As comrades attending the same Hiiragi campus, let's encourage and improve each other.
Message.学園での生活はどうですか？: How is life at the academy?
Message.拳を交えることで分かりあい、友情が芽生える……漫画でよくあるパターン。: Understanding each other by crossing fists, sprouting friendship... a common manga pattern.

Message.＠Kurara_K\\n確かに、ふたりが戦ったら\\nどうなるのかは興味があるわ: @Kurara_K\nIndeed, I'm interested in what happens if you two fight.

Description.アマツ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。主となるエリアには柊校舎の他、飲食店や商店、住: A district based on Amatsu regional culture. The main area includes the Hiiragi School Building alongside clustered restaurants, shops, and residences, making it a comfortable place to live. The Hiiragi School Building is equipped with various facilities, allowing students to lead a cultured life without feeling any inconveniences.
Description.スカラ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。スカラ校舎含めて校区全体が、複雑に入り組んだ城: A district based on Scala regional culture. The entire district, including the Scala School Building, features an intricately intertwined, fortress-like architectural structure due to continuous, unplanned expansions. With an open culture that accepts students regardless of their background, it serves as a melting pot of various races.
Description.ノヴァセレス地区の文化を基盤とした校区。ユーロ・タワーは学園のランドマークであり: A district based on Nova Ceres regional culture. The Euro Tower is the academy's landmark, a skyscraper visible from almost anywhere. Due to Nova Ceres's economic prosperity, the interior of the school building boasts well-appointed facilities, including various commercial establishments.
Description.リバティ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。ＬＯＣは創造性あふれる個性豊かな生徒が多く、: A district based on Liberty regional culture. LOC is home to many creative and uniquely talented students, and quite a few hold titles outside of being pilots. Aside from practical exercises and special classes, all basic instruction is conducted fully remotely.
Description.各校区から独立した商業区域。映画館やショッピングモール、ゲームセンターに飲食店な: A commercial zone independent of the various districts. Featuring movie theaters, shopping malls, arcades, and restaurants, it serves as a relaxation spot for the students. The Special Training School Building, which functions as a retraining facility, is also located within the city.
Description.学園の行政機関が集中している区域。伝統的な建築物から近未来的な衣装を取り入れたビ: An area where the academy's administrative organs are concentrated. It features a landscape fusing tradition and modernity, ranging from traditional architecture to buildings incorporating futuristic aesthetics. This zone is primarily used for lodging by non-student outsiders, and instructional commanders also sleep and stay in the dormitories located here.
Description.レドフカ地区の文化を基盤とした校区に存在する。所属はレドフカ出身者しか認められて: Located within a district based on Redovka regional culture. Only those hailing from Redovka are permitted membership, and the district is known for its rigorous education, training, and high loyalty. It has very little interaction with other school buildings.

Message.も、もしもし、桃園めるですっ！\nあの……今少しよろしいでしょうか？ 明日のお昼:
H-Hello, this is Meru Momozono!
Um... do you have a moment right now? I was thinking about the menu
for the bento lunch I'm bringing tomorrow...
Message.何かリクエストはありますか？ この前はパスタにしましたし、\nハンバーグや餃子も:
Do you have any requests? Last time we had pasta,
and we have Hamburg steak and gyoza pretty often, right?
I thought you might get tired of having the same things all the time...
Message.あなたには、飽きずにいつまでも……\nその、私のお弁当を食べてほしいから……:
Because I want you to... well, keep eating my lunches forever
without getting tired of them...
Message.あっ……そうだ！ オムライスなんてどうですか？\nそういえば、まだ作ってなかった:
Ah... I know! How about omurice?
Come to think of it, I haven't made that for you yet. I'm actually pretty confident in it.
Maybe I'll make the same thing for myself to bring along.
Message.それで……よろしければ、明日もお昼ご一緒しませんか？\n晴れるそうなので、ぜひと:
So... if you'd like, would you join me for lunch again tomorrow?
They say it's going to be sunny, so I'd love to eat out in the school courtyard...
Message.えへへ……最近お昼休みはいつもあなたを独り占めしてて、\n他のみんなに少し申し訳: Ehehe... I've been keeping you all to myself during lunch breaks lately, so I feel a little bad for everyone else...
Message.それじゃ、明日のお昼も楽しみにしていますねっ。: Well then, I'm looking forward to lunch tomorrow too!
Message.もしもし、えっと、桃園めるです！ 今よろしいでしょうか？\nその……もしよければ:
Hello, um, this is Meru Momozono! Do you have a moment right now?
Um... if it's alright, I wanted to ask about our next study session... while I still have the chance.
Message.その……あなたっていろんな女の子達から人気ですから……: You see... you're really popular with a lot of different girls, so...
Message.あ、ごめんなさい！ なんでもないです！\nもちろん、お忙しいなら全然断ってくれて:
Ah, I'm sorry! It's nothing!
Of course, if you're busy, please feel free to decline!
Message.でももし、また勉強会をしてくれるなら、\nまたふたりきりであの教室でやりたいです:
But if we do have another study session,
I'd love to study just the two of us in that classroom again... ehehe.
Message.次からは前よりも長く時間を取れればいいなって思っています。\nそれだけあなたと一:
I hope we can spend more time together next time than before.
That way, I can be with you longer...
Message.今度は何か美味しいお菓子や飲み物を持っていきますね！\nふたりで食べながら楽しく:
I'll bring some delicious snacks and drinks next time!
I hope we can have fun studying while enjoying them together!
Message.それでは楽しみにしていますね。\n新しい参考書とかいっぱい買わなきゃ……！:
Well then, I'll be looking forward to it.
I'll need to buy lots of new reference books...!
Message.あっ……%usernameusernameuserna%さん、お疲れ様です。\n:
Ah... thank you for your hard work, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Um... thank you so much for listening to my advice today.
I'm really glad I talked to you.
Message.そうじゃないと、いつまでもウジウジ悩んでしまって……\nきっと本番も集中できなか:
Otherwise, I would have kept moping around endlessly...
I probably wouldn't have been able to focus during the real thing either.
I wouldn't even have been able to make use of this concentration skills that everyone complimented me on.
Message.……あ、そうだ。もし一斉検挙作戦が始まったら、\nあまりお話しできる機会がないと:
...Ah, that's right. Once the roundup operation begins,
I don't think we'll have much chance to talk, so I wanted to say this now.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……\n私達の命……%use:
%usernameusernameuserna%...
We are entrusting our lives... to you, %usernameusernameuserna%.
I believe in you.
Message.だから%usernameusernameuserna%さんも、私を――私達を信じ:
So I would be really happy if you, %usernameusernameuserna%, could trust me—trust us—and lead us.
We will fulfill our duty with everything we've got.
Message.だから――当日はよろしくお願いいたしますね。: So—please take good care of us on that day.
Message.もしもし、鳴滝です。\nその、お時間は大丈夫でしょうか？:
Hello, this is Narutaki.
Um, do you have a moment to talk?
Message.今日はありがとうございましたわ……\nデートに誘ったのはわたくしなのに、色々とエ:
Thank you so much for today...
Even though I was the one who asked you out on a date, you ended up escorting me in so many ways.
Message.ふふ、でも結果的に良かった気がしますわ。\n初めてのエスコートをして頂いた相手が:
Fufu, but in the end, I feel it turned out well.
Having you as the person who escorted me for the very first time...
Message.……もしよろしければ、またデートをして頂けますか？: ...If you don't mind, would you go on another date with me?
Message.今日の事はとても勉強になりましたもの。\nだから、今度こそはちゃんとしたデートを:
I learned a lot from today's experience.
That's why I want to have a proper date next time.
Message.ふふ、次は今日みたいな失敗はしませんわ。\n一緒に楽しむことが大切……ですわよね:
Fufu, I won't make the same mistakes next time.
The important thing is enjoying our time together... right?
Message.だから、楽しみにしていてくださいませ。\n二人で一緒に楽しい時間を過ごせるデート:
So please look forward to it.
I'll plan a date where the two of us can have a wonderful time together♪
Message.そういうことで、またお誘いしますわね。\nでは……失礼します。:
With that said, I'll invite you again sometime.
Well then... good night.
Message.もしもし、鳴滝です。\nお時間は大丈夫でしょうか？:
Hello, this is Narutaki.
Do you have a moment?
Message.ふふ、お時間を頂きありがとうございます。\n今日は本当に助かりましたわ。:
Fufu, thank you for making time for me.
You were a huge help today.
Message.ゲームセンターの件は特に……あのままだと、\n何も見つからないまま沈んだ気分で帰:
Especially regarding the arcade... If you hadn't been there,
I would have gone home feeling down without finding anything.
Message.それで、頂いたぬいぐるみの名前を考えましたの。\nふふ、ちゃんとした普通の名前で:
So, I came up with a name for the plushie you gave me.
Fufu, it's a perfectly normal name.
Message.ナデシコちゃんって名前を付けましたの。\nええ、わたくしの育てている花の名前から:
I named it Nadeshiko-chan.
Yes, I named it after the flowers I grow♪
Message.どうしてナデシコにしたのかって？\n……その、それは……秘密、ですわ。:
Why did I choose Nadeshiko, you ask?
...Well, that's... a secret.
Message.ただ、わたくしの気持ちを込めて付けましたの……\nそ、それだけですわ！:
I just put my feelings into it when giving it that name...
Th-That's all there is to it!
Message.ナデシコちゃんは大切に致しますわね。\n……また、この子の様子を見に来てください:
I will take good care of Nadeshiko-chan.
...Please come check on her again sometime, okay?
Message.ええ……それじゃあ、また。\n失礼いたしますわ。:
Yes... Well then, see you later.
Goodbye.
Message.もしもーし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\n今日は色々と付:
Hellooo, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Thanks for hanging out with me today♪
Message.まあ、ちょっと調子を崩しちゃったけど、\nすっかりいつものあたしに戻ったよ！: Well, I got a bit out of sorts, but I'm completely back to my usual self now!
Message.でも、考えてみたんだけどさぁ。\n%usernameusernameuserna:
But you know, I was thinking about it.
You're at fault too, %usernameusernameuserna%!
Message.最近、すっごい楽しくなっちゃったからさぁ。\nそのせいで、ずっと一緒に遊びたいな:
Because things have been so super fun lately,
I ended up wanting to hang out with you all the time!
Message.だから、あたしらしくない行動だってしちゃって、\nまだまだいられるように……って:
That's why I acted out of character and tried so hard...
just so I could stay around longer.
Message.……って、ちょっと恥ずかしいこと言っちゃったかな？\nでも、これってあたしの本音:
...Wait, did I just say something embarrassing?
But hey, those are my true feelings, okay?
Message.だから、ちゃんと責任取って、\nもっといろいろと面白い事に付き合ってよね！:
So take responsibility and keep joining me
for all kinds of fun things!
Message.今日はありがとうね？\nちょっとあたしの情けない姿を見せちゃったかな……:
Thanks for today, okay?
I guess I showed you a pretty pathetic side of me...
Message.まあ、流石にああいう態度になっちゃうとねぇ……\n流石にちょっと悲しかったなぁ。:
Well, when people take an attitude like that...
It really made me a little sad, as expected.
Message.あの時も言ったけど、\n昔から態度が変わっちゃう子っていっぱい居たからね。:
Like I said back then,
there have always been lots of kids whose attitudes suddenly changed.
Message.これって何回経験しても慣れないんだよねぇ……: No matter how many times I experience this, I never get used to it...
Message.だからこそ、シリウスシュガーの皆も、\nキミもあたしに変わらず付き合ってくれるの:
That's why I'm so happy that everyone in Sirius Sugar,
and you as well, treat me the same as always♪
Message.……実はあたしの居場所がなくなっちゃうかも。\nなんて、不安になってたんだけど。: ...To be honest, I was getting anxious that I might lose my place here.
Message.でも、そんな不安は杞憂だったみたいだね！\nんー、この学園に来てからあたしって恵:
But it seems those worries were completely unfounded!
Hmm, maybe I've been really blessed since coming to this academy♪
Message.だから、キミたちともっと一緒に居られるように、\nちょっとはあたしも頑張ってみる:
So I'll try my best to do my part too,
just so I can stay with you all even longer♪
Message.もしもし～？ %usernameusernameuserna%、あけおめ～！\n:
Hello~? Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%~!
...Wait, I guess this greeting's expiration date has passed by now, hasn't it?
Message.いやぁ、餅パ楽しかったね～！\nまあ、さすがにあんだけの量あったからか、食べ切れ:
Man, that mochi party was so much fun~!
Well, as expected with that amount, we couldn't finish it all though.
...What should we do with the leftovers? Hand them out to everyone in Sirius Sugar?
Message.え？ また餅パやればいい？\nまあ、それはそうかもしれないけど、お正月はもう終わ:
Huh? Just host another mochi party?
Well, that might be true, but isn't New Year's already over?
Message.もし第１回をふたりでやったなんて言ったら、\nめるちゃん達ってばきっと別のおモチ:
If I tell them we held the 1st one with just the two of us,
Meru-chan and the others will definitely burn with a different kind of jealousy~
Message.ん？ なんのおモチかって？\nふふ、それは乙女のヒ・ミ・ツ♪:
Hmm? What kind of jealousy?
Fufu, that's a maiden's secret♪
Message.もしもーし！ 明日空いてる？ 当然、ラミのために空けてるよね～！\nまあ、おまえ:
Hellooo! Are you free tomorrow? Of course you kept it free for Rami, right~!
Well, you always look free anyway, so there's no way you aren't!
You should be grateful that I'm inviting you to listen to me vent again!
Message.というわけで、いつものカフェでよろしくー。: So with that said, see you at the usual cafe~
Message.はぁ！？ なんでよ！ ラミのためになんで空けてないのよ！\nラミがおまえに会うの:
Hah!? Why! Why didn't you keep it open for Rami!
Do you have any idea how much Rami was looking forward to seeing you...
Message.……って、今のナシ！\nとりあえず、その用事は後回し！ まずはラミに付き合うの！:
...Wait, strike that!
Anyway, put those plans on hold! You're hanging out with Rami first!
There is no other option!
Message.……ま、まあ、どうしても忙しいっていうなら、\nまた今度にしてあげてもいいけど。:
...W-Well, if you're absolutely busy,
I guess I could let you off the hook this time.
Message.えっ？ 頑張れば午後は大丈夫そう……？: Eh? You can manage the afternoon if you try...?
Message.……じゃ、なかった！ それくらいの気遣い、できて当然だし！\nんじゃ、明日の１３:
...Wait, no! That kind of consideration is only natural!
Alright then, tomorrow at 1:00 PM! Don't forget!
Message.やーっと出た！ 電話に出るのノロすぎ～！\nラミからの電話なんだから、秒で出なさ:
You finally picked up! You're way too slow to answer the phone~!
It's a call from Rami, so you should answer in a split second!
Message.用事？ 明日のメイズ探索に決まってんじゃん。\n察せないとか、ダメダメすぎない？:
What do I want? Maze exploration tomorrow, obviously.
How can you not figure that out? You're so hopeless!
Message.……は？ 約束してないって？ してなくてもそれに\n備えて空けとくのが、おまえの:
...Huh? We didn't make a promise? Even if we didn't,
keeping your schedule open just in case is your duty!
All of your time belongs to Rami!
Message.え？ 別にいいけど、浅い層しか行けないのにいいのかって？\nま、まあ、それは……:
Eh? You're asking if I'm fine with only going to shallow floors?
W-Well, that's... fine, isn't it?
Look! We might accidentally discover something, like Meru did!
Message.こっそりまた許可範囲外いくんじゃないかって？\nそれも大丈夫だし！ おまえこそ下:
You're worried I'll sneak past the allowed boundaries again?
That's fine too! You better not mess up and stray out of bounds yourself!
Message.じゃ、明日朝６時、ポータルに集合！: Alright, gather at the portal tomorrow morning at 6:00 AM!
Message.…………\n……ち、ちなみに、他のみんなは誘ってないから。:
...
...B-By the way, I didn't invite anyone else.
Message.もしもし！ 明日も初詣に付き合いなさい！\n今度は校区の端っこにある小さい神社に:
Hello! You're coming with me for Hatsumode tomorrow too!
This time we're going to that small shrine at the edge of the school district!
Message.……は？ また行くのかって？ とーぜんでしょ！\n学園敷地内にある全神社を制覇し:
...Huh? We're going again? Of course we are!
I'm going to conquer every single shrine on the academy grounds!
So keep your schedule clear!
Message.むっふっふ……これだけ願い事あちこちの神様に仕込んどけば、\nもう願い事叶いまく:
Muffuffu... If I plant my wishes with gods all over the place like this,
there's no doubt a bunch of my wishes will come true.
Man, having so many wishes I want granted is a real dilemma.
Message.でもやっぱり一番叶ってほしいのは、おまえと……: But the one I want granted the most is, with you...
Message.と、とにかく、明日！\nあと明後日と明々後日もついでに空けておいて！\nちなみに:
A-Anyway, tomorrow!
And while you're at it, clear your schedule for the day after tomorrow and the day after that too!
By the way, once we conquer them all, we're doing a second lap!
Message.え？ 本当は一緒に出かけたいだけじゃないかって？\nん、んなわけないでしょ！！:
Eh? You're asking if I just want to go out with you? 
N-No way!! Don't get the wrong idea!
Message.……………………まあ、ちょっとは……ほーんのちょっとだけ、\n楽しみにしてるけど:
.........Well, maybe a little... just a tiny, tiny bit,
I am looking forward to it, though.
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\nその、今電話をし:
Hello, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Um, is it alright to talk right now?
Message.……こうして、男の子と普通に電話をするのも初めて。\n普通の学生だと、こうして何:
...This is the first time I've called a boy normally like this.
Normal students talk on the phone like this over nothing, right?
Message.だから、特に内容も決めてないの。\n……ふふ、なんだか変な感じ。:
So I haven't really decided on what to talk about.
...Fufu, it feels a bit strange.
Message.いつだって何か考えてて理由があるって言われるけど……\nこんな風に、何も考えずに:
People always say I'm always thinking and have a reason for everything, but...
I wanted to call someone without thinking about anything, just like this.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%のおかげで、\n憧れてた普通の子:
Thanks to you, %usernameusernameuserna%,
I feel like I'm getting used to being the ordinary girl I always longed to be.
Message.……まだ、他の子の勘違いを解くには時間がかかると思うけど。\nでも、ちょっとずつ:
...I think it will still take time to clear up the misunderstandings with the other girls.
But I'll try my best, bit by bit, okay?
Message.だから、あなたには見守っていて欲しい。\n……もしも、困ったときがあったら頼らせ:
So I want you to keep watching over me.
...If I ever get into trouble, I'll rely on you, alright?
Message.だって、わたしは全然すごい子じゃない……\nただの『一条白奈』だから。:
Because I'm not an amazing girl at all...
I'm just "Shirana Ichijo."
Message.それじゃあ……また電話しようね？\nバイバイ。:
Well then... let's talk again on the phone, okay?
Bye-bye.
Message.その、今日は本当にありがとう。\n相談もだし、アクセサリーまでプレゼントして貰っ:
Um, thank you so much for today.
Not only for listening to my worries, but also for gifting me accessories...
Message.でも、本当に感謝してる。\nこのアクセサリーを見ると、ドンドン勇気が湧いてくるの:
I'm really grateful.
Whenever I look at this accessory, courage wells up inside me.
Message.今まで出来なかったことも、\n無理だって諦めたことも……挑戦してみようって思える:
Things I couldn't do before,
things I gave up on thinking were impossible... I feel like trying them now.
Message.……普段使いはしない。\n%usernameusernameuserna%が買っ:
...I won't wear it every day.
Since it's something you bought for me, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Message.このアクセサリーは世界に一つだけ。\n今日の思い出がこもったものだから。:
This accessory is one-of-a-kind in the world.
Because it holds the memories of today.
Message.だから、%usernameusernameuserna%。\nこのイヤリングは大:
So, %usernameusernameuserna%.
I will treasure these earrings.
Message.大切なことがある日には、このイヤリングを付けて行く。: On days when something important happens, I'll wear these earrings.
Message.そうすれば、このイヤリングに大切な思い出が増えて、\nもっと素敵な宝物になるから:
That way, more precious memories will be added to these earrings,
making them an even more wonderful treasure...
Message.……いよいよ、明日、一斉検挙。\nきっと作戦始まったら話せなくなりそうだから、話:
...Finally, tomorrow is the roundup operation.
I wanted to talk to you because we probably won't be able to once the operation begins.
Message.みんなとはどうなのかって？ とっくにいっぱい話した。\n長い作戦になるだろうから:
How did things go with everyone, you ask? We've already talked a lot.
It's going to be a long operation, so we won't be able to chat for a while.
That's why we talked about so many things.
Message.終わったら美味しいスイーツをみんなで食べに行こうとか、\n%usernameus:
Like going to eat delicious sweets together when it's over,
or taking you, %usernameusernameuserna%,
and visiting Amatsu again like during New Year's...
Message.こうして全部終わったあとのことをまっすぐ話せるのも、\n%usernameuse:
Being able to talk directly about what happens after everything is over
is because you gave me confidence, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Message.いつも%usernameusernameuserna%はわたし達を助けてくれる。:
You always help us, %usernameusernameuserna%.
You give us so many irreplaceable things and guide us.
Message.そんなあなただから、きっとみんなこの作戦に参加することを\n決めたんだと思う。つ:
Because you are that kind of person, I'm sure everyone decided to join this operation.
I think everyone wanted to follow you.
Message.……当日も、頼りにしてる。\nよろしく、わたし達の教導指揮官。:
...I'm relying on you on that day too.
We're counting on you, our instructor commander.
Message.もしもし、生駒葵だ。\n%usernameusernameuserna%の電話で:
Hello, this is Aoi Ikoma.
Is this %usernameusernameuserna%?
Message.ああ、よかった。\n……あの後、猫に餌をあげていた子から謝られたよ。:
