Message.それで、私の知らない場所だと、\n父さんがどんな人だったのか、何を考えてたのか、:
And I hope that, in places I don't know,
I can learn what kind of person my father was and what he was thinking.
Message.だから、その時は一緒に来てくれないかな。\n無事に帰ってこれたのはこの人のおかげ:
So, will you come with me when that time comes?
Because I want to introduce you as the person who made it possible for me to return safely.
Message.でも約束、ゼッタイ忘れないようにしろよ。\n一緒に帰るってやつ。:
But make sure you NEVER forget our promise.
The one about returning together.
Message.とにかく、覚えておいて。\nじゃあこれで……通話を切るボタンは確か……:
Anyway, keep it in mind.
Well then... the button to end the call was, if I recall...
Message.とにかく！ とっとと寝ろ！ また明日！\n寝不足でボケてたらぶっ飛ばすからな！:
Anyway! Go to sleep already! See you tomorrow!
If you're out of it from lack of sleep, I'll send you flying!
Message.なんか、髪結んでもらった分、\nちょっと勇気もらえたし……やっぱ今のナシナシ！:
Having my hair tied up gave me a bit of courage, so...
Wait, cancel that last part! Ughhh!
Message.ま、ラミ様にかかればそれぐらいラクショーだけどね。\nイザナミなんかぶっ飛ばして:
Well, for Rami-sama, something like that is a piece of cake.
We just have to blast Izanami away and get ourselves a free tomorrow!
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\n今、ちょっといい:
Hello, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Do you have a moment right now?
Message.今度、ファルファッラに案内してもらって、\n父さんがよく行ってた場所を巡ることに:
Next time, I decided to have Farfalla guide me around
places my father used to visit often.
Message.付き合ってくれて、まあ……助かったかも。\nそこは感謝してる。:
You coming along with me... well, was pretty helpful, I guess.
I'm grateful for that.
Message.大事な人に大事な人を紹介したいって、変なのかな。\nよく分からない。:
Is it weird that I want to introduce an important person to an important person?
I don't really know.
Message.……それと、先ほどの会話はニーナには伝えぬように。\n我が魂の片割れの負担となる:
...And don't tell Nina about our conversation earlier.
I cannot allow it to become a burden on my soul's other half.
Message.そのために、我はお前と共に戦うとしよう。\n同じ『今日』を生きる者として、な。:
To that end, I shall fight alongside you.
As those who share the same 'today'.
Message.ちょ、ちょっと、あまり怒鳴らないでください！\nいきなりどうしたんですか！？\n:
W-Wait, please don't shout like that!
What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?
Huh...? It's not flattery? That I'm truly attractive...
Message.先ほどは我の決意を見届けてくれたこと、感謝する。\n信頼するお前だからこそ、あの:
I thank you for witnessing my resolve earlier.
It was precisely because you are someone I trust that I could lay myself bare like that.
Message.我にとって一番大事な存在は、やはりニーナなのだ。\nおっと……これもまた、本人に:
To me, the most important presence is still Nina.
Oops... please keep this a secret from her as well.
Message.我らは家畜ではない。与えられるだけの明日に意味はない。\n故に『今日』という日を:
We are not livestock. A tomorrow that is merely handed to us has no meaning.
Therefore, we must fight through this 'today' and win what we desire.
Message.話は以上だ。ではな、%usernameusernameuserna%！\n後ほど:
That is all. Farewell, %usernameusernameuserna%!
Do not get too entranced by my sword dance on the battlefield later!
Message.……そのためにも、この戦いを乗り越える必要があります。\n後ほどまた、決戦に向け:
...For that reason as well, we need to overcome this battle.
Let's coordinate again later for the decisive battle. Farewell.
Message.あと、それと……戦いが終わったら、ゾリャーの外のこと、\nまだまだたくさん教えて:
Also... when the battle is over,
please teach me so much more about the world outside Zorya.
Message.なんだかこうしていると、普通のどこにでもいる\nひとりの女の子になったみたいです:
Somehow, being like this makes me feel like I've become
an ordinary girl you could find anywhere.
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%さんですか？\nさっき:
Hello, is this %usernameusernameuserna%?
Thank you for accompanying me to check the unit earlier.
Message.ザルトゥームの未来のために、あなたが辣腕を振るうことを期待します。\n我々クラス:
For the future of Zartum, I expect you to show your great skill.
We in Krasna will also surely follow your orders and deliver results.
Message.不安や懸念を完全に払拭し、\n決戦に臨むことができるようになったでしょうか。:
Have you completely cleared away your anxieties and concerns,
allowing you to face the decisive battle?
Message.私達……思えば、出会ってからまだ間もないですけど。\nでも、%usernameu:
Come to think of it... it hasn't been long since we met.
But if it's you, %usernameusernameuserna%, I can trust you.
Message.……あ、お礼が理由なんですね。: ...Ah, so thanking me was the reason.
Message.……？ みんなじゃなくて、ふたりで……？: ...? Not with everyone, but just the two of us...?
Message.あ、%usernameusernameuserna%さん、こんにちは。\n昨日は:
Ah, hello, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Thank you... for yesterday.
Message.い、いえ！ 嫌とかじゃなくて……むしろ、望むところと言いますか、\n願ってもない:
N-No! It's not that I dislike it... rather, it's just what I wished for,
or I should say I couldn't ask for anything better...!
Message.ううん、なんでもないです！ 嬉しいです……！\nどうであれ、私と『ふたりで』とい:
No, it's nothing! I'm happy...!
Either way, the fact that it's 'just the two of us' with me is especially... ehehe.
Message.えっ！？ ふたりでですか！？: Eh!? Just the two of us!?
Message.え？ また星を観に行こう？ 今度は景色のいい場所で……？: Eh? Go stargazing again? Next time in a place with a nice view...?
Message.では今度時間を作って、夜空の綺麗な場所へ行きましょう。\nアマツで綺麗な星が観ら:
Then let's make time next time and go somewhere with a beautiful night sky.
I'll look up a few candidate spots in Amatsu where we can see beautiful stars.
Message.はい……！ 喜んで！\nではみんなにもこのお話をして、スケジュールを――:
Yes...! Gladly!
Then I'll tell everyone about this and coordinate schedules—
Message.ん？ 昨日のお礼をちゃんとしたい……ですか？: Hmm? You want to... properly thank me for yesterday?
Message.不束者ですが、これからも末永くよろしくお願いしますっ。: I'm still inexperienced, but I look forward to working with you for a long time to come.
Message.…………あーもう、ほんと、ヤなやつ！ そういうとこよ！！\n目の前にいたら蹴飛ば:
............Agh geez, seriously, you're so annoying! It's that trait of yours!!
If you were right in front of me, I'd kick you!
Message.……？ え、行ってくれるの……？ ふたりで？: ...? Eh, you'll go with me...? Just the two of us?
Message.あー！ やっぱなし！ 忘れなさい！ 今のはなし！\nこんなの私らしくない！:
Ah! Forget it after all! Forget what I said! Cancel that!
This isn't like me at all!
Message.いい？ 絶対今度もふたりだからね！\n『せっかくだからみんなも誘ってみた』\nと:
Listen here, next time has to be just the two of us too, okay!
Don't do something idiotically stupid like
'Since we're going, I invited everyone else too'!
Message.え？ 『そういう一面もいい』……？: Eh? 'A side like that is nice too'...?
Message.こ、今度よかったら……また、どこかに行かない？ ふ、ふたりで……: I-If you're free next time... want to go somewhere again? J-Just the two of us...
Message.こう……あんたと何でもない日を、\nもっと過ごしてみたいっていうか……: Like... I want to spend more ordinary, nothing-special days with you...
Message.どうせなら、のんびり夕日の見れる場所とか……そういうところ。\nまあ、無理にとは:
If we're going, somewhere we can relax and watch the sunset... a place like that.
Well, I'm not forcing you or anything, though...
Message.ふふ、言ったわね？ 今更撤回なんてナシなんだから！\nまた予定つけたら声かけるわ:
Fufu, you said it, okay? There's no taking it back now!
I'll call you again once I set up a schedule!
Message.もしもし……起きてる？ 今日はその……ありがとう。楽しかったわ。\n校舎もゆっく:
Hello... Are you awake? Today... thanks. I had fun.
I got to take my time looking around the school building too.
Message.校舎から見る夕日、綺麗だった。\n本当なら晴れていれば毎日見れるはずなのに、\n:
The sunset seen from the school building was beautiful.
Normally, we should be able to see it every day if it's clear,
but I realized that there are surprisingly few times when we actually take the time to watch it properly.
